SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS link_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, SUM(p.answercount) AS total_answers, SUM(p.commentcount) AS total_post_comments, SUM(p.favoritecount) AS total_favorites, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, AVG(t.count) AS avg_tag_popularity, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) DESC) AS badge_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid AND b.date >= 1580413823942 LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid AND c.creationdate >= 1336176458006 AND c.score > '1' LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid AND ph.creationdate >= 1535277967345 AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON ph.postid = pl.postid AND pl.creationdate >= 1472625162811 AND pl.linktypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid AND p.creationdate >= 1572370700457 AND p.posttypeid = '1' AND p.score > 688 AND p.viewcount > 59735 LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND v.creationdate >= 1408262746015 AND v.votetypeid = '1' AND v.bountyamount > '0' LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid AND t.count > 8333 WHERE u.reputation > 694551 AND u.creationdate >= 1528556436758 AND (u.upvotes > 8930 OR u.downvotes < 503) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) > 572 AND SUM(p.score) > 6715 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) > 428 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, badge_count DESC LIMIT 103;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS link_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, SUM(p.answercount) AS total_answers, SUM(p.commentcount) AS total_post_comments, SUM(p.favoritecount) AS total_favorites, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, AVG(t.count) AS avg_tag_popularity, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) DESC) AS badge_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY (u.reputation / 1000) ORDER BY SUM(p.viewcount) DESC) AS view_rank_in_reputation_bucket FROM users u LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid AND b.date >= 1491487958961 LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid AND c.creationdate >= 1436575777010 AND c.score > '1' LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid AND ph.creationdate >= 1525615376615 AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON ph.postid = pl.postid AND pl.creationdate >= 1441105755358 AND pl.linktypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid AND p.creationdate >= 1399724560395 AND p.posttypeid = '1' AND p.score > 56 LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND v.creationdate >= 1342560394472 AND v.votetypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid AND t.count > 538 WHERE u.reputation > 617943 AND u.creationdate >= 1428947865776 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, (u.reputation / 1000) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) > 80 AND SUM(p.score) > 6795 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) > 78 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, badge_count DESC LIMIT 380;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(c.score) AS max_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid WHERE p.posttypeid = '1' AND p.creationdate >= 1409739287165 AND p.creationdate <= 1380094739087 AND u.reputation > 150677 AND p.score > 4490 AND v.votetypeid IN (SELECT v2.votetypeid FROM votes v2 WHERE v2.creationdate >= 1262863243763 AND v2.userid = u.id GROUP BY v2.votetypeid HAVING COUNT(*) > 63) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 444 AND SUM(p.score) > 32818 ORDER BY total_score DESC, post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(c.score) AS max_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS link_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts p2 WHERE p2.owneruserid = u.id AND p2.posttypeid = 1 AND p2.creationdate >= 1302427376649) AS recent_questions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes v2 WHERE v2.userid = u.id AND v2.votetypeid = 2 AND v2.creationdate >= 1266735386275) AS recent_upvotes FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid AND p.posttypeid = 2 LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid AND c.score > '1' LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND (v.votetypeid = 8 OR v.votetypeid = 9) LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid AND b.date >= 1409788244873 LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid IN (2,5) LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = 1 WHERE u.reputation > 558500 AND (u.creationdate <= 1338413918229 OR u.views >= 37732) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM posts p3 WHERE p3.owneruserid = u.id AND p3.favoritecount > 648) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM comments c2 WHERE c2.userid = u.id AND c2.creationdate >= 1490920359375)) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 498 AND SUM(p.score) >= 105 AND COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) < 95320 ORDER BY total_score DESC, post_count ASC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(c.score) AS max_comment_score, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.posttypeid = '1' AND p.creationdate >= 1599391558748 AND p.creationdate <= 1351024798728 AND u.reputation > 723048 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM badges b WHERE b.userid = u.id AND b.date >= 1527894822474 ORDER BY b.date DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 141) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 81 AND SUM(p.score) >= 5890 ORDER BY total_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answer_count, MAX(p.favoritecount) AS max_favorite_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.votetypeid = '1') AS specific_vote_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) FILTER (WHERE ph.posthistorytypeid = '1') AS specific_history_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) FILTER (WHERE pl.linktypeid = '1') AS specific_link_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank, LAG(u.reputation, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY u.id ORDER BY MIN(p.creationdate)) AS prev_reputation FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid WHERE ( (p.creationdate >= 1583266301742 AND p.creationdate <= 1607166278383) OR (c.creationdate >= 1525810896126 AND c.creationdate <= 1384870994392) OR (b.date >= 1550057755806 AND b.date <= 1278550075220) ) AND NOT (p.score < 7 AND p.viewcount < 5091) AND (u.reputation > 41892 OR u.views > 91479) AND p.posttypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 33 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) >= 81 AND SUM(p.score) > 243 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, total_views DESC LIMIT 764;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, MAX(p.viewcount) AS max_view_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS linked_posts_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.favoritecount) DESC) AS favorite_rank FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1606194931371 AND p.creationdate <= 1471268595758 AND p.score > 617 AND u.reputation >= 890324 AND v.votetypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 94 AND SUM(v.bountyamount) >= '0' ORDER BY total_bounty DESC, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(CASE WHEN p.posttypeid = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS question_count, SUM(CASE WHEN p.posttypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answer_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes_received, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS post_history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS post_links_involved, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date, (SUM(p.favoritecount) + SUM(p.commentcount) + SUM(p.answercount)) AS engagement_score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid OR p.id = pl.relatedpostid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1602862349752 AND p.score > 37 AND u.reputation >= 166290 AND v.creationdate >= 1604358062699 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 54 AND SUM(p.viewcount) > 529157 ORDER BY total_posts DESC, engagement_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received, MAX(sub.max_comment_score) AS max_comment_score_on_posts, SUM(sub2.total_badge_count) AS total_badges_earned FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ph.userid, MAX(c.score) AS max_comment_score FROM posthistory ph JOIN comments c ON ph.postid = c.postid WHERE ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' AND c.creationdate >= 1323906413452 GROUP BY ph.userid ) sub ON u.id = sub.userid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT b.userid, COUNT(*) AS total_badge_count FROM badges b WHERE b.date BETWEEN 1351953215269 AND 1473642461074 GROUP BY b.userid ) sub2 ON u.id = sub2.userid WHERE u.creationdate >= 1356238357916 AND p.creationdate BETWEEN 1370504442073 AND 1521568421613 AND p.posttypeid = '1' AND (p.score > 74 OR p.viewcount > 51663) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 98 AND SUM(p.score) >= 3550 ORDER BY total_posts DESC, total_post_score DESC LIMIT 952;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.score) AS median_post_score, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.viewcount) AS p75_post_views, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY u.reputation) AS p90_user_reputation FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1433054186922 AND p.creationdate <= 1519312327306 AND u.creationdate >= 1369334436489 AND u.creationdate <= 1492929702186 AND p.score > 727 AND u.reputation > 268603 AND v.creationdate >= 1496628377651 AND v.creationdate <= 1296385550305 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 415 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 4252 AND SUM(p.viewcount) > 289097 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, total_views DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_month, p.posttypeid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS link_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.posttypeid ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.id), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY u.id, p.posttypeid ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate))) AS prev_month_post_count FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1391157528 AND p.creationdate <= 1313119381 AND u.reputation > 883933 AND p.score > 1910 AND v.votetypeid = '1' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (u.id, u.reputation, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), p.posttypeid), (u.id, u.reputation, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate))), (u.id, u.reputation, p.posttypeid), (u.id, u.reputation), (DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), p.posttypeid), (DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate))), (p.posttypeid), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 575 AND SUM(p.score) > 76335 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(CASE WHEN p.posttypeid = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS question_count, SUM(CASE WHEN p.posttypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answer_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvote_count, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvote_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date, (SUM(p.favoritecount) + SUM(p.commentcount) + SUM(p.answercount)) AS total_engagement_score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid AND p.creationdate >= 1607925130441 AND p.score > 24 LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid AND c.creationdate >= 1473169415109 AND c.score > '0' LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.creationdate >= 1355125546015 AND v.votetypeid IN ('1', '1') LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid AND b.date >= 1502063274509 LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid AND ph.creationdate >= 1544447757069 AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.creationdate >= 1389607152783 AND pl.linktypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE u.reputation > 669512 AND u.creationdate >= 1362338358033 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 335 AND SUM(p.viewcount) > 836920 ORDER BY total_engagement_score DESC, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY u.reputation / 1000 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_rank_by_reputation_bucket, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.id), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY u.id ORDER BY p.creationdate) AS prev_post_count FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1310798227833 AND p.creationdate <= 1584373752896 AND p.score > 315 AND u.reputation >= 629884 AND u.reputation <= 361439 AND v.creationdate >= 1289454713141 AND v.creationdate <= 1509623871364 AND c.creationdate >= 1441167056964 AND c.creationdate <= 1329590089071 AND b.date >= 1572215008685 AND b.date <= 1569308063570 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, p.creationdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 85 AND SUM(p.score) > 826 AND AVG(p.viewcount) > 16503 ORDER BY total_posts DESC, total_post_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS rank_by_post_score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY u.reputation / 1000 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS row_in_reputation_bucket FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid AND p.posttypeid = 1 LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid WHERE u.creationdate >= 1435879951 AND u.reputation >= 142715 AND (p.creationdate >= 1386480614 OR p.creationdate IS NULL) AND (c.creationdate >= 1370437998 OR c.creationdate IS NULL) AND (v.creationdate >= 1544067787 OR v.creationdate IS NULL) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 23 AND SUM(p.score) > 2339 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 4624 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_postlinks, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_posthistory, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answers_per_post, AVG(p.commentcount) AS avg_comments_per_post, AVG(p.favoritecount) AS avg_favorites_per_post, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank, LAG(u.reputation, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY u.id ORDER BY MIN(p.creationdate)) AS prev_reputation, SUM(SUM(p.score)) OVER (PARTITION BY u.reputation / 1000) AS reputation_bucket_total_score FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1545411799024 AND p.creationdate <= 1310927678557 AND u.reputation > 334075 AND p.score > 2452 AND v.creationdate >= 1335644779945 AND v.creationdate <= 1408550762461 AND b.date >= 1399072867590 AND b.date <= 1335933782705 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 483 AND SUM(p.score) > 49531 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, total_posts DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_year, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1571987744574 AND p.creationdate <= 1535054985732 AND p.posttypeid = 1 AND u.reputation > 346470 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (u.id, u.reputation, post_year), (u.id, u.reputation), (post_year), () ) ORDER BY u.reputation DESC, post_year;

WITH user_activity AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.creationdate AS user_creation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, SUM(p.answercount) AS total_answers, SUM(p.favoritecount) AS total_favorites, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1599846220659 OR p.creationdate IS NULL GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate ), post_engagement AS ( SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.owneruserid, p.posttypeid, p.creationdate, p.score, p.viewcount, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS link_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score FROM posts p LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate BETWEEN 1270239949959 AND 1331052678086 GROUP BY p.id, p.owneruserid, p.posttypeid, p.creationdate, p.score, p.viewcount ), tag_popularity AS ( SELECT t.id AS tag_id, t.count AS tag_usage, t.excerptpostid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS tagged_posts, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_tag_views, SUM(p.answercount) AS total_tag_answers FROM tags t JOIN posts p ON t.excerptpostid = p.id WHERE t.count > 4874 GROUP BY t.id, t.count, t.excerptpostid ) SELECT ua.user_id, ua.reputation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + ua.user_creation * INTERVAL '1 millisecond') AS join_year, ua.post_count, ua.comment_count, ua.badge_count, ua.vote_count, ua.total_post_score, ua.total_views, ua.total_answers, ua.total_favorites, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.post_id) AS active_posts, AVG(pe.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(pe.viewcount) t.id = tp.tag_id WHERE ua.reputation > 64397 AND ua.post_count >= 686 AND pe.posttypeid = '1' GROUP BY ua.user_id, ua.reputation, ua.user_creation, ua.post_count, ua.comment_count, ua.badge_count, ua.vote_count, ua.total_post_score, ua.total_views, ua.total_answers, ua.total_favorites HAVING AVG(pe.score) > 10 AND SUM(pe.viewcount) > 29400 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pe.post_id) >= 183 ORDER BY ua.reputation DESC, total_post_views DESC LIMIT 574;

WITH user_activity AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.creationdate AS user_creation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_given, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_post_views FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1543549987490 OR c.creationdate >= 1394675263501 OR v.creationdate >= 1479044436170 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 37 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 13 ), post_metrics AS ( SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.owneruserid, p.score, p.viewcount, p.answercount, p.commentcount, p.favoritecount, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS edit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS link_count, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS post_upvotes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS post_downvotes, MAX(v.creationdate) AS last_vote_date FROM posts p LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid = 5 LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = 1 LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate BETWEEN 1508308210233 AND 1483202230685 GROUP BY p.id, p.owneruserid, p.score, p.viewcount, p.answercount, p.commentcount, p.favoritecount HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) >= 5 AND SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 3 ), tag_popularity AS ( SELECT t.id AS tag_id, t.count AS tag_usage_count, t.excerptpostid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS tagged_post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_tagged_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_tagged_views FROM tags t JOIN posts p ON t.excerptpostid = p.id WHERE t.count > 142 GROUP BY t.id, t.count, t.excerptpostid ) SELECT ua.user_id, ua.reputation, ua.post_count, ua.comment_count, ua.vote_count, ua.upvotes_given, ua.total_post_score, ua.avg_post_views, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.post_id) AS active_post_count, SUM(pm.score) AS total_active_post_score, AVG(pm.viewcount) AS avg_active_post_views, SUM(pm.edit_count) AS total_edits, SUM(pm.link_count) AS total_links, SUM(pm.post_upvotes) AS total_post_upvotes_received, SUM(pm.post_downvotes) AS total_post_downvotes_received, COUNT(DISTINCT tp.tag_id) AS tags_associated, SUM(tp.tag_usage_count) AS total_tag_usage, SUM(tp.tagged_post_count) AS total_tagged_posts, AVG(tp.avg_tagged_post_score) AS avg_tagged_post_score FROM user_activity ua JOIN post_metrics pm ON ua.user_id = pm.owneruserid LEFT JOIN tags t ON pm.post_id = t.excerptpostid LEFT JOIN tag_popularity tp ON t.id = tp.tag_id WHERE ua.reputation > 59760 AND pm.score > 19 GROUP BY ua.user_id, ua.reputation, ua.post_count, ua.comment_count, ua.vote_count, ua.upvotes_given, ua.total_post_score, ua.avg_post_views HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pm.post_id) > 3 AND SUM(pm.post_upvotes) > 11 ORDER BY total_active_post_score DESC, ua.reputation DESC LIMIT 864;

WITH user_post_stats AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.posttypeid = '1' OR p.posttypeid IS NULL GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation ), comment_engagement AS ( SELECT c.userid, COUNT(c.id) AS comment_count, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, MIN(c.creationdate) AS first_comment_date, MAX(c.creationdate) AS last_comment_date FROM comments c WHERE c.score >= '0' GROUP BY c.userid ), vote_analysis AS ( SELECT v.userid, COUNT(v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_given, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes_given, AVG(v.bountyamount) AS avg_bounty FROM votes v WHERE v.creationdate BETWEEN 1532205300 AND 1534107150 GROUP BY v.userid ), badge_summary AS ( SELECT b.userid, COUNT(b.id) AS badge_count, MIN(b.date) AS first_badge_date FROM badges b WHERE b.date >= 1314109835 GROUP BY b.userid ), post_history_trend AS ( SELECT ph.userid, COUNT(ph.id) AS history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.posthistorytypeid) AS unique_history_types FROM posthistory ph WHERE ph.creationdate >= 1498415804 GROUP BY ph.userid ), post_link_network AS ( SELECT pl.postid, COUNT(pl.id) AS link_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS unique_related_posts FROM postlinks pl WHERE pl.linktypeid = '1' GROUP BY pl.postid ), tag_popularity AS ( SELECT t.excerptpostid, t.count AS tag_usage_count FROM tags t WHERE t.count > 8619 ) SELECT ups.user_id, ups.reputation, ups.total_posts, ups.total_post_score, ups.avg_viewcount, ce.comment_count, ce.avg_comment_score, va.total_votes, va.upvotes_given, va.downvotes_given, va.avg_bounty, bs.badge_count, bs.first_badge_date, pht.history_entries, pht.unique_history_types, pln.link_count, pln.unique_related_posts, tp.tag_usage_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ups.total_post_score DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ce.comment_count DESC) AS comment_count_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY va.total_votes DESC) AS vote_percent_rank FROM user_post_stats ups LEFT JOIN comment_engagement ce ON ups.user_id = ce.userid LEFT JOIN vote_analysis va ON ups.user_id = va.userid LEFT JOIN badge_summary bs ON ups.user_id = bs.userid LEFT JOIN post_history_trend pht ON ups.user_id = pht.userid LEFT JOIN posts p ON ups.user_id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN post_link_network pln ON p.id = pln.postid LEFT JOIN tag_popularity tp ON p.id = tp.excerptpostid WHERE (ups.total_posts > 6 OR ce.comment_count > 73) AND (va.total_votes >= 884 OR bs.badge_count >= 90) AND NOT (pht.history_entries < 67 AND pln.link_count < 22) AND ups.latest_post_date <= 1585365128 GROUP BY ups.user_id, ups.reputation, ups.total_posts, ups.total_post_score, ups.avg_viewcount, ce.comment_count, ce.avg_comment_score, va.total_votes, va.upvotes_given, va.downvotes_given, va.avg_bounty, bs.badge_count, bs.first_badge_date, pht.history_entries, pht.unique_history_types, pln.link_count, pln.unique_related_posts, tp.tag_usage_count HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 3 AND AVG(pln.link_count) < 2 ORDER BY ups.total_post_score DESC, ce.comment_count DESC, va.total_votes DESC LIMIT 96;

p.owneruserid ), combined_analysis AS ( SELECT ua.user_id, ua.reputation, ua.post_count, ua.comment_count, ua.badge_count, ua.total_post_score, ua.avg_viewcount, pm.post_id, pm.score AS post_score, tp.posts_with_tag, tp.tag_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ua.user_id ORDER BY pm.score DESC) AS post_rank, SUM(pm.score) OVER (PARTITION BY ua.user_id) AS user_total_post_score, AVG(pm.viewcount) OVER (PARTITION BY ua.user_id) AS user_avg_viewcount, COUNT(pm.post_id) OVER (PARTITION BY tp.tag_id) AS tag_user_count FROM user_activity ua JOIN post_metrics pm ON ua.user_id = ua.total_post_score DESC, ua.reputation DESC) AS user_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tp.tag_id ORDER BY pm.score DESC) AS tag_post_rank FROM user_activity ua JOIN post_metrics pm ON ua.user_id SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, p.posttypeid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_year, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answers, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_links, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.posttypeid ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1595678532590 AND p.creationdate <= 1586291981376 AND p.score > 11 AND u.reputation >= 165683 AND u.reputation <= 357089 AND v.creationdate >= 1551129345944 AND v.creationdate <= 1404540158653 GROUP BY CUBE(u.id, u.reputation, p.posttypeid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate))) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 526 AND SUM(p.viewcount) > 258101 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, total_views DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.creationdate AS user_creation, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges b WHERE b.userid = u.id AND b.date >= 1481302202109) AS recent_badge_count, (SELECT AVG(p.score) FROM posts p WHERE p.owneruserid = u.id AND p.creationdate >= 1487689754215) AS avg_post_score, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM users u LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid AND c.creationdate >= 1453925033659 LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.votetypeid = '1' AND v.creationdate >= 1394148230591 WHERE u.reputation BETWEEN 996137 AND 602058 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 401 ORDER BY total_bounty DESC NULLS LAST, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u1.id AS user_id, u1.reputation AS user_reputation, u2.id AS other_user_id, u2.reputation AS other_reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT b1.id) AS badge_count FROM users u1 JOIN users u2 ON u1.id != u2.id AND u1.creationdate = u2.creationdate LEFT JOIN badges b1 ON u1.id = b1.userid WHERE u1.reputation > 646308.4 AND u2.reputation > 975162.09 GROUP BY u1.id, u1.reputation, u2.id, u2.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b1.id) > 22.07 ORDER BY badge_count DESC;

WITH user_activity AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.creationdate AS user_creation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1566107682621 OR p.creationdate IS NULL GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate ), post_metrics AS ( SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.owneruserid, p.creationdate AS post_creation, p.score, p.viewcount, p.answercount, p.commentcount, p.favoritecount, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS edit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS link_count, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score FROM posts p LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid = 5 LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid WHERE p.score > 41 GROUP BY p.id, p.owneruserid, p.creationdate, p.score, p.viewcount, p.answercount, p.commentcount, p.favoritecount ), ranked_users AS ( SELECT ua.user_id, ua.reputation, ua.user_creation, ua.post_count, ua.comment_count, ua.badge_count, ua.total_post_score, ua.total_views, ua.upvotes_received, pm.post_id, pm.post_creation, pm.score AS post_score, pm.viewcount AS post_views, pm.answercount, pm.commentcount, pm.favoritecount, pm.edit_count, pm.link_count, pm.avg_comment_score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ua.user_id ORDER BY pm.post_creation DESC) AS post_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ua.total_post_score DESC) AS user_score_rank, AVG(ua.reputation) OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + ua.user_creation * INTERVAL '1 millisecond')) AS avg_reputation_by_year FROM user_activity ua LEFT JOIN post_metrics pm ON ua.user_id = pm.owneruserid WHERE ua.reputation >= 78165 ) SELECT user_id, reputation, user_creation, post_count, comment_count, badge_count, total_post_score, total_views, upvotes_received, user_score_rank, avg_reputation_by_year, COUNT(post_id) AS recent_post_count, SUM(post_score) AS recent_post_score_sum, AVG(post_views) AS avg_recent_post_views, MAX(edit_count) AS max_edit_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY link_count) AS median_link_count FROM ranked_users WHERE post_rank <= 5 GROUP BY user_id, reputation, user_creation, post_count, comment_count, badge_count, total_post_score, total_views, upvotes_received, user_score_rank, avg_reputation_by_year HAVING SUM(post_score) > 68 ORDER BY user_score_rank, total_post_score DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH user_activity AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.creationdate AS user_creation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, SUM(p.answercount) AS total_answers, SUM(p.commentcount) AS total_post_comments, SUM(p.favoritecount) AS total_favorites, MAX(p.creationdate) AS last_post_date, MIN(p.creationdate) AS first_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1294358327435 OR c.creationdate >= 1513056445141 OR v.creationdate >= 1539816219406 OR b.date >= 1557140022106 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate ), post_metrics AS ( SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.owneruserid, p.posttypeid, p.creationdate, p.score, p.viewcount, p.answercount, p.commentcount, p.favoritecount, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS edit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS link_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, MAX(t.count) AS tag_popularity FROM posts p LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid IN (2,5,8) LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = 1 LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate BETWEEN 1383949015964 AND 1344069429629 GROUP BY p.id, p.owneruserid, p.posttypeid, p.creationdate, p.score, p.viewcount, p.answercount, p.commentcount, p.favoritecount ), ranked_users AS ( SELECT ua.*, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ua.reputation DESC) AS rep_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ua.total_post_score DESC) AS score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ua.total_views DESC) AS view_rank, (ua.last_post_date - ua.first_post_date) / 86400000 AS activity_span_days FROM user_activity ua WHERE ua.post_count > 9 OR ua.comment_count > 249 ), aggregated_posts AS ( SELECT pm.owneruserid, COUNT(*) AS total_posts, AVG(pm.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(pm.viewcount) AS total_post_views, SUM(pm.answercount) AS total_post_answers, SUM(pm.commentcount) AS total_post_comments, SUM(pm.favoritecount) AS total_post_favorites, SUM(pm.edit_count) AS total_edits, SUM(pm.link_count) AS total_links, SUM(pm.vote_count) AS total_post_votes, SUM(pm.upvotes) AS total_upvotes, SUM(pm.downvotes) AS total_downvotes, AVG(pm.avg_comment_score) AS overall_avg_comment_score, MAX(pm.tag_popularity) AS max_tag_popularity, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pm.score) AS median_post_score FROM post_metrics pm GROUP BY pm.owneruserid HAVING COUNT(*) > 50 AND AVG(pm.score) > 95.56 ) SELECT ru.user_id, ru.reputation, ru.post_count, ru.comment_count, ru.vote_count, ru.badge_count, ru.total_post_score, ru.total_views, ru.total_answers, ru.total_post_comments, ru.total_favorites, ru.rep_rank, ru.score_rank, ru.view_rank, ru.activity_span_days, ap.total_posts, ap.avg_post_score, ap.total_post_views, ap.total_post_answers, ap.total_post_comments, ap.total_post_favorites, ap.total_edits, ap.total_links, ap.total_post_votes, ap.total_upvotes, ap.total_downvotes, ap.overall_avg_comment_score, ap.max_tag_popularity, ap.median_post_score, (ru.total_post_score * 0.3 + ru.total_views * 0.2 + ap.total_posts * 0.1 + ap.avg_post_score * 0.4) AS engagement_score FROM ranked_users ru JOIN aggregated_posts ap ON ru.user_id = ap.owneruserid WHERE ru.reputation > 9842 AND ru.activity_span_days > 1066 AND ap.total_post_votes > 101 ORDER BY engagement_score DESC, ru.reputation DESC LIMIT 473;

WITH user_activity_summary AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.creationdate AS user_creation_date, u.views AS user_profile_views, u.upvotes - u.downvotes AS net_votes, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(CASE WHEN p.posttypeid = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS question_count, SUM(CASE WHEN p.posttypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answer_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, MAX(p.viewcount) AS max_view_count, SUM(p.commentcount) AS total_comments_on_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comments_made, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS votes_cast, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badges_earned, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS post_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS post_links_involved FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid OR p.id = pl.relatedpostid WHERE u.creationdate >= 1576588484 AND p.creationdate >= 1100196774 AND v.creationdate >= 1500733077 AND b.date >= 1274862926 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate, u.views, u.upvotes, u.downvotes ), tag_popularity AS ( SELECT t.id AS tag_id, t.count AS tag_usage_count, t.excerptpostid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS posts_with_tag, AVG(p.score) AS avg_score_tagged_posts, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views_tagged_posts FROM tags t JOIN posts p ON t.excerptpostid = p.id WHERE t.count >= 6600 AND p.creationdate >= 1399995641 GROUP BY t.id, t.count, t.excerptpostid ), post_engagement_metrics AS ( SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.owneruserid, p.posttypeid, p.creationdate, p.score, p.viewcount, p.answercount, p.commentcount, p.favoritecount, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes, MAX(v.bountyamount) AS max_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS edit_history_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS link_count FROM posts p LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid OR p.id = pl.relatedpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1319697516 AND v.creationdate >= 1541556228 AND ph.creationdate >= 1382489728 GROUP BY p.id, p.owneruserid, p.posttypeid, p.creationdate, p.score, p.viewcount, p.answercount, p.commentcount, p.favoritecount ) SELECT uas.user_id, uas.reputation, uas.user_profile_views, uas.net_votes, uas.total_posts, uas.question_count, uas.answer_count, uas.avg_post_score, uas.max_view_count, uas.total_comments_on_posts, uas.comments_made, uas.votes_cast, uas.badges_earned, uas.post_history_events, uas.post_links_involved, tp.tag_id, tp.tag_usage_count, tp.posts_with_tag, tp.avg_score_tagged_posts, tp.total_views_tagged_posts, pem.post_id, pem.posttypeid, pem.creationdate AS post_creation_date, pem.score AS post_score, pem.viewcount AS post_views, pem.answercount, pem.commentcount, pem.favoritecount, pem.vote_count, pem.comment_count, pem.upvotes, pem.downvotes, pem.max_bounty, pem.edit_history_count, pem.link_count, CASE WHEN uas.reputation >= 57328 THEN 'High Reputation' WHEN uas.reputation >= 6658 THEN 'Medium Reputation' ELSE 'Low Reputation' END AS reputation_category, CASE WHEN pem.score >= 433 THEN 'High Scoring Post' WHEN pem.score >= 20 THEN 'Medium Scoring Post' ELSE 'Low Scoring Post' END AS post_score_category, CASE WHEN tp.tag_usage_count >= 9686 THEN 'Popular Tag' WHEN tp.tag_usage_count >= 129 THEN 'Common Tag' ELSE 'Niche Tag' END AS tag_popularity_category, CASE WHEN pem.vote_count >= 38 THEN 'Highly Voted' WHEN pem.vote_count >= 19 THEN 'Moderately Voted' ELSE 'Low Votes' END AS vote_engagement_category FROM user_activity_summary uas JOIN post_engagement_metrics pem ON uas.user_id = pem.owneruserid LEFT JOIN tag_popularity tp ON pem.post_id = tp.excerptpostid WHERE uas.total_posts >= 56 AND pem.vote_count >= 25 AND tp.tag_usage_count >= 225 ORDER BY uas.reputation DESC, pem.score DESC, tp.tag_usage_count DESC LIMIT 3103;

WITH user_post_activity AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1275672505119 OR c.creationdate >= 1572360714825 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation ), post_engagement AS ( SELECT ph.postid, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes, MAX(v.creationdate) AS last_vote_date FROM posthistory ph JOIN votes v ON ph.postid = v.postid WHERE ph.posthistorytypeid IN ('1', '11') AND v.creationdate BETWEEN 1365134795033 AND 1844546091622 GROUP BY ph.postid ), tag_popularity AS ( SELECT t.id AS tag_id, t.count AS tag_usage_count, p.owneruserid, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score_for_tag, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS linked_posts_count FROM tags t JOIN posts p ON t.excerptpostid = p.id LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = '1' WHERE t.count > 6332 GROUP BY t.id, t.count, p.owneruserid ), badge_analysis AS ( SELECT b.userid, COUNT(b.id) AS badge_count, MIN(b.date) AS first_badge_date, MAX(b.date) AS last_badge_date FROM badges b WHERE b.date >= 1422927513837 GROUP BY b.userid HAVING COUNT(b.id) > 29 ) SELECT upa.user_id, upa.reputation, upa.post_count, upa.comment_count, upa.total_post_score, upa.avg_viewcount, pe.history_entries, pe.vote_count, pe.upvotes, pe.downvotes, tp.tag_usage_count, tp.avg_post_score_for_tag, tp.linked_posts_count, ba.badge_count, ba.first_badge_date, ba.last_badge_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY upa.total_post_score DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY upa.reputation DESC) AS reputation_rank, SUM(upa.post_count) OVER (PARTITION BY upa.reputation / 749) AS posts_by_reputation_bucket, AVG(pe.vote_count) OVER (ORDER BY upa.latest_post_date RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_votes_rolling FROM user_post_activity upa JOIN post_engagement pe ON upa.user_id = (SELECT owneruserid FROM posts WHERE id = pe.postid) JOIN tag_popularity tp ON upa.user_id = tp.owneruserid JOIN badge_analysis ba ON upa.user_id = ba.userid WHERE upa.reputation > 44292 AND upa.post_count >= 26 AND pe.upvotes > 3 AND tp.tag_usage_count BETWEEN 92 AND 7696 ORDER BY upa.total_post_score DESC, upa.reputation DESC LIMIT 959;

WITH user_post_stats AS ( SELECT p.owneruserid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM posts p WHERE p.posttypeid = 1 GROUP BY p.owneruserid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 7 ), comment_activity AS ( SELECT c.userid, COUNT(*) AS comment_count, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, MIN(c.creationdate) AS first_comment_date, MAX(c.creationdate) AS last_comment_date FROM comments c GROUP BY c.userid HAVING AVG(c.score) > '1' ), vote_analysis AS ( SELECT v.userid, COUNT(*) AS total_votes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes, AVG(v.bountyamount) AS avg_bounty FROM votes v WHERE v.creationdate >= 1276219806 GROUP BY v.userid HAVING COUNT(*) > 261 ), post_history_self_join AS ( SELECT ph1.postid, ph1.userid AS editor1, ph2.userid AS editor2, COUNT(*) AS edit_pairs_count, MIN(ph1.creationdate) AS first_edit_pair_date FROM posthistory ph1 JOIN posthistory ph2 ON ph1.postid = ph2.postid AND ph1.id < ph2.id AND ph1.posthistorytypeid = ph2.posthistorytypeid AND ph1.creationdate BETWEEN 1360969279 AND 1364839676 WHERE ph1.userid IS NOT NULL AND ph2.userid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ph1.postid, ph1.userid, ph2.userid ), linked_posts AS ( SELECT pl.postid, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS linked_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_linked_score FROM postlinks pl JOIN posts p ON pl.relatedpostid = p.id WHERE pl.linktypeid = 1 GROUP BY pl.postid ), user_aggregated AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.views AS profile_views, u.upvotes AS user_upvotes, u.downvotes AS user_downvotes, ups.total_posts, ups.total_score, ups.avg_views, ups.latest_post_date, ca.comment_count, ca.avg_comment_score, ca.first_comment_date, ca.last_comment_date, va.total_votes, va.upvotes AS vote_upvotes, va.downvotes AS vote_downvotes, va.avg_bounty, COALESCE(SUM(phs.edit_pairs_count), 0) AS total_edit_pairs, COALESCE(AVG(lp.linked_count), 0) AS avg_linked_posts, COALESCE(AVG(lp.avg_linked_score), 0) AS avg_linked_score FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_post_stats ups ON u.id = ups.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comment_activity ca ON u.id = ca.userid LEFT JOIN vote_analysis va ON u.id = va.userid LEFT JOIN post_history_self_join phs ON u.id = phs.editor1 OR u.id = phs.editor2 LEFT JOIN linked_posts lp ON u.id = (SELECT owneruserid FROM posts WHERE id = lp.postid) WHERE u.reputation > 40437 AND u.creationdate >= 1325866764 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.views, u.upvotes, u.downvotes, ups.total_posts, ups.total_score, ups.avg_views, ups.latest_post_date, ca.comment_count, ca.avg_comment_score, ca.first_comment_date, ca.last_comment_date, va.total_votes, va.upvotes, va.downvotes, va.avg_bounty ) SELECT user_id, reputation, profile_views, user_upvotes, user_downvotes, total_posts, total_score, avg_views, latest_post_date, comment_count, avg_comment_score, first_comment_date, last_comment_date, total_votes, vote_upvotes, vote_downvotes, avg_bounty, total_edit_pairs, avg_linked_posts, avg_linked_score, (total_score * 0.3 + avg_views * 0.2 + reputation * 0.5) AS engagement_score FROM user_aggregated WHERE total_posts IS NOT NULL AND comment_count IS NOT NULL AND total_votes IS NOT NULL ORDER BY engagement_score DESC, reputation DESC LIMIT 679;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_posthistory_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_postlinks, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date, MIN(u.creationdate) AS user_creation_date, SUM(p.answercount + p.commentcount + p.favoritecount) AS total_engagement_metrics, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1459605239641 AND p.score > 832 AND c.creationdate >= 1369722212038 AND v.creationdate >= 1572032148233 AND b.date >= 1592283184698 AND ph.creationdate >= 1534962946358 AND pl.creationdate >= 1538949343899 AND u.reputation >= 103080 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 83 AND SUM(p.score) > 1119 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 94 AND COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) > 103 AND COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) > 25 AND AVG(p.viewcount) > 9741 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, total_posts DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes_received, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty_received, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, MAX(b.date) AS latest_badge_date, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid WHERE u.creationdate >= 1395659230586 AND u.reputation > 59139 AND (p.creationdate >= 1530885563322 OR p.creationdate IS NULL) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM posts p2 WHERE p2.owneruserid = u.id AND p2.posttypeid = 1 AND p2.answercount > 31 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM votes v2 WHERE v2.userid = u.id AND v2.votetypeid = 2 AND v2.creationdate >= 1380875386770 ) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 45 AND SUM(p.score) > 5543 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) >= 63 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received, MAX(sub.max_comment_score) AS max_comment_score_on_post, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS rank_by_post_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid = 2 LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = 1 LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid JOIN ( SELECT p2.owneruserid, MAX(c2.score) AS max_comment_score FROM posts p2 JOIN comments c2 ON p2.id = c2.postid WHERE c2.creationdate >= 1463758913845 AND c2.creationdate <= 1360750374324 GROUP BY p2.owneruserid ) sub ON u.id = sub.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1457072396861 AND p.creationdate <= 1584085606946 AND p.posttypeid = 1 AND u.reputation > 898981 AND (p.favoritecount >= 305 OR p.favoritecount IS NULL) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 66 AND SUM(p.score) > 1533 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_month, p.posttypeid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS link_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, MAX(t.count) AS max_tag_popularity FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1586141424870 AND p.creationdate <= 1480260715502 AND u.reputation > 854404 AND p.score > 32 AND (p.viewcount > 22359 OR p.viewcount IS NULL) GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (u.id, u.reputation, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), p.posttypeid), (u.id, u.reputation, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate))), (u.id, u.reputation), (DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), p.posttypeid), (DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate))), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 72 AND SUM(p.score) > 3973 ORDER BY u.reputation DESC, post_month DESC, posttypeid;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, t.id AS tag_id, t.count AS tag_count, p.posttypeid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS link_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1288633739065 AND p.creationdate <= 1511685498127 AND u.reputation > 468231 AND p.score > 4568 GROUP BY CUBE(u.id, u.reputation, t.id, t.count, p.posttypeid) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 548 AND SUM(p.score) > 38361 ORDER BY total_score DESC, post_count DESC;

WITH user_activity AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.creationdate AS user_creation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, SUM(p.answercount) AS total_answers, SUM(p.commentcount) AS total_post_comments, SUM(p.favoritecount) AS total_favorites, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1463851588 OR p.creationdate IS NULL GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate ), post_metrics AS ( SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.owneruserid, p.posttypeid, p.creationdate AS post_creation, p.score, p.viewcount, p.answercount, p.commentcount, p.favoritecount, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS link_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND v.votetypeid IN ('1', '1') WHERE p.creationdate BETWEEN 1333412309 AND 1310155750 GROUP BY p.id, p.owneruserid, p.posttypeid, p.creationdate, p.score, p.viewcount, p.answercount, p.commentcount, p.favoritecount ), tag_analysis AS ( SELECT t.id AS tag_id, t.count AS tag_usage_count, t.excerptpostid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS posts_with_tag, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score_tag, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views_tag FROM tags t JOIN posts p ON t.excerptpostid = p.id WHERE t.count > 9291 GROUP BY t.id, t.count, t.excerptpostid ), combined_metrics AS ( SELECT ua.user_id, ua.reputation, ua.user_creation, ua.post_count, ua.comment_count, ua.badge_count, ua.total_post_score, ua.total_views, ua.total_answers, ua.total_post_comments, ua.total_favorites, ua.avg_post_score, pm.post_id, pm.posttypeid, pm.post_creation, pm.vote_count, pm.upvotes, pm.downvotes, pm.total_bounty, ta.tag_id, ta.tag_usage_count, ta.posts_with_tag, ta.avg_post_score_tag, ta.total_views_tag, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ua.user_id ORDER BY pm.post_creation DESC) AS rn_user_post, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ua.total_post_score DESC) AS user_score_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ua.reputation) AS reputation_percentile FROM user_activity ua JOIN post_metrics pm ON ua.user_id = pm.owneruserid LEFT JOIN tag_analysis ta ON pm.post_id = ta.excerptpostid WHERE ua.reputation >= 46067 AND ua.total_views > 872243 ) SELECT user_id, reputation, user_creation, post_count, comment_count, badge_count, total_post_score, total_views, total_answers, total_post_comments, total_favorites, avg_post_score, COUNT(DISTINCT post_id) AS distinct_post_count, SUM(post_score) AS sum_post_scores, AVG(post_views) AS avg_post_views, MAX(post_answers) AS max_post_answers, MIN(post_comments) AS min_post_comments, SUM(post_favorites) AS sum_post_favorites, SUM(history_entries) AS total_history_entries, SUM(link_count) AS total_link_count, SUM(vote_count) AS total_vote_count, SUM(upvotes) AS total_upvotes, SUM(downvotes) AS total_downvotes, SUM(total_bounty) AS grand_total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT tag_id) AS distinct_tag_count, SUM(tag_usage_count) AS sum_tag_usage, AVG(avg_post_score_tag) AS avg_tag_post_score, SUM(total_views_tag) AS sum_tag_views, user_score_rank, AVG(reputation_percentile) AS avg_reputation_percentile FROM combined_metrics WHERE rn_user_post <= 4 GROUP BY user_id, reputation, user_creation, post_count, comment_count, badge_count, total_post_score, total_views, total_answers, total_post_comments, total_favorites, avg_post_score, user_score_rank HAVING SUM(post_score) > 1587 AND COUNT(DISTINCT post_id) >= 38 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, reputation DESC LIMIT 147;

WITH user_post_stats AS ( SELECT p.owneruserid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM posts p WHERE p.posttypeid = 1 GROUP BY p.owneruserid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 40 ), comment_engagement AS ( SELECT c.userid, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, MIN(c.creationdate) AS first_comment_date FROM comments c GROUP BY c.userid HAVING AVG(c.score) > '1' ), vote_analysis AS ( SELECT v.userid, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT v.postid) AS distinct_posts_voted FROM votes v WHERE v.votetypeid IN (1,2,3) GROUP BY v.userid HAVING SUM(v.bountyamount) > '50' ), post_history_trend AS ( SELECT ph1.userid, ph1.postid, COUNT(DISTINCT ph2.id) AS history_entries, MIN(ph2.creationdate) AS first_history_date FROM posthistory ph1 JOIN posthistory ph2 ON ph1.postid = ph2.postid AND ph1.userid = ph2.userid AND ph1.creationdate < ph2.creationdate WHERE ph1.posthistorytypeid = 2 GROUP BY ph1.userid, ph1.postid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ph2.id) > 14 ), badge_achievers AS ( SELECT b1.userid, COUNT(DISTINCT b1.id) AS total_badges, MIN(b2.date) AS earliest_badge_date FROM badges b1 JOIN badges b2 ON b1.userid = b2.userid AND b1.date < b2.date GROUP BY b1.userid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b1.id) > 13 ), linked_posts AS ( SELECT pl1.postid, COUNT(DISTINCT pl2.relatedpostid) AS total_links, MIN(pl2.creationdate) AS first_link_date FROM postlinks pl1 JOIN postlinks pl2 ON pl1.postid = pl2.postid AND pl1.creationdate < pl2.creationdate WHERE pl1.linktypeid = 1 GROUP BY pl1.postid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pl2.relatedpostid) > 35 ) SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.views AS profile_views, ups.total_posts, ups.total_score, ups.avg_views, ce.total_comments, ce.avg_comment_score, va.total_votes, va.total_bounty, va.distinct_posts_voted, pht.history_entries, ba.total_badges, lp.total_links, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY u.reputation DESC) AS reputation_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ups.total_score DESC) AS score_rank, LAG(u.reputation, 1) OVER (ORDER BY u.creationdate) AS prev_user_reputation FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_post_stats ups ON u.id = ups.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comment_engagement ce ON u.id = ce.userid LEFT JOIN vote_analysis va ON u.id = va.userid LEFT JOIN post_history_trend pht ON u.id = pht.userid LEFT JOIN badge_achievers ba ON u.id = ba.userid LEFT JOIN linked_posts lp ON u.id = lp.postid WHERE u.reputation > 65187 AND u.creationdate >= 1293635232 AND (ups.latest_post_date >= 1365525930 OR ups.latest_post_date IS NULL) ORDER BY u.reputation DESC, ups.total_score DESC LIMIT 504;

WITH user_post_stats AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS distinct_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS distinct_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS distinct_votes, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid WHERE u.creationdate >= 1402985600 AND u.reputation > 107040 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation ), post_history_agg AS ( SELECT ph.postid, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.userid) AS distinct_editors, MAX(ph.creationdate) AS last_history_date FROM posthistory ph WHERE ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' GROUP BY ph.postid ), tag_post_links AS ( SELECT t.id AS tag_id, t.count AS pl.relatedpostid WHERE t.count >= 9678 GROUP BY t.id, t.count ), badge_activity AS ( SELECT b.userid, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, MIN(b.date) AS first_badge_date, MAX(b.date) AS last_badge_date FROM badges b WHERE b.date BETWEEN 1326898790 AND 1517774154 GROUP BY b.userid ) SELECT ups.user_id, ups.reputation, ups.distinct_posts, ups.distinct_comments, ups.distinct_votes, ups.total_post_score, ups.avg_viewcount, COALESCE(pha.history_entries, 0) AS post_history_entries, COALESCE(pha.distinct_editors, 0) AS post_distinct_editors, COALESCE(tpl.tag_usage_count, 0) AS tag_usage, COALESCE(tpl.linked_posts, 0) AS tag_linked_posts, COALESCE(tpl.related_posts, 0) AS tag_related_posts, COALESCE(ba.badge_count, 0) AS user_badge_count, COALESCE(ba.first_badge_date, 0) AS SUM(ups.total_post_score * ups.distinct_posts) AS weighted_post_score FROM user_post_stats ups LEFT JOIN post_history_agg pha ON ups.user_id = (SELECT owneruserid FROM posts WHERE id = pha.postid) LEFT JOIN tag_post_links tpl ON ups.user_id = (SELECT owneruserid FROM posts WHERE id IN (tpl.linked_posts, tpl.related_posts)) LEFT JOIN badge_activity ba ON ups.user_id = ba.userid WHERE total_comments, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT c.postid) AS distinct_posts_commented FROM comments c WHERE c.creationdate >= 1470862213135 GROUP BY c.userid ), vote_analysis AS ( SELECT v.userid, COUNT(v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_given, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes_given, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty_given FROM votes v WHERE v.creationdate >= 1370459721272 GROUP BY v.userid ), badge_achievements AS ( SELECT b.userid, COUNT(b.id) AS total_badges, MIN(b.date) AS first_badge_date, MAX(b.date) AS latest_badge_date FROM badges b WHERE b.date >= 1576483836919 GROUP BY b.userid ), post_history_tracking AS ( SELECT ph.userid, COUNT(ph.id) AS total_history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.postid) AS distinct_posts_edited FROM posthistory ph WHERE ph.creationdate >= 1528624375975 GROUP BY ph.userid ), post_link_network AS ( SELECT pl.postid, COUNT(pl.id) AS t.count AS tag_usage_count, t.excerptpostid, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts p2 WHERE p2.id = t.excerptpostid AND p2.score > 51) AS high_score_excerpt FROM tags t WHERE t.count > 8948 ), nested_aggregation AS ( SELECT ups.user_id, ups.reputation, ups.total_posts, ups.total_post_score, ups.avg_viewcount, ups.latest_post_date, COALESCE(ce.total_comments, 0) AS total_comments, COALESCE(ce.avg_comment_score, 0) AS avg_comment_score, COALESCE(ce.distinct_posts_commented, 0) AS distinct_posts_commented, COALESCE(va.total_votes, 0) AS total_votes, COALESCE(va.upvotes_given, 0) post_link_network pln WHERE pln.postid IN (SELECT p3.id FROM posts p3 WHERE p3.owneruserid = ups.user_id)) AS total_post_links, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tp.tag_id) FROM tag_popularity tp WHERE tp.excerptpostid IN (SELECT p4.id FROM posts p4 WHERE p4.owneruserid = ups.user_id)) AS distinct_popular_tags_used FROM user_post_stats ups LEFT JOIN comment_engagement ce ON ups.user_id = ce.userid engagement_score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (na.total_post_score * 0.3 + na.avg_comment_score * 0.2 + na.reputation * 0.5) DESC) AS engagement_rank FROM nested_aggregation na WHERE na.total_posts > 50 OR WITH user_post_stats AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.creationdate AS user_creation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views,
