SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges b WHERE b.userid = u.id AND b.date >= 1523166674380) AS recent_badges FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid WHERE u.reputation > 3118 AND p.creationdate >= 1519745869916 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 11 ORDER BY recent_badges DESC, avg_post_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1485571802485 AND p.score > 5 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 40 ORDER BY post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1515613927607 AND p.creationdate <= 1293694153995 AND p.posttypeid = 1 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 57 ORDER BY avg_post_score DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received, MAX(sub.max_comment_score) AS max_comment_score_on_posts FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid, LATERAL (SELECT MAX(c_inner.score) AS max_comment_score FROM comments c_inner WHERE c_inner.postid = p.id AND c_inner.creationdate >= 1267845410992 AND c_inner.score > '1' GROUP BY c_inner.postid) AS sub WHERE p.posttypeid = 1 AND p.creationdate BETWEEN 1407461764903 AND 1364536687794 AND u.reputation > 393330 AND v.creationdate >= 1516360939996 AND ph.posthistorytypeid IN ('1', '1') AND b.date >= 1354130295918 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 52 AND AVG(p.score) < -56 AND SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 374 ORDER BY post_count DESC, avg_post_score ASC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY (p.posttypeid) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank_by_type FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1515653132675 AND p.score > 60 AND u.reputation >= 84216 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, p.posttypeid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 19 ORDER BY post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND v.votetypeid = 7 WHERE p.creationdate >= 1554437597442 AND p.creationdate <= 1275151537009 AND u.reputation > 487942 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 733 ORDER BY total_bounty DESC NULLS LAST, post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid AND p.creationdate >= 1377823006084 LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND v.votetypeid = '1' WHERE u.reputation > 59889 AND u.creationdate <= 1340551048777 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 60 ORDER BY total_bounty DESC NULLS LAST, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) OVER (PARTITION BY u.id) AS avg_post_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1445906768657 AND p.score > 82 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, p.score ORDER BY post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) OVER (PARTITION BY u.id) AS avg_post_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1526416483919 AND p.score > 98 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, p.score ORDER BY post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty_received FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND v.votetypeid = 8 WHERE u.reputation > 38086 AND u.creationdate >= 1009594461 AND p.id IN ( SELECT ph.postid FROM posthistory ph WHERE ph.posthistorytypeid = 2 AND ph.creationdate >= ( SELECT MIN(pl.creationdate) FROM postlinks pl WHERE pl.linktypeid = 1 AND pl.creationdate <= 1102548405 ) ) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 47 AND AVG(p.score) < 20 ORDER BY total_bounty_received DESC NULLS LAST, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, AVG(p.score) FILTER (WHERE p.score IS NOT NULL) AS avg_post_score, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY u.creationdate >= 1282102281 ORDER BY u.reputation DESC) AS rep_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.votetypeid = '1' WHERE u.reputation > 93864 AND u.creationdate BETWEEN 1264069683 AND 1278259201 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 54 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 44 ORDER BY u.reputation DESC, total_bounty DESC LIMIT 657;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.votetypeid = 8 WHERE p.creationdate >= 1561870422795 OR c.creationdate >= 1561933517632 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 13 AND AVG(p.score) < 49 AND SUM(v.bountyamount) >= '50' ORDER BY total_bounty DESC, post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, (SELECT AVG(score) FROM comments c WHERE c.userid = u.id AND c.creationdate >= 1423202676378) AS avg_comment_score_recent FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1301649579691 AND p.score > 65 AND v.votetypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 49 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.score) FILTER (WHERE p.score > 0) AS avg_positive_score, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1385909150005 OR c.creationdate >= 1292819346375 OR v.creationdate >= 1585741865675 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 65 OR COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 80 ORDER BY u.reputation DESC, total_post_score DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.score) FILTER (WHERE p.score > 0) AS avg_positive_score, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_quarter FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1383113600087 AND p.creationdate <= 1386530165422 AND p.score > 82 AND u.reputation >= 10547 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, post_year, post_quarter HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 45 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, post_year, post_quarter LIMIT 957;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1416796563135 AND p.score > 64 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING SUM(p.score) > 500 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 9 ORDER BY total_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1371062810263 AND p.score > 74 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 23 ORDER BY total_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(c.creationdate) AS latest_comment_date, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' THEN ph.id END) AS specific_history_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges b WHERE b.userid = u.id AND b.date >= 1418475270965) AS recent_badges, (SELECT AVG(sub.score) FROM (SELECT p2.score FROM posts p2 JOIN votes v2 ON p2.id = v2.postid WHERE p2.owneruserid = u.id AND v2.votetypeid = '1' AND p2.creationdate BETWEEN 1290975948999 AND 1570761306877 GROUP BY p2.id HAVING COUNT(v2.id) > 847) AS sub) AS avg_score_for_vote_type FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND v.bountyamount IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid WHERE u.reputation > 595375 AND p.creationdate >= 1550809367526 AND p.posttypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 80 AND SUM(p.score) >= 8107 ORDER BY total_score DESC, post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(c.score) AS max_comment_score, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges b WHERE b.userid = u.id AND b.date BETWEEN 1445563558465 AND 1395375109965) AS badge_count_in_range, (SELECT SUM(v.bountyamount) FROM votes v WHERE v.userid = u.id AND v.votetypeid = '1' AND v.creationdate >= 1295619694126) AS total_bounty_received, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1517141075015 AND p.score > 400 AND u.reputation > 110089 AND p.posttypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 56 AND SUM(p.score) > 2767 ORDER BY total_score DESC, post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(c.score) AS max_comment_score, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1569131135629 AND p.creationdate <= 1311990317427 AND p.score > 821 AND u.reputation >= 635969 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tags t WHERE t.excerptpostid = p.id AND t.count > 3510 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0) AND v.votetypeid = '1' AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' AND pl.linktypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 14 AND SUM(p.score) >= 59457 ORDER BY total_score DESC, post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(c.score) AS max_comment_score, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1468739545191 AND p.creationdate <= 1358101464869 AND p.score > 901 AND u.reputation >= 99645 AND v.votetypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 32 AND SUM(p.score) > 3007 INTERSECT SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(c.score) AS max_comment_score, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1417537321960 AND p.creationdate <= 1375654716473 AND p.favoritecount > 568 AND u.views >= 38585 AND pl.linktypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 26 AND AVG(p.viewcount) > 97922 ORDER BY user_id;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1585638987 AND p.creationdate <= 1405998098 AND v.votetypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 99 AND SUM(v.bountyamount) >= '50' INTERSECT SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.postid) AS history_count, SUM(pl.linktypeid) AS total_link_type, AVG(b.date) AS avg_badge_date FROM users u JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid JOIN postlinks pl ON ph.postid = pl.postid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE ph.creationdate >= 1481252713 AND ph.creationdate <= 1363977675 AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ph.postid) > 19 AND SUM(pl.linktypeid) <= '100' ORDER BY user_id;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_upvotes_received, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_downvotes_received, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, MAX(p.viewcount) AS max_post_views, SUM(p.favoritecount) AS total_favorites, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS total_linked_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) FILTER (WHERE ph.posthistorytypeid = 2) AS total_edits, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.favoritecount) DESC) AS favorite_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid WHERE ( (u.reputation > 159507 AND u.creationdate >= 1332476114284) OR (p.score > 641 AND p.creationdate BETWEEN 1270476236982 AND 1329657791545) OR (c.score > '5' AND c.creationdate >= 1568925641867) OR (v.bountyamount IS NOT NULL AND v.creationdate >= 1489877856891) ) AND NOT (u.views < 33 AND u.upvotes < 103) AND p.posttypeid = 1 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 40 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 28 AND AVG(p.score) < 17 ORDER BY total_posts DESC, total_favorites DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes_received, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, MAX(p.viewcount) AS max_post_views, SUM(p.favoritecount) AS total_favorites, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS linked_posts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) FILTER (WHERE ph.posthistorytypeid = 2) AS edit_history_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.favoritecount) DESC) AS favorite_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid WHERE ( (u.reputation > 583924.81 AND u.creationdate >= 1161877275) OR (p.score > 757.58 AND p.creationdate BETWEEN 1158822781 AND 1300663566) OR (c.score > 165.63 AND c.creationdate >= 1440752706) OR (b.date >= 1261531528) ) AND NOT (u.views < 6215.82 AND u.upvotes < 3846.75) AND p.posttypeid = 1 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 1.27 AND SUM(p.favoritecount) >= 344.63 AND AVG(p.score) BETWEEN 35.84 AND 31.76 ORDER BY total_posts DESC, total_favorites DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_post_views, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty_received, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT c.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY u.reputation / 1000 ORDER BY u.creationdate ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_comments_per_user, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS user_score_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid AND p.posttypeid = 1 LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND v.votetypeid = 9 LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid = 2 LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = 1 LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE u.creationdate >= 1396060818 AND u.reputation > 442698 AND (p.creationdate >= 1200899304 OR p.creationdate IS NULL) AND (v.creationdate >= 1496925537 OR v.creationdate IS NULL) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 305 AND SUM(p.score) > 5583 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, user_score_rank LIMIT 650;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(u.creationdate)) AS user_creation_month, p.posttypeid, DATE_TRUNC('quarter', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_creation_quarter, t.count AS tag_popularity, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(p.score) AS sum_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_view_count, MAX(p.favoritecount) AS max_favorite_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ph.posthistorytypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS edits_count, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_count, SUM(CASE WHEN b.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS badges_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('quarter', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), p.posttypeid ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_rank_by_quarter_type FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid AND b.date >= 1387842013270 LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1486818705678 AND p.score > 993 AND u.reputation BETWEEN 875654 AND 342222 AND (p.answercount > 35 OR p.commentcount > 69) GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (u.id, u.reputation, user_creation_month, p.posttypeid, post_creation_quarter, t.count), (user_creation_month, p.posttypeid, post_creation_quarter), (p.posttypeid, post_creation_quarter), (post_creation_quarter), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 44 AND SUM(p.score) < 67040 ORDER BY post_creation_quarter DESC, total_posts DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, SUM(p.favoritecount) AS total_favorites, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, MAX(p.answercount) AS max_answercount, SUM(p.commentcount) AS total_post_commentcount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS quarterly_post_score_rank FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1527252026653 AND p.creationdate <= 1274755781549 AND p.score > 970 AND p.viewcount > 79574 AND u.reputation > 771272 AND v.votetypeid = '1' AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' AND pl.linktypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 38 AND SUM(p.favoritecount) > 19 ORDER BY post_year DESC, post_quarter DESC, total_post_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, badge_counts.badge_count, comment_counts.comment_count, post_counts.post_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT userid, COUNT(*) AS badge_count FROM badges WHERE date >= 1360607895123 GROUP BY userid ) badge_counts ON u.id = badge_counts.userid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT userid, COUNT(*) AS comment_count FROM comments WHERE creationdate >= 1582144496628 GROUP BY userid ) comment_counts ON u.id = comment_counts.userid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT owneruserid, COUNT(*) AS post_count FROM posts WHERE creationdate >= 1393176660338 AND score > 56 GROUP BY owneruserid ) post_counts ON u.id = post_counts.owneruserid WHERE u.reputation > 72845 AND u.creationdate >= 1580029569219 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, badge_counts.badge_count, comment_counts.comment_count, post_counts.post_count ORDER BY u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, p.creationdate AS post_creation_date, p.score AS post_score, AVG(p.score) OVER ( PARTITION BY p.owneruserid ORDER BY p.creationdate ROWS BETWEEN 8 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_score, COUNT(c.id) AS comment_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid AND c.creationdate >= 1331793400 LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND v.votetypeid = '1' WHERE p.posttypeid = '1' AND p.creationdate BETWEEN 1503570976 AND 1467783638 AND u.reputation > 8785 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, p.creationdate, p.score, p.owneruserid HAVING COUNT(c.id) > 10 ORDER BY moving_avg_score DESC, total_bounty DESC LIMIT 317;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.views, u.upvotes, u.downvotes, badge_counts.badge_count, comment_counts.comment_score_sum, post_counts.post_score_sum FROM users u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT userid, COUNT(*) AS badge_count FROM badges WHERE date >= 1528032205911 GROUP BY userid ) badge_counts ON u.id = badge_counts.userid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT userid, SUM(score) AS comment_score_sum FROM comments WHERE creationdate >= 1528102932916 GROUP BY userid ) comment_counts ON u.id = comment_counts.userid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT owneruserid, SUM(score) AS post_score_sum FROM posts WHERE creationdate >= 1430757285908 AND score > 53 GROUP BY owneruserid ) post_counts ON u.id = post_counts.owneruserid WHERE u.reputation > 47922 AND u.creationdate >= 1339781963325 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.views, u.upvotes, u.downvotes, badge_counts.badge_count, comment_counts.comment_score_sum, post_counts.post_score_sum ORDER BY u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u1.id AS user1_id, u2.id AS user2_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p1.id) AS common_posts, AVG(p1.score) AS avg_score_user1, AVG(p2.score) AS avg_score_user2 FROM users u1 JOIN posts p1 ON u1.id = p1.owneruserid JOIN posts p2 ON p1.posttypeid = p2.posttypeid JOIN users u2 ON p2.owneruserid = u2.id WHERE u1.creationdate >= 1338997506 AND u2.creationdate >= 1292971578 AND p1.score > 62 AND p2.score > 53 GROUP BY u1.id, u2.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p1.id) > 10 AND AVG(p1.score) > 35.74 ORDER BY common_posts DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT u1.id AS user1_id, u2.id AS user2_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p1.id) AS posts_by_user1, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.id) AS posts_by_user2, SUM(CASE WHEN v1.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received_user1, SUM(CASE WHEN v2.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received_user2, AVG(c1.score) AS avg_comment_score_user1, AVG(c2.score) AS avg_comment_score_user2, MAX(p1.viewcount) AS max_viewcount_user1, MAX(p2.viewcount) AS max_viewcount_user2, COUNT(DISTINCT ph1.id) AS post_history_entries_user1, COUNT(DISTINCT ph2.id) AS post_history_entries_user2, SUM(b1.id) AS badge_count_user1, SUM(b2.id) AS badge_count_user2, COUNT(DISTINCT pl1.id) AS postlinks_from_user1_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT pl2.id) AS postlinks_from_user2_posts, (SUM(p1.favoritecount) + SUM(p2.favoritecount)) AS combined_favorite_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (SUM(p1.score) + SUM(p2.score)) DESC) AS combined_score_rank FROM users u1 JOIN users u2 ON u1.creationdate >= 1476669555 AND u2.creationdate >= 1239205886 AND u1.reputation > u2.reputation JOIN posts p1 ON u1.id = p1.owneruserid AND p1.creationdate >= 1388017572 JOIN posts p2 ON u2.id = p2.owneruserid AND p2.creationdate >= 1481139103 JOIN votes v1 ON p1.id = v1.postid AND v1.creationdate >= 1373085256 JOIN votes v2 ON p2.id = v2.postid AND v2.creationdate >= 1591152392 JOIN comments c1 ON p1.id = c1.postid AND c1.creationdate >= 1492011748 JOIN comments c2 ON p2.id = c2.postid AND c2.creationdate >= 1314182012 JOIN posthistory ph1 ON p1.id = ph1.postid AND ph1.creationdate >= 1276183525 JOIN posthistory ph2 ON p2.id = ph2.postid AND ph2.creationdate >= 1380358361 JOIN badges b1 ON u1.id = b1.userid AND b1.date >= 1225276026 JOIN badges b2 ON u2.id = b2.userid AND b2.date >= 1581219037 JOIN postlinks pl1 ON p1.id = pl1.postid AND pl1.creationdate >= 1455264612 JOIN postlinks pl2 ON p2.id = pl2.postid AND pl2.creationdate >= 1582944679 WHERE u1.upvotes > 2124 AND u2.downvotes < 900 GROUP BY u1.id, u2.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p1.id) > 53 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p2.id) > 33 ORDER BY combined_score_rank;

WITH user_activity_summary AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, SUM(p.answercount) AS total_answers, SUM(p.commentcount) AS total_post_comments, SUM(p.favoritecount) AS total_favorites, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1404719889229 OR c.creationdate >= 1305967942961 OR b.date >= 1553126941602 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation ), post_engagement_metrics AS ( SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.owneruserid, p.posttypeid, p.score, p.viewcount, p.answercount, p.commentcount, p.favoritecount, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS history_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS link_count, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score FROM posts p LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid WHERE v.creationdate >= 1364200940828 OR ph.creationdate >= 1510917088449 OR pl.creationdate >= 1317545694107 OR c.creationdate >= 1564600804421 GROUP BY p.id, p.owneruserid, p.posttypeid, p.score, p.viewcount, p.answercount, p.commentcount, p.favoritecount ), tag_popularity AS ( SELECT t.id AS tag_id, t.count AS tag_usage_count, t.excerptpostid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS posts_with_tag, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score_for_tag, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views_for_tag FROM tags t JOIN posts p ON t.excerptpostid = p.id WHERE p.creationdate >= 1474934752074 GROUP BY t.id, t.count, t.excerptpostid HAVING AVG(p.score) > 12 ) SELECT uas.user_id, uas.reputation, uas.post_count, uas.comment_count, uas.badge_count, uas.total_post_score, uas.total_views, uas.total_answers, uas.total_post_comments, uas.total_favorites, pem.post_id, pem.posttypeid, pem.score AS post_score, pem.viewcount AS post_views, pem.answercount AS post_answers, pem.commentcount AS post_comments, pem.favoritecount AS post_favorites, pem.vote_count, pem.history_count, pem.link_count, pem.upvotes, pem.downvotes, pem.avg_comment_score, tp.tag_id, tp.tag_usage_count, tp.posts_with_tag, tp.avg_post_score_for_tag, tp.total_views_for_tag, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY uas.user_id ORDER BY pem.score DESC) AS post_rank_per_user, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY uas.total_post_score DESC) AS user_rank_by_post_score, SUM(pem.vote_count) OVER (PARTITION BY uas.user_id) AS total_votes_by_user, AVG(pem.avg_comment_score) OVER (PARTITION BY tp.tag_id) AS tag_wide_avg_comment_score FROM user_activity_summary uas JOIN post_engagement_metrics pem ON uas.user_id = pem.owneruserid LEFT JOIN tag_popularity tp ON pem.post_id = tp.excerptpostid WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM votes v2 WHERE v2.postid = pem.post_id AND v2.votetypeid IN (1,2,3) AND v2.creationdate >= 1454940333844 ) AND uas.reputation > 886854 AND pem.score > 551 AND (pem.upvotes > 94 OR pem.downvotes > 98) GROUP BY uas.user_id, uas.reputation, uas.post_count, uas.comment_count, uas.badge_count, uas.total_post_score, uas.total_views, uas.total_answers, uas.total_post_comments, uas.total_favorites, uas.latest_post_date, pem.post_id, pem.posttypeid, pem.score, pem.viewcount, pem.answercount, pem.commentcount, pem.favoritecount, pem.vote_count, pem.history_count, pem.link_count, pem.upvotes, pem.downvotes, pem.avg_comment_score, tp.tag_id, tp.tag_usage_count, tp.posts_with_tag, tp.avg_post_score_for_tag, tp.total_views_for_tag HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pem.post_id) > 3 AND AVG(pem.avg_comment_score) < '-10' ORDER BY uas.total_post_score DESC, pem.score DESC, tp.tag_usage_count DESC LIMIT 5527;

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes FROM posts p LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1423253037520 AND p.creationdate <= 1362303693738 AND p.posttypeid = '1' AND p.score > 784 GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) ORDER BY post_year DESC, post_quarter DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1451020045 AND p.score > 85 GROUP BY u.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 27 AND SUM(p.score) > 464 ORDER BY total_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1361736562770 AND p.score > 85 GROUP BY u.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 34 ORDER BY total_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score FROM users u JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE u.reputation > 352929.25 AND b.date >= 1325504598669 AND p.creationdate >= 1439267384440 AND p.id IN (SELECT ph.postid FROM posthistory ph WHERE ph.creationdate >= 1429334048810) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING AVG(c.score) > 40.37 ORDER BY badge_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS link_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, SUM(p.answercount) AS total_answers, SUM(p.commentcount) AS total_post_comments, SUM(p.favoritecount) AS total_favorites, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, MAX(v.bountyamount) AS max_bounty, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid AND b.date >= 1290213282904 LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid AND c.creationdate >= 1420297356540 AND c.score > '1' LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid AND ph.creationdate >= 1605221661497 AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON ph.postid = pl.postid AND pl.creationdate >= 1503412950815 AND pl.linktypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid AND p.creationdate >= 1432776634970 AND p.posttypeid = '1' AND p.score > 572 LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND v.creationdate >= 1531540781865 AND v.votetypeid = '1' WHERE u.reputation > 673577 AND u.creationdate >= 1282733697859 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 295 AND SUM(p.score) > 8760 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1293259992042 AND p.score > 70 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 28 AND AVG(p.score) < 551 ORDER BY post_count DESC, avg_post_score ASC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1574943315015 AND p.score > 53 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM votes v WHERE v.postid = p.id AND v.votetypeid = 2 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 59 ) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 35 ORDER BY avg_post_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1271804221417 AND p.creationdate <= 1537230431649 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM comments c WHERE c.postid = p.id AND c.score > '5') GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 32 ORDER BY post_count DESC, avg_post_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1281623246979 AND p.score > 35 AND p.owneruserid IN ( SELECT userid FROM badges WHERE date >= 1589963742825 GROUP BY userid HAVING COUNT(*) > 9 ) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 12 ORDER BY post_count DESC, avg_post_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1338562142845 AND p.score > 18 AND u.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT v.userid FROM votes v WHERE v.creationdate >= 1461315905744 AND v.votetypeid = '1' ) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 29 ORDER BY avg_post_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1420269181693 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM comments c WHERE c.userid = u.id AND c.creationdate >= 1412719948954) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 23 ORDER BY u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.posttypeid = 1 AND p.creationdate >= 1287374767978 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM comments c WHERE c.postid = p.id AND c.score > '5' ) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 70 ORDER BY avg_post_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_rank FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1489759613225 AND p.score > 29 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 18 ORDER BY post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1439168570333 AND p.creationdate <= 1458820780630 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(u.creationdate)) >= 5 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 53 ORDER BY upvotes_received DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE (p.posttypeid = 1 OR p.posttypeid = 2) AND p.creationdate >= 1580460132634 AND (p.score > 38 OR p.favoritecount > 31) AND NOT (p.answercount = 0 AND p.commentcount = 0) AND u.reputation BETWEEN 86003 AND 68419 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 50 AND AVG(p.score) < 16.76 ORDER BY upvotes_received DESC, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views_per_post, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY u.reputation) AS reputation_percentile, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT c.id), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY u.id ORDER BY MAX(p.creationdate)) AS prev_comment_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid AND p.posttypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid AND c.creationdate BETWEEN 1519489927053 AND 1295610876768 LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid AND b.date >= 1376917473090 LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.votetypeid IN ('1', '1') LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE u.reputation > 253202 AND (p.score > 929 OR p.score IS NULL) AND (c.score >= '0' OR c.score IS NULL) AND (v.bountyamount > '0' OR v.bountyamount IS NULL) AND u.creationdate <= 1527622017336 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 839 AND SUM(p.viewcount) > 44653 AND (COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 267 OR COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) = 0) ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, u.reputation DESC LIMIT 236;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_postlinks, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_posthistory, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answers_per_post, AVG(p.commentcount) AS avg_comments_per_post, AVG(p.favoritecount) AS avg_favorites_per_post, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank, LAG(u.reputation, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY u.id ORDER BY MIN(p.creationdate)) AS prev_reputation, SUM(SUM(p.score)) OVER (PARTITION BY u.reputation / 1000) AS reputation_bucket_total_score FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1422243504134 AND p.creationdate <= 1567702930212 AND u.reputation > 455036 AND p.score > 695 AND v.creationdate >= 1571964599258 AND v.creationdate <= 1468979624444 AND b.date >= 1314546349836 AND b.date <= 1263175626055 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 237 AND SUM(p.score) > 16802 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, total_posts DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.score) AS median_post_score, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.viewcount) AS p75_post_views, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY u.reputation) AS p90_user_reputation FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1295097359893 AND p.creationdate <= 1447104968413 AND u.creationdate >= 1511554538270 AND u.reputation > 998299 AND p.score > 919 AND v.creationdate >= 1482797992341 AND ph.creationdate >= 1336477173267 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 372 AND SUM(p.viewcount) > 249678 AND PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.score) > 611 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, total_views DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(c.score) AS max_comment_score, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS score_rank FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1315585814253 AND p.creationdate <= 1300210072478 AND p.score > 544 AND u.reputation >= 313211 AND v.votetypeid = '1' AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' AND pl.linktypeid = '1' AND b.date >= 1291373695289 AND b.date <= 1593321121526 AND p.id IN (SELECT p2.id FROM posts p2 WHERE p2.answercount > 82 AND p2.favoritecount >= 153 AND p2.owneruserid IN (SELECT u2.id FROM users u2 WHERE u2.upvotes > 4706 AND u2.downvotes < 8970)) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 953 AND SUM(p.score) > 6430 AND AVG(p.viewcount) < 649091 ORDER BY total_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_month, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, AVG(t.count) AS avg_tag_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1467776807 AND p.creationdate <= 1363140645 AND u.reputation > 652626 AND p.score > 60 AND v.creationdate >= 1276632557 AND v.creationdate <= 1541616757 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (u.id, u.reputation, post_month), (u.id, u.reputation), (post_month), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 69 AND SUM(p.viewcount) > 544990 ORDER BY u.reputation DESC, post_month, total_posts DESC;

SELECT u1.id AS user_id, u1.reputation AS user_reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT b1.id) AS badge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c1.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ph1.id) AS post_history_entries, SUM(p1.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p1.viewcount) AS avg_post_views, COUNT(DISTINCT pl1.id) AS post_links_created, COUNT(DISTINCT v1.id) AS votes_cast, SUM(v1.bountyamount) AS total_bounty_given, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.id) AS posts_by_high_rep_users, MAX(u2.reputation) AS max_linked_user_reputation FROM users u1 JOIN badges b1 ON u1.id = b1.userid JOIN comments c1 ON u1.id = c1.userid JOIN posthistory ph1 ON u1.id = ph1.userid JOIN posts p1 ON u1.id = p1.owneruserid JOIN postlinks pl1 ON p1.id = pl1.postid JOIN votes v1 ON u1.id = v1.userid JOIN posts p2 ON pl1.relatedpostid = p2.id JOIN users u2 ON p2.owneruserid = u2.id WHERE u1.creationdate >= 1464679632788 AND u1.reputation > 427620 AND p1.creationdate >= 1452512283113 AND v1.creationdate >= 1403174239760 AND b1.date >= 1445511253665 AND u2.reputation > 146211 AND p1.score > 576 GROUP BY u1.id, u1.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b1.id) > 68 AND SUM(p1.score) > 2218 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ph1.id) > 196 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, badge_count DESC;

WITH user_post_stats AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1454018980 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation ), comment_engagement AS ( SELECT c.userid, COUNT(c.id) AS total_comments, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, SUM(CASE WHEN c.score > '5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_score_comments FROM comments c WHERE c.creationdate >= 1389841042 GROUP BY c.userid ), vote_analysis AS ( SELECT v.userid, COUNT(v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT v.postid) AS distinct_voted_posts FROM votes v WHERE v.creationdate BETWEEN 1270030349 AND 1314211822 GROUP BY v.userid ), badge_summary AS ( SELECT b.userid, COUNT(b.id) AS badge_count, MIN(b.date) AS first_badge_date FROM badges b WHERE b.date <= 1443856590 GROUP BY b.userid ), post_history_agg AS ( SELECT ph.userid, COUNT(ph.id) AS history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.postid) AS affected_posts FROM posthistory ph WHERE ph.creationdate >= 1507302176 GROUP BY ph.userid ) SELECT ups.user_id, ups.reputation, ups.total_posts, ups.total_post_score, ups.avg_viewcount, COALESCE(ce.total_comments, 0) AS total_comments, COALESCE(ce.avg_comment_score, 0) AS avg_comment_score, COALESCE(ce.high_score_comments, 0) AS high_score_comments, COALESCE(va.total_votes, 0) AS total_votes, COALESCE(va.total_bounty, 0) AS total_bounty, COALESCE(va.distinct_voted_posts, 0) AS distinct_voted_posts, COALESCE(bs.badge_count, 0) AS badge_count, COALESCE(pha.history_entries, 0) AS history_entries, COALESCE(pha.affected_posts, 0) AS affected_posts, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ups.total_post_score DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(ce.total_comments, 0) DESC) AS comment_count_rank FROM user_post_stats ups LEFT JOIN comment_engagement ce ON ups.user_id = ce.userid LEFT JOIN vote_analysis va ON ups.user_id = va.userid LEFT JOIN badge_summary bs ON ups.user_id = bs.userid LEFT JOIN post_history_agg pha ON ups.user_id = pha.userid WHERE ups.total_posts > 56 AND ups.reputation >= 46531 AND (COALESCE(ce.total_comments, 0) > 211 OR COALESCE(va.total_votes, 0) > 293) ORDER BY ups.total_post_score DESC, ups.reputation DESC LIMIT 779;

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_quarter, u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answers_per_post, SUM(v.bountyamount) FILTER (WHERE v.votetypeid = 9) AS total_bounty_awarded, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS quarterly_score_rank FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE p.posttypeid = 1 AND p.creationdate >= 1542161530992 AND p.creationdate <= 1395891777929 AND p.score > 798 AND u.reputation >= 657832 GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 13 ORDER BY post_year DESC, post_quarter DESC, total_post_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, COUNT(b.id) AS badge_count FROM users u JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE b.date >= 1356441577939 AND u.reputation > 654060 GROUP BY u.id HAVING COUNT(b.id) > 55 ORDER BY badge_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(c.score) AS max_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS link_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts p2 WHERE p2.owneruserid = u.id AND p2.posttypeid = 1 AND p2.creationdate >= 1358402548512) AS recent_questions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes v2 WHERE v2.userid = u.id AND v2.votetypeid = 2 AND v2.creationdate >= 1294133609345) AS recent_upvotes FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid AND p.posttypeid = 2 LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid AND c.score > '1' LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND (v.votetypeid = 8 OR v.votetypeid = 9) LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid AND b.date >= 1323639290243 LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid IN (2,5) LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = 1 WHERE u.reputation > 22960 AND (u.creationdate <= 1203120944592 OR u.views >= 69246) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM posts p3 WHERE p3.owneruserid = u.id AND p3.favoritecount > 479) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM comments c2 WHERE c2.userid = u.id AND c2.creationdate >= 1529167684822)) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 994 AND SUM(p.score) >= 5819 AND COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) < 63167 ORDER BY total_score DESC, post_count ASC;
