SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_posthistory, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_postlinks, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT c.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY u.reputation ORDER BY u.creationdate ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_comments_per_user FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1523839524059 AND p.score > 447 AND u.reputation >= 561333 AND v.creationdate >= 1481208622240 AND b.date >= 1331414858383 AND ph.creationdate >= 1487378588780 AND pl.creationdate >= 1323214585012 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 60 AND SUM(p.score) > 768 AND AVG(p.viewcount) > 92712 ORDER BY total_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_month, AVG(p.score) OVER (PARTITION BY u.id ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_score_3month_moving, COUNT(p.id) AS post_count FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.score > 70 AND p.creationdate >= 1406343927680 AND v.votetypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), p.score HAVING COUNT(p.id) >= 18 ORDER BY u.reputation DESC, post_month;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, p.creationdate AS post_creation_date, p.score AS post_score, AVG(p.score) OVER ( PARTITION BY p.owneruserid ORDER BY p.creationdate ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_score, COUNT(c.id) AS comment_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid AND c.creationdate >= 1352868412 LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND v.votetypeid = '1' WHERE p.posttypeid = '1' AND p.creationdate BETWEEN 1495174587 AND 1366729170 AND u.reputation > 2973 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, p.creationdate, p.score, p.owneruserid HAVING COUNT(c.id) > 31 ORDER BY moving_avg_score DESC, total_bounty DESC LIMIT 162;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.views, u.upvotes, u.downvotes, badge_counts.badge_count, comment_counts.comment_score_sum, post_counts.post_score_sum FROM users u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT userid, COUNT(*) AS badge_count FROM badges WHERE date >= 1320196539685 GROUP BY userid ) badge_counts ON u.id = badge_counts.userid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT userid, SUM(score) AS comment_score_sum FROM comments WHERE creationdate >= 1593167811048 GROUP BY userid ) comment_counts ON u.id = comment_counts.userid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT owneruserid, SUM(score) AS post_score_sum FROM posts WHERE creationdate >= 1330127661570 AND posttypeid = '1' GROUP BY owneruserid ) post_counts ON u.id = post_counts.owneruserid WHERE u.reputation > 606651 AND u.creationdate >= 1545268239483 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.views, u.upvotes, u.downvotes, badge_counts.badge_count, comment_counts.comment_score_sum, post_counts.post_score_sum ORDER BY u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u1.id AS user1_id, u2.id AS user2_id, COUNT(DISTINCT b1.id) AS badges_user1, COUNT(DISTINCT b2.id) AS badges_user2, AVG(c1.score) AS avg_comment_score_user1, AVG(c2.score) AS avg_comment_score_user2, SUM(p1.score) AS total_post_score_user1, SUM(p2.score) AS total_post_score_user2, COUNT(DISTINCT ph1.id) FILTER (WHERE ph1.posthistorytypeid = '1') AS posthistory_count_user1, COUNT(DISTINCT ph2.id) FILTER (WHERE ph2.posthistorytypeid = '1') AS posthistory_count_user2, SUM(v1.bountyamount) AS total_bounty_user1, SUM(v2.bountyamount) AS total_bounty_user2, MAX(t1.count) AS max_tag_count_user1, MAX(t2.count) AS max_tag_count_user2, COUNT(DISTINCT pl1.id) AS postlinks_count_user1, COUNT(DISTINCT pl2.id) AS postlinks_count_user2, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (SUM(p1.score) + SUM(p2.score)) DESC) AS combined_score_rank FROM users u1 JOIN users u2 ON u1.creationdate >= 1529276844 AND u2.creationdate <= 1531473897 AND u1.id <> u2.id LEFT JOIN badges b1 ON u1.id = b1.userid AND b1.date >= 1991929290 LEFT JOIN badges b2 ON u2.id = b2.userid AND b2.date <= 1177897857 LEFT JOIN comments c1 ON u1.id = c1.userid AND c1.creationdate BETWEEN 1783327346 AND 1658148610 LEFT JOIN comments c2 ON u2.id = c2.userid AND c2.creationdate BETWEEN 1739278913 AND 1529792314 LEFT JOIN posts p1 ON u1.id = p1.owneruserid AND p1.creationdate >= 1824155762 LEFT JOIN posts p2 ON u2.id = p2.owneruserid AND p2.creationdate <= 1188774284 LEFT JOIN posthistory ph1 ON u1.id = ph1.userid AND ph1.creationdate >= 1474339358 LEFT JOIN posthistory ph2 ON u2.id = ph2.userid AND ph2.creationdate <= 1001082212 LEFT JOIN votes v1 ON u1.id = v1.userid AND v1.creationdate BETWEEN 1032749833 AND 1100604347 LEFT JOIN votes v2 ON u2.id = v2.userid AND v2.creationdate BETWEEN 1918007748 AND 1896043198 LEFT JOIN tags t1 ON p1.id = t1.excerptpostid LEFT JOIN tags t2 ON p2.id = t2.excerptpostid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl1 ON p1.id = pl1.postid AND pl1.creationdate >= 1552527017 LEFT JOIN postlinks pl2 ON p2.id = pl2.postid AND pl2.creationdate <= 1790117561 WHERE u1.reputation > 377529 AND u2.reputation < 506499 GROUP BY u1.id, u2.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b1.id) > 68 AND COUNT(DISTINCT b2.id) < 64 ORDER BY combined_score_rank;

SELECT u1.id AS user1_id, u2.id AS user2_id, COUNT(DISTINCT b1.id) AS badges_user1, COUNT(DISTINCT b2.id) AS badges_user2, AVG(c1.score) AS avg_comment_score_user1, AVG(c2.score) AS avg_comment_score_user2, SUM(p1.score) AS total_post_score_user1, SUM(p2.score) AS total_post_score_user2, MAX(v1.bountyamount) AS max_bounty_user1, MAX(v2.bountyamount) AS max_bounty_user2, COUNT(DISTINCT ph1.postid) AS edited_posts_user1, COUNT(DISTINCT ph2.postid) AS edited_posts_user2, SUM(pl1.linktypeid) AS total_linktype_user1, SUM(pl2.linktypeid) AS total_linktype_user2, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (SUM(p1.score) + SUM(p2.score)) DESC) AS combined_score_rank FROM users u1 JOIN users u2 ON u1.creationdate < u2.creationdate AND u1.reputation > 869511.68 AND u2.reputation > 166643.79 LEFT JOIN badges b1 ON u1.id = b1.userid AND b1.date BETWEEN '0' AND '0' LEFT JOIN badges b2 ON u2.id = b2.userid AND b2.date BETWEEN '0' AND '0' LEFT JOIN comments c1 ON u1.id = c1.userid AND c1.creationdate >= '0' LEFT JOIN comments c2 ON u2.id = c2.userid AND c2.creationdate >= '0' LEFT JOIN posts p1 ON u1.id = p1.owneruserid AND p1.posttypeid = 2.63 LEFT JOIN posts p2 ON u2.id = p2.owneruserid AND p2.posttypeid = 4.51 LEFT JOIN votes v1 ON u1.id = v1.userid AND v1.votetypeid = 7.85 LEFT JOIN votes v2 ON u2.id = v2.userid AND v2.votetypeid = 3.62 LEFT JOIN posthistory ph1 ON u1.id = ph1.userid AND ph1.posthistorytypeid = 33.56 LEFT JOIN posthistory ph2 ON u2.id = ph2.userid AND ph2.posthistorytypeid = 31.48 LEFT JOIN postlinks pl1 ON p1.id = pl1.postid AND pl1.linktypeid IN (1.29, 7.2) LEFT JOIN postlinks pl2 ON p2.id = pl2.postid AND pl2.linktypeid IN (8.32, 2.4) WHERE u1.views > 93559.99 AND u2.views > 99946.05 GROUP BY u1.id, u2.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b1.id) + COUNT(DISTINCT b2.id) > 534.22 AND AVG(c1.score) + AVG(c2.score) < 15.57 ORDER BY combined_score_rank, u1.id, u2.id;

SELECT u1.id AS user_id, u1.reputation AS user_reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p1.id) AS posts_created, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.id) AS posts_edited, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty_received, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, MAX(t.count) AS max_tag_popularity FROM users u1 JOIN posts p1 ON u1.id = p1.owneruserid LEFT JOIN posts p2 ON u1.id = p2.lasteditoruserid AND p2.lasteditoruserid IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN votes v ON p1.id = v.postid AND v.votetypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN comments c ON u1.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p1.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN tags t ON p1.id = t.excerptpostid JOIN users u2 ON u1.creationdate < u2.creationdate AND u1.reputation > u2.reputation WHERE u1.creationdate >= 1358868021 AND u1.reputation BETWEEN 545 AND 67043 AND (p1.score > 48 OR p1.viewcount > 6248) GROUP BY u1.id, u1.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p1.id) > 6 AND SUM(v.bountyamount) >= '0' ORDER BY total_bounty_received DESC, user_reputation DESC;

WITH user_activity AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.creationdate AS user_created, u.views AS profile_views, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes_cast, SUM(CASE WHEN p.posttypeid = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS questions_asked, SUM(CASE WHEN p.posttypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answers_given, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, MAX(p.creationdate) AS last_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid WHERE u.reputation >= 92867 AND u.creationdate BETWEEN 1173274240 AND 1472822638 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate, u.views ), post_metrics AS ( SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.owneruserid, p.posttypeid, p.score, p.viewcount, p.answercount, p.commentcount, p.favoritecount, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS edit_history_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS related_links_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes_received, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes, MAX(v.bountyamount) AS max_bounty, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score FROM posts p LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid IN (2,5,8) LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = 1 LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1295946665 AND p.score >= 714 GROUP BY p.id, p.owneruserid, p.posttypeid, p.score, p.viewcount, p.answercount, p.commentcount, p.favoritecount ), tag_analysis AS ( SELECT t.id AS tag_id, t.count AS tag_usage_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS posts_with_tag, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score_for_tag, MAX(p.viewcount) AS max_views_for_tag, SUM(p.favoritecount) AS total_favorites_for_tag FROM tags t JOIN posts p ON t.excerptpostid = p.id WHERE t.count >= 7642 GROUP BY t.id, t.count ), combined_metrics AS ( SELECT ua.user_id, ua.reputation, ua.profile_views, ua.total_posts, ua.total_comments, ua.total_badges, ua.total_votes_cast, ua.questions_asked, ua.answers_given, ua.avg_post_score, COUNT(pm.post_id) AS active_posts, SUM(pm.viewcount) AS total_post_views, SUM(pm.total_votes_received) AS total_votes_on_posts, AVG(pm.avg_comment_score) AS avg_comments_on_posts, SUM(pm.favoritecount) AS total_favorites_received, MAX(pm.max_bounty) AS highest_bounty_received, COUNT(DISTINCT ta.tag_id) AS distinct_tags_used, SUM(ta.tag_usage_count) AS total_tag_usage, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ua.reputation DESC) AS reputation_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ua.total_posts DESC) AS post_count_rank, CASE WHEN ua.reputation >= 10000 THEN 'Expert' WHEN ua.reputation >= 5000 THEN 'Advanced' WHEN ua.reputation >= 1000 THEN 'Intermediate' ELSE 'Beginner' END AS user_level, CASE WHEN ua.total_posts >= 100 THEN 'Very Active' WHEN ua.total_posts >= 50 THEN 'Active' WHEN ua.total_posts >= 10 THEN 'Occasional' ELSE 'Rare' END AS posting_frequency, CASE WHEN ua.avg_post_score >= 10 THEN 'High Quality' WHEN ua.avg_post_score >= 5 THEN 'Good Quality' WHEN ua.avg_post_score >= 0 THEN 'Average' ELSE 'Low Quality' END AS content_quality FROM user_activity ua LEFT JOIN post_metrics pm ON ua.user_id = pm.owneruserid LEFT JOIN tags t ON pm.post_id = t.excerptpostid LEFT JOIN tag_analysis ta ON t.id = ta.tag_id WHERE pm.score >= 38 AND pm.viewcount >= 57170 GROUP BY ua.user_id, ua.reputation, ua.profile_views, ua.total_posts, ua.total_comments, ua.total_badges, ua.total_votes_cast, ua.questions_asked, ua.answers_given, ua.avg_post_score ) SELECT user_level, posting_frequency, content_quality, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS user_count, AVG(reputation) AS avg_reputation, AVG(total_posts) AS avg_posts_per_user, AVG(total_comments) AS avg_comments_per_user, AVG(total_post_views) AS avg_views_per_user, AVG(total_votes_on_posts) AS avg_votes_per_user, SUM(total_favorites_received) AS total_favorites, MAX(highest_bounty_received) AS max_bounty_in_group, AVG(distinct_tags_used) AS avg_tags_per_user, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY reputation) AS median_reputation, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_posts) AS median_posts FROM combined_metrics WHERE reputation_rank <= 5648 AND post_count_rank <= 5357 GROUP BY user_level, posting_frequency, content_quality HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) >= 74 AND AVG(reputation) >= 2187 ORDER BY avg_reputation DESC, user_count DESC;

WITH user_activity AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.creationdate AS user_creation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1407768221621 OR p.creationdate IS NULL GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate ), post_metrics AS ( SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.owneruserid, p.score, p.viewcount, p.answercount, p.commentcount, p.favoritecount, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS edit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS link_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score FROM posts p LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid = 5 LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid WHERE p.posttypeid = 1 GROUP BY p.id, p.owneruserid, p.score, p.viewcount, p.answercount, p.commentcount, p.favoritecount ), tag_popularity AS ( SELECT t.id AS tag_id, t.count AS tag_usage_count, p.owneruserid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS posts_with_tag, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t.count DESC) AS tag_rank FROM tags t JOIN posts p ON t.excerptpostid = p.id WHERE t.count > 6106 GROUP BY t.id, t.count, p.owneruserid ), combined_analysis AS ( SELECT ua.user_id, ua.reputation, ua.post_count, ua.comment_count, ua.badge_count, ua.total_post_score, ua.avg_viewcount, pm.post_id, pm.score AS post_score, pm.viewcount, pm.answercount, pm.commentcount, pm.favoritecount, pm.edit_count, pm.link_count, pm.vote_count, pm.upvotes, pm.downvotes, pm.avg_comment_score, tp.tag_id, tp.tag_usage_count, tp.posts_with_tag, tp.tag_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ua.user_id ORDER BY pm.score DESC) AS post_rank, SUM(pm.score) OVER (PARTITION BY ua.user_id) AS user_total_post_score, AVG(pm.viewcount) OVER (PARTITION BY ua.user_id) AS user_avg_viewcount, COUNT(pm.post_id) OVER (PARTITION BY tp.tag_id) AS tag_user_count FROM user_activity ua JOIN post_metrics pm ON ua.user_id = pm.owneruserid LEFT JOIN tag_popularity tp ON pm.owneruserid = tp.owneruserid WHERE ua.reputation > 13982 AND pm.score > 789 ) SELECT user_id, reputation, post_count, comment_count, badge_count, total_post_score, avg_viewcount, COUNT(DISTINCT post_id) AS distinct_post_count, SUM(post_score) AS sum_post_score, AVG(viewcount) AS avg_post_views, MAX(answercount) AS max_answers, SUM(favoritecount) AS total_favorites, SUM(edit_count) AS total_edits, SUM(link_count) AS total_links, SUM(vote_count) AS total_votes, SUM(upvotes) AS total_upvotes, SUM(downvotes) AS total_downvotes, AVG(avg_comment_score) AS overall_avg_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT tag_id) AS distinct_tags_used, SUM(tag_usage_count) AS total_tag_usage, MIN(tag_rank) AS best_tag_rank, MAX(post_rank) AS worst_post_rank, AVG(user_total_post_score) AS avg_user_total_score, AVG(user_avg_viewcount) AS avg_user_viewcount, SUM(tag_user_count) AS total_tag_user_associations FROM combined_analysis GROUP BY user_id, reputation, post_count, comment_count, badge_count, total_post_score, avg_viewcount HAVING SUM(post_score) > 43293 AND COUNT(DISTINCT post_id) >= 46 ORDER BY sum_post_score DESC, reputation DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH user_post_activity AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views_per_post, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1470743815504 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation ), user_comment_activity AS ( SELECT c.userid, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, MAX(c.creationdate) AS latest_comment_date FROM comments c WHERE c.creationdate >= 1449821511764 GROUP BY c.userid ), user_vote_activity AS ( SELECT v.userid, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, MAX(v.creationdate) AS latest_vote_date FROM votes v WHERE v.creationdate >= 1568212598005 GROUP BY v.userid ), post_history_summary AS ( SELECT ph.userid, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.postid) AS affected_posts FROM posthistory ph WHERE ph.creationdate >= 1425100720614 GROUP BY ph.userid ), badge_summary AS ( SELECT b.userid, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges FROM badges b WHERE b.date >= 1345888027874 GROUP BY b.userid ), post_link_summary AS ( SELECT pl.postid, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_links FROM postlinks pl WHERE pl.creationdate >= 1464755076801 GROUP BY pl.postid ), tag_summary AS ( SELECT t.excerptpostid, t.count AS tag_usage_count FROM tags t WHERE t.count >= 6333 ) SELECT upa.user_id, upa.reputation, upa.total_posts, upa.total_post_score, upa.avg_views_per_post, uca.total_comments, uca.avg_comment_score, uva.total_votes, uva.total_bounty, phs.total_history_entries, phs.affected_posts, bs.total_badges, SUM(pls.total_links) AS total_post_links, AVG(ts.tag_usage_count) AS avg_tag_usage FROM user_post_activity upa LEFT JOIN user_comment_activity uca ON upa.user_id = uca.userid LEFT JOIN user_vote_activity uva ON upa.user_id = uva.userid LEFT JOIN post_history_summary phs ON upa.user_id = phs.userid LEFT JOIN badge_summary bs ON upa.user_id = bs.userid LEFT JOIN posts p ON upa.user_id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN post_link_summary pls ON p.id = pls.postid LEFT JOIN tag_summary ts ON p.id = ts.excerptpostid WHERE upa.reputation >= 282890 GROUP BY upa.user_id, upa.reputation, upa.total_posts, upa.total_post_score, upa.avg_views_per_post, uca.total_comments, uca.avg_comment_score, uva.total_votes, uva.total_bounty, phs.total_history_entries, phs.affected_posts, bs.total_badges HAVING SUM(pls.total_links) > 99 AND AVG(ts.tag_usage_count) < 59197 ORDER BY upa.total_post_score DESC, upa.reputation DESC LIMIT 899;

WITH user_post_stats AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS distinct_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS distinct_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS distinct_votes, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid WHERE u.creationdate >= 1350513097 AND u.reputation > 635248 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation ), post_history_agg AS ( SELECT ph.postid, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.userid) AS distinct_editors, MAX(ph.creationdate) AS last_history_date FROM posthistory ph WHERE ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' GROUP BY ph.postid ), tag_post_links AS ( SELECT t.id AS tag_id, t.count AS tag_usage_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.postid) AS linked_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS related_posts FROM tags t LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON t.excerptpostid = pl.postid OR t.excerptpostid = pl.relatedpostid WHERE t.count >= 5611 GROUP BY t.id, t.count ), badge_activity AS ( SELECT b.userid, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, MIN(b.date) AS first_badge_date, MAX(b.date) AS last_badge_date FROM badges b WHERE b.date BETWEEN 1447925037 AND 1581796350 GROUP BY b.userid ) SELECT ups.user_id, ups.reputation, ups.distinct_posts, ups.distinct_comments, ups.distinct_votes, ups.total_post_score, ups.avg_viewcount, COALESCE(pha.history_entries, 0) AS post_history_entries, COALESCE(pha.distinct_editors, 0) AS post_distinct_editors, COALESCE(tpl.tag_usage_count, 0) AS tag_usage, COALESCE(tpl.linked_posts, 0) AS tag_linked_posts, COALESCE(tpl.related_posts, 0) AS tag_related_posts, COALESCE(ba.badge_count, 0) AS user_badge_count, COALESCE(ba.first_badge_date, 0) AS first_badge_date, COALESCE(ba.last_badge_date, 0) AS last_badge_date, COUNT(DISTINCT pha.postid) AS distinct_posts_with_history, COUNT(DISTINCT tpl.tag_id) AS distinct_tags_linked, SUM(ups.total_post_score * ups.distinct_posts) AS weighted_post_score FROM user_post_stats ups LEFT JOIN post_history_agg pha ON ups.user_id = (SELECT owneruserid FROM posts WHERE id = pha.postid) LEFT JOIN tag_post_links tpl ON ups.user_id = (SELECT owneruserid FROM posts WHERE id IN (tpl.linked_posts, tpl.related_posts)) LEFT JOIN badge_activity ba ON ups.user_id = ba.userid WHERE ups.distinct_posts > 981 AND ups.distinct_comments >= 2829 GROUP BY ups.user_id, ups.reputation, ups.distinct_posts, ups.distinct_comments, ups.distinct_votes, ups.total_post_score, ups.avg_viewcount, pha.history_entries, pha.distinct_editors, tpl.tag_usage_count, tpl.linked_posts, tpl.related_posts, ba.badge_count, ba.first_badge_date, ba.last_badge_date HAVING SUM(ups.total_post_score) > 80163 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pha.postid) >= 42 ORDER BY weighted_post_score DESC, ups.reputation DESC LIMIT 214;

WITH user_post_stats AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1339210400 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation ), comment_engagement AS ( SELECT c.userid, COUNT(c.id) AS total_comments, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, SUM(CASE WHEN c.score > '5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_score_comments FROM comments c WHERE c.creationdate >= 1354659070 GROUP BY c.userid ), vote_analysis AS ( SELECT v.userid, COUNT(v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, AVG(v.votetypeid) AS avg_votetype FROM votes v WHERE v.creationdate >= 1529518785 GROUP BY v.userid ), badge_activity AS ( SELECT b.userid, COUNT(b.id) AS badge_count, MIN(b.date) AS first_badge_date, MAX(b.date) AS last_badge_date FROM badges b WHERE b.date >= 1388447450 GROUP BY b.userid ), post_history_summary AS ( SELECT ph.userid, COUNT(ph.id) AS history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.postid) AS affected_posts FROM posthistory ph WHERE ph.creationdate >= 1595069612 GROUP BY ph.userid ), combined_metrics AS ( SELECT ups.user_id, ups.reputation, ups.total_posts, ups.total_post_score, ups.avg_viewcount, ups.latest_post_date, COALESCE(ce.total_comments, 0) AS total_comments, COALESCE(ce.avg_comment_score, 0) AS avg_comment_score, COALESCE(ce.high_score_comments, 0) AS high_score_comments, COALESCE(va.total_votes, 0) AS total_votes, COALESCE(va.total_bounty, 0) AS total_bounty, COALESCE(va.avg_votetype, 0) AS avg_votetype, COALESCE(ba.badge_count, 0) AS badge_count, COALESCE(ba.first_badge_date, 0) AS first_badge_date, COALESCE(ba.last_badge_date, 0) AS last_badge_date, COALESCE(phs.history_entries, 0) AS history_entries, COALESCE(phs.affected_posts, 0) AS affected_posts, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ups.reputation / 1000 ORDER BY ups.total_post_score DESC) AS rank_by_reputation_bucket FROM user_post_stats ups LEFT JOIN comment_engagement ce ON ups.user_id = ce.userid LEFT JOIN vote_analysis va ON ups.user_id = va.userid LEFT JOIN badge_activity ba ON ups.user_id = ba.userid LEFT JOIN post_history_summary phs ON ups.user_id = phs.userid WHERE ups.total_posts > 14 AND ups.reputation > 45395 ) SELECT cm.user_id, cm.reputation, cm.total_posts, cm.total_post_score, cm.avg_viewcount, cm.total_comments, cm.high_score_comments, cm.total_votes, cm.total_bounty, cm.badge_count, cm.history_entries, cm.affected_posts, cm.rank_by_reputation_bucket, SUM(cm.total_post_score) OVER (PARTITION BY cm.reputation / 1000) AS bucket_total_score, AVG(cm.avg_viewcount) OVER (PARTITION BY cm.reputation / 1000) AS bucket_avg_viewcount, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY cm.reputation / 1000) AS users_in_bucket FROM combined_metrics cm WHERE cm.rank_by_reputation_bucket <= 18 ORDER BY cm.reputation DESC, cm.total_post_score DESC LIMIT 245;

WITH user_post_stats AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(p.creationdate) AS last_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1378639617214 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation ), comment_activity AS ( SELECT c.userid, COUNT(c.id) AS comment_count, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, MIN(c.creationdate) AS first_comment_date FROM comments c WHERE c.creationdate BETWEEN 1592101415284 AND 1548659278537 GROUP BY c.userid ), vote_summary AS ( SELECT v.userid, COUNT(v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM votes v WHERE v.creationdate >= 1519799844991 GROUP BY v.userid ) SELECT ups.user_id, ups.reputation, ups.total_posts, ups.total_score, ups.avg_views, ca.comment_count, ca.avg_comment_score, vs.vote_count, vs.total_bounty, AVG(ups.total_score) OVER ( ORDER BY ups.last_post_date ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_score FROM user_post_stats ups LEFT JOIN comment_activity ca ON ups.user_id = ca.userid LEFT JOIN vote_summary vs ON ups.user_id = vs.userid WHERE ups.total_posts > 80 AND ups.reputation >= 17828 ORDER BY ups.total_score DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH user_post_summary AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1293508490 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation ), comment_activity AS ( SELECT c.userid, COUNT(c.id) AS comment_count, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, MIN(c.creationdate) AS first_comment_date FROM comments c WHERE c.creationdate BETWEEN 1350725743 AND 1436121919 GROUP BY c.userid ), vote_analysis AS ( SELECT v.userid, COUNT(v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT v.postid) AS distinct_voted_posts FROM votes v WHERE v.creationdate >= 1532172307 GROUP BY v.userid ), badge_summary AS ( SELECT b.userid, COUNT(b.id) AS badge_count, MAX(b.date) AS latest_badge_date FROM badges b WHERE b.date <= 1574402119 GROUP BY b.userid ), post_history_agg AS ( SELECT ph.userid, COUNT(ph.id) AS history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.postid) AS affected_posts FROM posthistory ph WHERE ph.creationdate >= 1457988423 GROUP BY ph.userid ), post_link_network AS ( SELECT pl.postid, COUNT(pl.id) AS link_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS unique_related_posts FROM postlinks pl WHERE pl.creationdate BETWEEN 1381416078 AND 1523413334 GROUP BY pl.postid ), tag_popularity AS ( SELECT t.id AS tag_id, t.count AS usage_count, t.excerptpostid FROM tags t WHERE t.count > 1483 ), correlated_subquery AS ( SELECT ups.user_id, ups.reputation, ups.total_posts, ups.total_post_score, ups.avg_viewcount, ca.comment_count, ca.avg_comment_score, va.vote_count, va.total_bounty, bs.badge_count, pha.history_entries, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts p2 WHERE p2.owneruserid = ups.user_id AND p2.creationdate >= 1387754818 AND p2.score > (SELECT AVG(score) FROM posts WHERE creationdate >= 1446910155) ) AS high_score_posts FROM user_post_summary ups LEFT JOIN comment_activity ca ON ups.user_id = ca.userid LEFT JOIN vote_analysis va ON ups.user_id = va.userid LEFT JOIN badge_summary bs ON ups.user_id = bs.userid LEFT JOIN post_history_agg pha ON ups.user_id = pha.userid WHERE ups.total_posts > 47 AND (ca.comment_count IS NULL OR ca.comment_count >= 151) AND (va.vote_count IS NULL OR va.vote_count <= 6052) AND ups.reputation BETWEEN 719939 AND 469667 ) SELECT csq.user_id, csq.reputation, csq.total_posts, csq.total_post_score, csq.avg_viewcount, csq.comment_count, csq.avg_comment_score, csq.vote_count, csq.total_bounty, csq.badge_count, csq.history_entries, csq.high_score_posts, pln.link_count, pln.unique_related_posts, tp.usage_count AS tag_usage, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY csq.total_post_score DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY csq.reputation DESC) AS reputation_rank, LAG(csq.total_posts, 1) OVER (ORDER BY csq.user_id) AS prev_user_posts, SUM(csq.total_bounty) OVER (PARTITION BY csq.reputation / 1000) AS bounty_by_reputation_bucket FROM correlated_subquery csq LEFT JOIN posts p ON csq.user_id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN post_link_network pln ON p.id = pln.postid LEFT JOIN tag_popularity tp ON p.id = tp.excerptpostid WHERE csq.high_score_posts > 6 AND (pln.link_count IS NULL OR pln.link_count < 39) ORDER BY csq.total_post_score DESC, csq.reputation DESC LIMIT 950;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, SUM(CASE WHEN p.posttypeid = 1 THEN p.score ELSE 0 END) AS question_score_sum, SUM(CASE WHEN p.posttypeid = 2 THEN p.score ELSE 0 END) AS answer_score_sum, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1355330355526 AND p.score > 97 AND c.score >= '0' GROUP BY u.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 38 ORDER BY question_score_sum DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COALESCE(agg.total_comments, 0) AS total_comments, COALESCE(agg.avg_post_score, 0) AS avg_post_score FROM users u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c.userid, COUNT(*) AS total_comments, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score FROM comments c JOIN posts p ON c.postid = p.id WHERE p.creationdate >= 1374803662635 AND p.creationdate <= 1590005342008 AND p.score > 82 AND p.id IN ( SELECT ph.postid FROM posthistory ph WHERE ph.creationdate >= 1267014248452 AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' ) GROUP BY c.userid ) agg ON u.id = agg.userid WHERE u.reputation >= 73661 ORDER BY u.reputation DESC, total_comments DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received, AVG(p.score) FILTER (WHERE p.posttypeid = 1) AS avg_question_score, MAX(c.creationdate) AS latest_comment_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid AND b.date BETWEEN 1390154523234 AND 1547532040668 LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid = 2 LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = 1 WHERE u.reputation > 540284 AND (p.creationdate >= 1280196058981 OR p.creationdate IS NULL) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 270 AND SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 37 UNION ALL SELECT p.owneruserid AS user_id, u.reputation, 0 AS badge_count, 0 AS upvotes_received, 0 AS avg_question_score, MAX(c.creationdate) AS latest_comment_date FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.owneruserid = u.id LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND v.votetypeid = 3 WHERE p.posttypeid = 2 AND p.score > 852 AND p.creationdate BETWEEN 1515663351055 AND 1356544130531 GROUP BY p.owneruserid, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) > 398 AND AVG(p.favoritecount) < 22 ORDER BY reputation DESC, user_id;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received, AVG(p.score) FILTER (WHERE p.posttypeid = 1) AS avg_question_score, MAX(c.creationdate) AS latest_comment_date, SUM(pl.linktypeid) AS total_link_type_sum, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.postid) AS distinct_post_history_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY u.reputation DESC) AS reputation_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid AND b.date BETWEEN 1361733590871 AND 1319524719650 LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.creationdate >= 1528624235331 LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid AND c.score > '1' LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid IN ('1', '1') LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' WHERE u.creationdate >= 1472119562129 AND u.views > 263881 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) >= 913 AND SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 948 UNION ALL SELECT p.owneruserid AS user_id, MAX(u.reputation) AS reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS badge_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS upvotes_received, AVG(p2.score) AS avg_question_score, MAX(c2.creationdate) AS latest_comment_date, COUNT(DISTINCT pl2.relatedpostid) AS total_link_type_sum, SUM(ph2.posthistorytypeid) AS distinct_post_history_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) DESC) AS reputation_rank FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.owneruserid = u.id LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid AND t.count > 868 LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND v.votetypeid = 8 LEFT JOIN posts p2 ON u.id = p2.lasteditoruserid AND p2.answercount >= 46 LEFT JOIN comments c2 ON p.id = c2.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl2 ON p.id = pl2.postid AND pl2.creationdate BETWEEN 1385884135191 AND 1330048556209 LEFT JOIN posthistory ph2 ON p.id = ph2.postid AND ph2.userid = u.id WHERE p.posttypeid = 1 AND p.favoritecount > 101 AND p.viewcount >= 700525 GROUP BY p.owneruserid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) < 360 AND SUM(v.bountyamount) BETWEEN '0' AND '0' ORDER BY reputation_rank, upvotes_received DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1313657000557 AND p.score > 32 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM votes v WHERE v.postid = p.id AND v.votetypeid = '1' LIMIT 1 OFFSET 90 ) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 37 ORDER BY avg_post_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1349662265404 AND p.creationdate <= 1564789717508 AND c.score > '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 18 ORDER BY post_count DESC, avg_post_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1435099702575 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM comments c WHERE c.postid = p.id AND c.creationdate >= 1511356424845 ) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 43 ORDER BY post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1516833192405 AND (p.score > 22 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM comments c WHERE c.postid = p.id AND c.score > '1')) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 45 ORDER BY avg_post_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.id IN (SELECT ph.postid FROM posthistory ph WHERE ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' AND ph.creationdate >= 1347134892806) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 1 ORDER BY post_count DESC, avg_post_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_rank FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1393101266781 AND p.score > 85 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 24 ORDER BY post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_rank FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1606159267645 AND p.score > 10 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 27 ORDER BY post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND v.votetypeid = 7 WHERE p.creationdate >= 1551949531596 AND p.creationdate <= 1601899588078 AND p.score > 57 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 38 AND AVG(p.score) >= 20 ORDER BY total_bounty DESC NULLS LAST, post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_view_count, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date, SUM(CASE WHEN ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_history_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS linked_posts_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1563593661610 AND p.creationdate <= 1479608351666 AND u.reputation > 2958 AND (p.score > 63 OR p.score IS NULL) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 9 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 88 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, post_count DESC LIMIT 537;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.score) AS median_post_score, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c.score) AS median_comment_score FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid AND p.creationdate >= 1420193343192 LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid AND c.creationdate >= 1484950344032 LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid AND b.date >= 1580837457067 WHERE u.reputation > 921247 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 51 OR COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 179 ORDER BY u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, MAX(v.creationdate) AS last_vote_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid WHERE u.reputation > 24592 AND u.creationdate >= 1255423008 AND (p.creationdate >= 1025086274 OR p.creationdate IS NULL) AND (c.creationdate >= 1048392780 OR c.creationdate IS NULL) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 20 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 24 AND AVG(p.viewcount) < 30082 INTERSECT SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.postid) AS history_post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.postid) AS link_post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS tag_count, SUM(p.favoritecount) AS total_favorites, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answers, MAX(ph.creationdate) AS last_history_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON u.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE u.reputation > 44458 AND u.creationdate >= 874519233 AND (ph.creationdate >= 919832895 OR ph.creationdate IS NULL) AND (pl.creationdate >= 1538355529 OR pl.creationdate IS NULL) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ph.postid) > 23 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pl.postid) > 2 AND AVG(p.answercount) < 20 ORDER BY user_id;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE ( (u.reputation > 83520 AND u.creationdate >= 1494628084) OR (p.score > 42 AND p.creationdate BETWEEN 1291606065 AND 1407364674) OR (c.score > '2' AND c.creationdate >= 1489771423) ) AND NOT (u.views < 865 AND u.upvotes <= 246) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 41 AND (SUM(v.bountyamount) > '50' OR AVG(p.score) < 1) ORDER BY total_bounty DESC NULLS LAST, post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.score) AS median_post_score, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND v.votetypeid = '1' WHERE p.creationdate >= 1576531644109 AND p.creationdate <= 1343291427061 AND p.posttypeid = 1 AND u.reputation > 91016 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 58 ORDER BY total_bounty DESC NULLS LAST, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, MAX(p.viewcount) AS max_view_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_history_events, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes v2 WHERE v2.userid = u.id AND v2.votetypeid = '1') AS specific_vote_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY u.reputation DESC) AS reputation_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE u.creationdate >= 923738542 AND (p.creationdate >= 1116875740 OR p.creationdate IS NULL) AND (c.creationdate >= 1332569552 OR c.creationdate IS NULL) AND (b.date >= 1154372809 OR b.date IS NULL) AND (v.creationdate >= 1956061925 OR v.creationdate IS NULL) AND (ph.creationdate >= 639454547 OR ph.creationdate IS NULL) AND (pl.creationdate >= 1152565871 OR pl.creationdate IS NULL) AND (u.reputation > 13298 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM posts p2 WHERE p2.owneruserid = u.id AND p2.score > 4708)) AND (u.upvotes > 4438 OR u.downvotes < 82704) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 386 AND (SUM(v.bountyamount) > '0' OR AVG(p.score) < 5265) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c2 WHERE c2.userid = u.id AND c2.score > '0') > 311 ORDER BY total_posts DESC, total_bounty DESC LIMIT 626;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(CASE WHEN p.posttypeid = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS question_count, SUM(CASE WHEN p.posttypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answer_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1391056482534 AND p.score > 96 AND v.votetypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 34 ORDER BY total_posts DESC, avg_post_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, MAX(t.count) AS max_tag_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) + SUM(c.score) DESC) AS user_engagement_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.id), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY u.reputation >= 958528 ORDER BY u.creationdate) AS prev_post_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid AND p.posttypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid AND c.creationdate >= 1358245811476 LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid AND b.date BETWEEN 1501257638384 AND 1557559442984 LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.votetypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE u.reputation >= 178022 AND u.creationdate <= 1355902973696 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 533 AND SUM(p.score) + SUM(c.score) >= 76382 ORDER BY user_engagement_rank, total_posts DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY (CASE WHEN u.reputation >= 22621 THEN 'high' ELSE 'low' END) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank_by_reputation_group FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1311012927113 AND p.creationdate <= 1366715593841 AND p.score > 697 AND u.reputation BETWEEN 738160 AND 861462 AND p.viewcount > 62603 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 531 AND SUM(p.score) > 8019 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_month, p.posttypeid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS link_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.posttypeid ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank_by_type FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1549087013005 AND p.creationdate <= 1380823159114 AND u.reputation > 829045 AND p.score > 4285 AND (v.votetypeid = '1' OR v.votetypeid IS NULL) GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (u.id, u.reputation, post_month, p.posttypeid), (u.id, u.reputation), (post_month, p.posttypeid), (post_month), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 271 AND SUM(p.score) > 69147 ORDER BY post_month DESC, total_post_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_month, p.posttypeid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answers, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) FILTER (WHERE ph.posthistorytypeid = '1') AS specific_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) FILTER (WHERE pl.linktypeid = '1') AS specific_link_events, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), p.posttypeid ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND v.votetypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid AND c.creationdate BETWEEN 1533707176480 AND 1320074181198 LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.userid = u.id LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid AND b.date BETWEEN 1427675427958 AND 1431341474314 WHERE p.creationdate >= 1336764888645 AND p.score > 616 AND u.reputation >= 288170 AND (p.posttypeid = '1' OR p.posttypeid = '1') GROUP BY CUBE( u.id, u.reputation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), p.posttypeid ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 96 AND SUM(p.viewcount) >= 31080 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, post_year, post_month, p.posttypeid;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answers_per_post, MAX(p.favoritecount) AS max_favorites, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS quarterly_post_score_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.id), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY u.id ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate))) AS prev_quarter_post_count FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1282419402477 AND p.creationdate <= 1451646534554 AND p.score > 997 AND u.reputation >= 948274 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) = 2010 OR EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) IN (3, 2)) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 42 AND SUM(p.viewcount) > 379014 ORDER BY post_year DESC, post_quarter DESC, total_post_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, badge_counts.badge_count, comment_counts.comment_count, post_counts.post_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT b.userid, COUNT(*) AS badge_count FROM badges b WHERE b.date >= 1400285074436 GROUP BY b.userid ) badge_counts ON u.id = badge_counts.userid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c.userid, COUNT(*) AS comment_count FROM comments c WHERE c.creationdate >= 1372083792711 GROUP BY c.userid ) comment_counts ON u.id = comment_counts.userid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.owneruserid, COUNT(*) AS post_count FROM posts p WHERE p.creationdate >= 1284976281237 GROUP BY p.owneruserid ) post_counts ON u.id = post_counts.owneruserid WHERE u.reputation > 995482 ORDER BY u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, badge_counts.badge_count, comment_counts.comment_count, post_counts.post_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT b.userid, COUNT(*) AS badge_count FROM badges b WHERE b.date >= 1594869159848 GROUP BY b.userid ) badge_counts ON u.id = badge_counts.userid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c.userid, COUNT(*) AS comment_count FROM comments c WHERE c.creationdate >= 1449499790620 GROUP BY c.userid ) comment_counts ON u.id = comment_counts.userid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.owneruserid, COUNT(*) AS post_count FROM posts p WHERE p.creationdate >= 1509119471433 GROUP BY p.owneruserid ) post_counts ON u.id = post_counts.owneruserid WHERE u.reputation > 748811 ORDER BY u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.creationdate AS user_creation, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges b WHERE b.userid = u.id AND b.date >= 1591736823658) AS recent_badges, (SELECT AVG(p.score) FROM posts p WHERE p.owneruserid = u.id AND p.creationdate >= 1279959571456) AS avg_post_score, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM users u LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid AND c.creationdate >= 1360184624583 LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.votetypeid = 7 AND v.creationdate >= 1358158881083 WHERE u.reputation > 714598 AND u.creationdate >= 1317981806080 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 39 OR SUM(v.bountyamount) > '0' ORDER BY u.reputation DESC, total_bounty DESC;
SELECT u.id, COUNT(p.id) AS post_count FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1524696572914 AND p.score > 55 GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY post_count DESC;

WITH user_activity AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.creationdate AS user_creation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, SUM(p.answercount) AS total_answers, SUM(p.commentcount) AS total_post_comments, SUM(p.favoritecount) AS total_favorites, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1408504241 OR p.creationdate IS NULL GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate ), post_metrics AS ( SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.owneruserid, p.posttypeid, p.creationdate, p.score, p.viewcount, p.answercount, p.commentcount, p.favoritecount, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS edit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS link_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score FROM posts p LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid = 5 LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid WHERE p.creationdate BETWEEN 1296280207 AND 1273671076 GROUP BY p.id, p.owneruserid, p.posttypeid, p.creationdate, p.score, p.viewcount, p.answercount, p.commentcount, p.favoritecount ), windowed_ranks AS ( SELECT ua.user_id, ua.reputation, ua.user_creation, ua.post_count, ua.comment_count, ua.badge_count, ua.total_post_score, ua.total_views, ua.total_answers, ua.total_post_comments, ua.total_favorites, ua.avg_post_score, ua.latest_post_date, pm.post_id, pm.posttypeid, pm.creationdate AS post_creation, pm.score AS post_score, pm.viewcount AS post_views, pm.answercount AS post_answers, pm.commentcount AS post_comments, pm.favoritecount AS post_favorites, pm.edit_count, pm.link_count, pm.vote_count, pm.upvotes, pm.downvotes, pm.avg_comment_score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ua.user_id ORDER BY pm.score DESC, pm.viewcount DESC) AS post_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ua.total_post_score DESC, ua.reputation DESC) AS user_rank_by_score, NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY ua.total_views DESC) AS view_decile, LAG(pm.score, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ua.user_id ORDER BY pm.creationdate) AS prev_post_score, LEAD(pm.score, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ua.user_id ORDER BY pm.creationdate) AS next_post_score, SUM(pm.vote_count) OVER (PARTITION BY ua.user_id ORDER BY pm.creationdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_votes, AVG(pm.avg_comment_score) OVER (PARTITION BY ua.user_id) AS user_avg_comment_score FROM user_activity ua INNER JOIN post_metrics pm ON ua.user_id = pm.owneruserid WHERE ua.reputation > 82613 ) SELECT wr.user_id, wr.reputation, wr.user_creation, wr.post_count, wr.comment_count, wr.badge_count, wr.total_post_score, wr.total_views, wr.total_answers, wr.total_post_comments, wr.total_favorites, wr.avg_post_score, wr.latest_post_date, wr.post_id, wr.posttypeid, wr.post_creation, wr.post_score, wr.post_views, wr.post_answers, wr.post_comments, wr.post_favorites, wr.edit_count, wr.link_count, wr.vote_count, wr.upvotes, wr.downvotes, wr.avg_comment_score, wr.post_rank, wr.user_rank_by_score, wr.view_decile, wr.prev_post_score, wr.next_post_score, wr.cumulative_votes, wr.user_avg_comment_score, t.count AS tag_usage_count, t.excerptpostid AS tag_excerpt_post, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_history_events, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 9 THEN v.bountyamount ELSE 0 END) AS total_bounty_amount FROM windowed_ranks wr LEFT JOIN posts p ON wr.post_id = p.id LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON wr.post_id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON wr.post_id = v.postid AND v.votetypeid = 9 WHERE wr.post_rank <= 42 AND wr.post_score > 590 GROUP BY wr.user_id, wr.reputation, wr.user_creation, wr.post_count, wr.comment_count, wr.badge_count, wr.total_post_score, wr.total_views, wr.total_answers, wr.total_post_comments, wr.total_favorites, wr.avg_post_score, wr.latest_post_date, wr.post_id, wr.posttypeid, wr.post_creation, wr.post_score, wr.post_views, wr.post_answers, wr.post_comments, wr.post_favorites, wr.edit_count, wr.link_count, wr.vote_count, wr.upvotes, wr.downvotes, wr.avg_comment_score, wr.post_rank, wr.user_rank_by_score, wr.view_decile, wr.prev_post_score, wr.next_post_score, wr.cumulative_votes, wr.user_avg_comment_score, t.count, t.excerptpostid HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 9 THEN v.bountyamount ELSE 0 END) > '50' OR SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 9 THEN v.bountyamount ELSE 0 END) IS NULL ORDER BY wr.user_rank_by_score, wr.post_rank, wr.post_score DESC LIMIT 9605;

WITH user_activity_summary AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, SUM(p.answercount) AS total_answers, SUM(p.favoritecount) AS total_favorites, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1529070406 OR c.creationdate >= 1604379403 OR b.date >= 1572232612 OR v.creationdate >= 1599759751 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 84 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 49 ), post_network_analysis AS ( SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.owneruserid, p.posttypeid, p.score, p.viewcount, p.answercount, p.favoritecount, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS edit_history_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS link_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, MAX(ph.creationdate) AS last_edit_date FROM posts p LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid IN (2,5,8) LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = 1 LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate BETWEEN 1501439662 AND 1273775246 AND p.score > 21 AND (p.owneruserid IS NOT NULL OR p.lasteditoruserid IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY p.id, p.owneruserid, p.posttypeid, p.score, p.viewcount, p.answercount, p.favoritecount HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) >= 3 AND COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) > 11 ) SELECT 'user_summary' AS result_type, user_id, reputation, post_count, comment_count, badge_count, vote_count, total_post_score, total_views, total_answers, total_favorites, latest_post_date, NULL AS post_id, NULL AS posttypeid, NULL AS post_score, NULL AS post_viewcount, NULL AS edit_history_count, NULL AS link_count, NULL AS post_comment_count, NULL AS post_vote_count, NULL AS upvotes, NULL AS downvotes, NULL AS avg_comment_score FROM user_activity_summary WHERE reputation > 31796 AND total_views > 652811 UNION ALL SELECT 'post_analysis' AS result_type, owneruserid AS user_id, NULL AS reputation, NULL AS post_count, NULL AS comment_count, NULL AS badge_count, NULL AS vote_count, NULL AS total_post_score, NULL AS total_views, NULL AS total_answers, NULL AS total_favorites, NULL AS latest_post_date, post_id, posttypeid, score AS post_score, viewcount AS post_viewcount, edit_history_count, link_count, comment_count AS post_comment_count, vote_count AS post_vote_count, upvotes, downvotes, avg_comment_score FROM post_network_analysis WHERE viewcount > 692289 AND link_count > 8 ORDER BY result_type, user_id DESC, post_id DESC LIMIT 8586 OFFSET 119;

WITH user_post_stats AS ( SELECT p.owneruserid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM posts p WHERE p.posttypeid = 1 GROUP BY p.owneruserid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 89 ), comment_engagement AS ( SELECT c.userid, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, MIN(c.creationdate) AS first_comment_date FROM comments c GROUP BY c.userid HAVING AVG(c.score) > '1' ), vote_analysis AS ( SELECT v.userid, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT v.postid) AS distinct_posts_voted FROM votes v WHERE v.votetypeid IN (1,2,3) GROUP BY v.userid HAVING SUM(v.bountyamount) > '50' ), post_history_trend AS ( SELECT ph1.userid, ph1.postid, COUNT(DISTINCT ph2.id) AS history_entries, MIN(ph2.creationdate) AS first_history_date FROM posthistory ph1 JOIN posthistory ph2 ON ph1.postid = ph2.postid AND ph1.userid = ph2.userid AND ph1.creationdate < ph2.creationdate WHERE ph1.posthistorytypeid = 2 GROUP BY ph1.userid, ph1.postid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ph2.id) > 11 ), badge_achievers AS ( SELECT b1.userid, COUNT(DISTINCT b1.id) AS total_badges, MIN(b2.date) AS earliest_badge_date FROM badges b1 JOIN badges b2 ON b1.userid = b2.userid AND b1.date < b2.date GROUP BY b1.userid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b1.id)
