SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, MAX(b.date) AS latest_badge_date, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, SUM(t.count) AS total_tag_usage, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank, LAG(u.reputation, 1) OVER (ORDER BY u.creationdate) AS prev_user_reputation FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid AND p.posttypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid AND c.score > '0' LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.votetypeid IN ('1', '1') LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid AND b.date BETWEEN 1388061209905 AND 1544948541236 LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE u.reputation >= 762788 AND u.creationdate >= 1354586751262 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM posts p2 WHERE p2.owneruserid = u.id AND p2.score > 173 AND p2.creationdate >= 1581646955291 ORDER BY p2.creationdate DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 221 ) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 849 AND SUM(p.score) >= 964 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) BETWEEN 169 AND 197 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, u.reputation DESC LIMIT 383 OFFSET 19;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received, MAX(sub.max_comment_score) AS max_comment_score_on_post, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ph.postid, COUNT(*) AS history_entries, (SELECT AVG(c.score) FROM comments c WHERE c.postid = ph.postid AND c.creationdate >= 1334213321097 GROUP BY c.postid) AS avg_comment_score_for_post FROM posthistory ph WHERE ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' GROUP BY ph.postid HAVING COUNT(*) > 972 ) AS ph_sub ON p.id = ph_sub.postid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c.postid, MAX(c.score) AS max_comment_score FROM comments c GROUP BY c.postid ) AS sub ON p.id = sub.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1591343830506 AND p.posttypeid = '1' AND u.reputation > 160061 AND (p.favoritecount >= 157 OR p.favoritecount IS NULL) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING SUM(p.score) > 4277 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 790 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.score) AS median_post_score, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes_received, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.viewcount) AS p75_post_views, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY u.reputation) AS p90_user_reputation FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1529748274354 AND p.creationdate <= 1519488176369 AND u.creationdate >= 1569369527577 AND u.creationdate <= 1546848053690 AND p.score > 219 AND u.reputation > 467429 AND p.viewcount > 563084 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 889 AND SUM(p.score) > 8010 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 592 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answer_count, AVG(p.commentcount) AS avg_comment_count, AVG(p.favoritecount) AS avg_favorite_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY (p.posttypeid) ORDER BY SUM(p.viewcount) DESC) AS view_rank_by_post_type, LAG(u.reputation, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY (p.posttypeid) ORDER BY u.creationdate) AS prev_reputation_by_post_type FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1560771934003 AND p.creationdate <= 1605508153039 AND u.reputation > 231099 AND p.score > 5501 AND v.creationdate >= 1279059806724 AND v.creationdate <= 1534666580263 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate, p.posttypeid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 579 AND SUM(p.viewcount) > 718775 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, total_views DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answer_count_per_post, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid AND p.posttypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.votetypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid AND b.date BETWEEN 1280771676339 AND 1378491321758 LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE u.reputation > 203759 AND u.creationdate >= 1313676555345 AND (p.creationdate BETWEEN 1345599958064 AND 1539282440040 OR p.creationdate IS NULL) AND (c.creationdate BETWEEN 1462500081910 AND 1517395470411 OR c.creationdate IS NULL) AND (v.creationdate BETWEEN 1608062729775 AND 1448994255996 OR v.creationdate IS NULL) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 809 AND SUM(p.score) > 2689 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 4851 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, total_views DESC LIMIT 942;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_month, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answers_per_post, MAX(p.favoritecount) AS max_favorites, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes_received, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments_made, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badges_earned, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS post_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS post_links_involved, SUM(t.count) AS total_tag_usage, SUM(p.score) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.id), 0) AS avg_post_score, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS monthly_score_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.id), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY u.id ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate))) AS prev_month_post_count FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid OR p.id = pl.relatedpostid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1534805825880 AND p.creationdate <= 1378594966022 AND p.score > 836 AND u.reputation > 939969 AND DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) >= DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(1511355180985)) - INTERVAL '181 days' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 39 AND SUM(p.viewcount) > 20455 ORDER BY post_month DESC, monthly_score_rank ASC, total_post_score DESC LIMIT 8085;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_month, p.posttypeid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS posts_made, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comments_made, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS votes_received, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, SUM(CASE WHEN ph.posthistorytypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS edit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS linked_posts_count, MAX(b.date) AS latest_badge_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1603278257051 AND p.creationdate <= 1496503144896 AND u.reputation > 442261 AND p.score > 530 AND v.votetypeid = '1' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (u.id, u.reputation, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), p.posttypeid), (u.id, u.reputation, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate))), (u.id, u.reputation), (DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), p.posttypeid), (DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate))), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 42 OR COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) = 0 ORDER BY u.reputation DESC, post_month, p.posttypeid;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answers_per_post, MAX(p.favoritecount) AS max_favorites, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) FILTER (WHERE ph.posthistorytypeid = '1') AS specific_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.votetypeid = '1') AS specific_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badges_earned, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS linked_posts, SUM(t.count) AS total_tag_usage, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS quarterly_post_score_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.id), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY u.id ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate))) AS prev_quarter_posts FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1414534906 AND p.creationdate <= 1548058515 AND p.posttypeid = '1' AND u.reputation > 999008 AND p.score > 6526 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 22 AND SUM(p.viewcount) > 513948 ORDER BY post_year DESC, post_quarter DESC, total_post_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(u.creationdate)) AS user_join_year, p.posttypeid, t.count AS tag_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answers, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1341639953422 AND p.creationdate <= 1421902952979 AND u.reputation > 229140 AND p.score > 362 AND v.creationdate >= 1459146934106 GROUP BY CUBE( u.id, u.reputation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(u.creationdate)), p.posttypeid, t.count ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 100 AND SUM(p.viewcount) > 799895 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, total_views DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.views, u.upvotes, u.downvotes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges b WHERE b.userid = u.id AND b.date >= 1458892727410) AS recent_badge_count, (SELECT AVG(p.score) FROM posts p WHERE p.owneruserid = u.id AND p.creationdate >= 1476010199418) AS avg_post_score, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM users u LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid AND c.creationdate >= 1476299383888 LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.votetypeid = '1' AND v.creationdate >= 1445158896149 WHERE u.reputation > 77461 AND u.creationdate >= 1509635463385 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.views, u.upvotes, u.downvotes HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 225 ORDER BY u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1417296526502 AND p.score > 28 GROUP BY u.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 39 ORDER BY total_score DESC;

SELECT u1.id AS user1_id, u2.id AS user2_id, COUNT(DISTINCT b1.id) AS badges_user1, COUNT(DISTINCT b2.id) AS badges_user2, SUM(CASE WHEN v1.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_user1, SUM(CASE WHEN v2.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_user2, AVG(p1.score) AS avg_post_score_user1, AVG(p2.score) AS avg_post_score_user2, COUNT(DISTINCT ph1.id) FILTER (WHERE ph1.posthistorytypeid = '1') AS specific_history_user1, COUNT(DISTINCT ph2.id) FILTER (WHERE ph2.posthistorytypeid = '1') AS specific_history_user2, MAX(c1.creationdate) AS latest_comment_user1, MAX(c2.creationdate) AS latest_comment_user2, SUM(pl1.linktypeid) AS total_linktype_user1, SUM(pl2.linktypeid) AS total_linktype_user2, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (COUNT(DISTINCT b1.id) + SUM(CASE WHEN v1.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) DESC) AS user1_engagement_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (COUNT(DISTINCT b2.id) + SUM(CASE WHEN v2.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) DESC) AS user2_engagement_rank FROM users u1 JOIN users u2 ON u1.creationdate >= 1464425883959 AND u2.creationdate >= 933012337071 AND u1.id <> u2.id LEFT JOIN badges b1 ON u1.id = b1.userid AND b1.date BETWEEN 1007154135949 AND 676542183669 LEFT JOIN badges b2 ON u2.id = b2.userid AND b2.date BETWEEN 1580690782539 AND 1059829265969 LEFT JOIN votes v1 ON u1.id = v1.userid AND v1.creationdate >= 926927218008 LEFT JOIN votes v2 ON u2.id = v2.userid AND v2.creationdate >= 920132435801 LEFT JOIN posts p1 ON u1.id = p1.owneruserid AND p1.score > 196 LEFT JOIN posts p2 ON u2.id = p2.owneruserid AND p2.score > 282 LEFT JOIN posthistory ph1 ON u1.id = ph1.userid AND ph1.creationdate BETWEEN 1473098069628 AND 1492132572220 LEFT JOIN posthistory ph2 ON u2.id = ph2.userid AND ph2.creationdate BETWEEN 1210595535827 AND 1268557445042 LEFT JOIN comments c1 ON u1.id = c1.userid AND c1.score >= '0' LEFT JOIN comments c2 ON u2.id = c2.userid AND c2.score >= '0' LEFT JOIN postlinks pl1 ON p1.id = pl1.postid AND pl1.linktypeid IN ('1', '1') LEFT JOIN postlinks pl2 ON p2.id = pl2.postid AND pl2.linktypeid IN ('1', '1') WHERE u1.reputation > 501407 AND u2.reputation > 627457 GROUP BY u1.id, u2.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b1.id) > 33 AND COUNT(DISTINCT b2.id) > 15 ORDER BY (COUNT(DISTINCT b1.id) + COUNT(DISTINCT b2.id)) DESC LIMIT 878;

WITH user_activity AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.creationdate AS user_creation, u.views AS user_views, u.upvotes - u.downvotes AS net_votes, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, SUM(CASE WHEN p.posttypeid = 1 THEN p.viewcount ELSE 0 END) AS question_views, SUM(CASE WHEN p.posttypeid = 2 THEN p.score ELSE 0 END) AS answer_scores, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1450462473795 OR p.creationdate IS NULL GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate, u.views, u.upvotes, u.downvotes ), post_metrics AS ( SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.owneruserid, p.posttypeid, p.score, p.viewcount, p.answercount, p.commentcount, p.favoritecount, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS edit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS link_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, MAX(t.count) AS tag_popularity FROM posts p LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid IN (2,5,8) LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = 1 LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate BETWEEN 1262879568128 AND 1511284847668 GROUP BY p.id, p.owneruserid, p.posttypeid, p.score, p.viewcount, p.answercount, p.commentcount, p.favoritecount ), ranked_users AS ( SELECT ua.*, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ua.reputation DESC) AS rep_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ua.post_count DESC) AS post_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ua.comment_count DESC) AS comment_rank, CASE WHEN ua.net_votes > 1000 THEN 'High Influence' WHEN ua.net_votes BETWEEN 100 AND 1000 THEN 'Medium Influence' ELSE 'Low Influence' END AS influence_category, CASE WHEN ua.question_views > 10000 THEN 'Viral Questioner' WHEN ua.answer_scores > 500 THEN 'Top Answerer' WHEN ua.badge_count > 50 THEN 'Badge Collector' ELSE 'Regular Contributor' END AS user_archetype FROM user_activity ua WHERE ua.user_creation <= 1365031687118 ) SELECT ru.user_id, ru.reputation, ru.user_creation, ru.influence_category, ru.user_archetype, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.post_id) AS active_posts, AVG(pm.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(pm.viewcount) AS total_post_views, SUM(pm.answercount) AS total_answers_generated, SUM(pm.commentcount) AS total_comments_received, SUM(pm.favoritecount) AS total_favorites, AVG(pm.edit_count) AS avg_edits_per_post, AVG(pm.link_count) AS avg_links_per_post, AVG(pm.vote_count) AS avg_votes_per_post, AVG(pm.upvotes - pm.downvotes) AS avg_net_votes_per_post, AVG(pm.avg_comment_score) AS avg_comment_score_on_posts, MAX(pm.tag_popularity) AS max_tag_popularity, CASE WHEN SUM(pm.viewcount) > 100000 THEN 'Super High Traffic' WHEN SUM(pm.viewcount) BETWEEN 10000 AND 100000 THEN 'High Traffic' WHEN SUM(pm.viewcount) BETWEEN 1000 AND 10000 THEN 'Medium Traffic' ELSE 'Low Traffic' END AS traffic_category, CASE WHEN AVG(pm.score) > 50 THEN 'Consistently High Quality' WHEN AVG(pm.score) BETWEEN 10 AND 50 THEN 'Good Quality' WHEN AVG(pm.score) BETWEEN 0 AND 10 THEN 'Average Quality' ELSE 'Controversial/Low Quality' END AS quality_category FROM ranked_users ru JOIN post_metrics pm ON ru.user_id = pm.owneruserid WHERE ru.reputation >= 20486 AND pm.score >= 330 AND ru.post_count > 329 GROUP BY ru.user_id, ru.reputation, ru.user_creation, ru.influence_category, ru.user_archetype HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pm.post_id) > 72 AND AVG(pm.score) > 48.66 ORDER BY ru.reputation DESC, total_post_views DESC LIMIT 364;

WITH user_post_stats AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1422417694 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation ), comment_engagement AS ( SELECT c.userid, COUNT(c.id) AS total_comments, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, SUM(CASE WHEN c.score > '5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_score_comments FROM comments c WHERE c.creationdate >= 1607810508 GROUP BY c.userid ), vote_analysis AS ( SELECT v.userid, COUNT(v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT v.postid) AS distinct_voted_posts FROM votes v WHERE v.creationdate BETWEEN 1307749848 AND 1426147916 GROUP BY v.userid ), badge_summary AS ( SELECT b.userid, COUNT(b.id) AS badge_count, MIN(b.date) AS first_badge_date FROM badges b WHERE b.date <= 1342235306 GROUP BY b.userid ), post_history_agg AS ( SELECT ph.userid, COUNT(ph.id) AS history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.postid) AS affected_posts FROM posthistory ph WHERE ph.creationdate >= 1356204109 GROUP BY ph.userid ) SELECT ups.user_id, ups.reputation, ups.total_posts, ups.total_post_score, ups.avg_viewcount, COALESCE(ce.total_comments, 0) AS total_comments, COALESCE(ce.avg_comment_score, 0) AS avg_comment_score, COALESCE(ce.high_score_comments, 0) AS high_score_comments, COALESCE(va.total_votes, 0) AS total_votes, COALESCE(va.total_bounty, 0) AS total_bounty, COALESCE(va.distinct_voted_posts, 0) AS distinct_voted_posts, COALESCE(bs.badge_count, 0) AS badge_count, COALESCE(pha.history_entries, 0) AS history_entries, COALESCE(pha.affected_posts, 0) AS affected_posts, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ups.total_post_score DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(ce.total_comments, 0) DESC) AS comment_count_rank FROM user_post_stats ups SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posthistory ph WHERE ph.userid = u.id AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1') AS specific_history_actions FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE u.creationdate >= 1257480731 AND u.reputation > 217 AND (p.creationdate IS NULL OR p.creationdate <= 1543776339) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 24 AND AVG(p.score) < 57 ORDER BY u.reputation DESC, post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1352332073 OR c.creationdate >= 1493738031 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 10 AND AVG(p.viewcount) < 5944 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1530815996602 AND p.score > 85 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 4 ORDER BY total_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(p.favoritecount) AS max_favorites, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS link_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) + SUM(c.score) DESC) AS user_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.id), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY u.reputation / 100 ORDER BY u.creationdate) AS prev_post_count_same_reputation_bracket FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1317242279140 AND p.creationdate <= 1327534003045 AND u.reputation >= 952684 AND u.reputation <= 220338 AND p.score > 8 AND c.score > '0' AND v.votetypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 87 AND SUM(p.score) > 1211 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 66 ORDER BY total_score DESC, user_rank;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, SUM(p.favoritecount) AS total_favorites, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answers_per_post, MAX(v.bountyamount) AS max_bounty_received, SUM(CASE WHEN ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS unique_linked_posts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes v2 WHERE v2.userid = u.id AND v2.votetypeid = '1') AS user_votes_cast, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) DESC) AS badge_count_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid WHERE u.creationdate >= 1595747289 AND (p.creationdate >= 1588826562 OR p.creationdate IS NULL) AND (c.creationdate >= 1514794235 OR c.creationdate IS NULL) AND (b.date >= 1324740637 OR b.date IS NULL) AND (v.creationdate >= 1534510856 OR v.creationdate IS NULL) AND (ph.creationdate >= 1553187256 OR ph.creationdate IS NULL) AND (pl.creationdate >= 1278579409 OR pl.creationdate IS NULL) AND u.reputation > 610356 AND p.score > 6189 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 97 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 3698 AND SUM(p.viewcount) > 326530 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, total_views DESC LIMIT 659;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_post_views, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answers_per_post, MAX(p.favoritecount) AS max_favorites_on_post, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) FILTER (WHERE ph.posthistorytypeid = '1') AS specific_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) FILTER (WHERE pl.linktypeid = '1') AS specific_link_events, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty_awarded, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank, LAG(u.reputation, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY u.id ORDER BY MIN(p.creationdate)) AS prev_reputation FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1307592293105 AND p.creationdate <= 1382853556321 AND p.score > 778 AND p.viewcount > 95338 AND u.reputation >= 873488 AND u.views > 27858 AND v.creationdate >= 1362860021184 AND v.creationdate <= 1457162977642 AND b.date >= 1304282570797 AND b.date <= 1323400245208 AND p.posttypeid = '1' AND v.votetypeid IN ('1', '1') GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 55 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 398 AND SUM(p.score) > 6774 AND SUM(p.viewcount) > 216198 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, total_post_views DESC LIMIT 243;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_month, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_links, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, SUM(t.count) AS total_tag_usage, SUM(p.answercount) AS total_answers, SUM(p.favoritecount) AS total_favorites, SUM(p.commentcount) AS total_post_comments, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.id), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY u.id ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate))) AS prev_month_posts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT p.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY u.id ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_3month_posts FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1394086537743 AND p.creationdate <= 1288995590407 AND p.score > 326 AND u.reputation > 638338 AND v.votetypeid = '1' AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' AND pl.linktypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 43 AND SUM(p.score) > 1503 ORDER BY u.reputation DESC, post_month DESC, total_posts DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.creationdate AS user_creation, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges b WHERE b.userid = u.id AND b.date >= 1315964661314) AS recent_badges, (SELECT AVG(p.score) FROM posts p WHERE p.owneruserid = u.id AND p.creationdate >= 1286431804208) AS avg_post_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE u.reputation > 82332 AND p.creationdate >= 1269246173292 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate HAVING COUNT(p.id) > 65 ORDER BY u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.creationdate AS user_creation, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges b WHERE b.userid = u.id AND b.date >= 1473893191073) AS recent_badge_count, (SELECT AVG(p.score) FROM posts p WHERE p.owneruserid = u.id AND p.creationdate >= 1271167295732) AS avg_post_score, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM users u LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid AND c.creationdate >= 1436885766830 LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.votetypeid = 7 AND v.creationdate >= 1334933111390 WHERE u.reputation BETWEEN 830377 AND 516778 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 260 ORDER BY total_bounty DESC NULLS LAST, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.creationdate AS user_creation, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges b WHERE b.userid = u.id AND b.date >= 1539689028891) AS recent_badges, (SELECT AVG(p.score) FROM posts p WHERE p.owneruserid = u.id AND p.creationdate >= 1344756723409) AS avg_post_score, (SELECT SUM(v.bountyamount) FROM votes v WHERE v.userid = u.id AND v.creationdate >= 1294263088796) AS total_bounty FROM users u WHERE u.reputation > 95906 AND u.creationdate >= 1285144714024 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate ORDER BY u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u1.id AS user1_id, u2.id AS user2_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p1.id) AS posts_by_user1, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.id) AS posts_by_user2, SUM(v1.bountyamount) AS total_bounty_user1, SUM(v2.bountyamount) AS total_bounty_user2, AVG(c1.score) AS avg_comment_score_user1, AVG(c2.score) AS avg_comment_score_user2, MAX(ph1.creationdate) AS latest_posthistory_user1, MAX(ph2.creationdate) AS latest_posthistory_user2, COUNT(DISTINCT pl1.relatedpostid) AS linked_posts_user1, COUNT(DISTINCT pl2.relatedpostid) AS linked_posts_user2, SUM(b1.date) AS badge_date_sum_user1, SUM(b2.date) AS badge_date_sum_user2, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.excerptpostid) AS tag_excerpts_user1, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.excerptpostid) AS tag_excerpts_user2 FROM users u1 JOIN users u2 ON u1.reputation > u2.reputation AND u1.creationdate >= u2.creationdate LEFT JOIN posts p1 ON u1.id = p1.owneruserid LEFT JOIN posts p2 ON u2.id = p2.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v1 ON p1.id = v1.postid LEFT JOIN votes v2 ON p2.id = v2.postid LEFT JOIN comments c1 ON u1.id = c1.userid LEFT JOIN comments c2 ON u2.id = c2.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph1 ON u1.id = ph1.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph2 ON u2.id = ph2.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl1 ON p1.id = pl1.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl2 ON p2.id = pl2.postid LEFT JOIN badges b1 ON u1.id = b1.userid LEFT JOIN badges b2 ON u2.id = b2.userid LEFT JOIN tags t1 ON p1.id = t1.excerptpostid LEFT JOIN tags t2 ON p2.id = t2.excerptpostid WHERE u1.views > 27483 AND u2.views < 80851 AND p1.score > 996 AND p2.score < 701 AND v1.creationdate >= 1281704335 AND v2.creationdate <= 1423532015 AND ph1.posthistorytypeid = '1' AND ph2.posthistorytypeid = '1' GROUP BY u1.id, u2.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p1.id) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p2.id) < 75 AND SUM(v1.bountyamount) >= '0' AND SUM(v2.bountyamount) <= '0' ORDER BY u1.id, u2.id LIMIT 424;

WITH user_activity AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.creationdate AS user_created, u.views AS profile_views, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes_cast, SUM(CASE WHEN p.posttypeid = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS questions_asked, SUM(CASE WHEN p.posttypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answers_given, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, MAX(p.creationdate) AS last_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid WHERE u.reputation >= 193581 AND u.creationdate BETWEEN 1161024409 AND 1405003461 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate, u.views ), post_metrics AS ( SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.owneruserid, p.posttypeid, p.score, p.viewcount, p.answercount, p.commentcount, p.favoritecount, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS edit_history_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS related_links_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes_received, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes, MAX(v.bountyamount) AS max_bounty, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score FROM posts p LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid IN (2,5,8) LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = 1 LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1401875775 AND p.score >= 222 GROUP BY p.id, p.owneruserid, p.posttypeid, p.score, p.viewcount, p.answercount, p.commentcount, p.favoritecount ), tag_analysis AS ( SELECT t.id AS tag_id, t.count AS tag_usage_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS posts_with_tag, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score_for_tag, MAX(p.viewcount) AS max_views_for_tag, SUM(p.favoritecount) AS total_favorites_for_tag FROM tags t JOIN posts p ON t.excerptpostid = p.id WHERE t.count >= 227 GROUP BY t.id, t.count ), combined_metrics AS ( SELECT ua.user_id, ua.reputation, ua.profile_views, ua.total_posts, ua.total_comments, ua.total_badges, ua.total_votes_cast, ua.questions_asked, ua.answers_given, ua.avg_post_score, COUNT(pm.post_id) AS active_posts, SUM(pm.viewcount) AS total_post_views, SUM(pm.total_votes_received) AS total_votes_on_posts, AVG(pm.avg_comment_score) AS avg_comments_on_posts, SUM(pm.favoritecount) AS total_favorites_received, MAX(pm.max_bounty) AS highest_bounty_received, COUNT(DISTINCT ta.tag_id) AS distinct_tags_used, SUM(ta.tag_usage_count) AS total_tag_usage, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ua.reputation DESC) AS reputation_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ua.total_posts DESC) AS post_count_rank, CASE WHEN ua.reputation >= 10000 THEN 'Expert' WHEN ua.reputation >= 5000 THEN 'Advanced' WHEN ua.reputation >= 1000 THEN 'Intermediate' ELSE 'Beginner' END AS user_level, CASE WHEN ua.total_posts >= 100 THEN 'Very Active' WHEN ua.total_posts >= 50 THEN 'Active' WHEN ua.total_posts >= 10 THEN 'Occasional' ELSE 'Rare' END AS posting_frequency, CASE WHEN ua.avg_post_score >= 10 THEN 'High Quality' WHEN ua.avg_post_score >= 5 THEN 'Good Quality' WHEN ua.avg_post_score >= 0 THEN 'Average' ELSE 'Low Quality' END AS content_quality FROM user_activity ua LEFT JOIN post_metrics pm ON ua.user_id = pm.owneruserid LEFT JOIN tags t ON pm.post_id = t.excerptpostid LEFT JOIN tag_analysis ta ON t.id = ta.tag_id WHERE pm.score >= 3 AND pm.viewcount >= 45739 GROUP BY ua.user_id, ua.reputation, ua.profile_views, ua.total_posts, ua.total_comments, ua.total_badges, ua.total_votes_cast, ua.questions_asked, ua.answers_given, ua.avg_post_score ) SELECT user_level, posting_frequency, content_quality, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS user_count, AVG(reputation) AS avg_reputation, AVG(total_posts) AS avg_posts_per_user, AVG(total_comments) AS avg_comments_per_user, AVG(total_post_views) AS avg_views_per_user, AVG(total_votes_on_posts) AS avg_votes_per_user, SUM(total_favorites_received) AS total_favorites, MAX(highest_bounty_received) AS max_bounty_in_group, AVG(distinct_tags_used) AS avg_tags_per_user, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY reputation) AS median_reputation, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_posts) AS median_posts FROM combined_metrics WHERE reputation_rank <= 7831 AND post_count_rank <= 7431 GROUP BY user_level, posting_frequency, content_quality HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) >= 61 AND AVG(reputation) >= 6581 ORDER BY avg_reputation DESC, user_count DESC;

WITH user_post_stats AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.creationdate AS user_creation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, SUM(p.answercount) AS total_answers_generated, SUM(p.favoritecount) AS total_favorites FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1313630405969 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate ), comment_engagement AS ( SELECT c.userid, COUNT(c.id) AS comment_count, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, MAX(c.creationdate) AS last_comment_date FROM comments c WHERE c.creationdate BETWEEN 1606121769591 AND 1370517806051 GROUP BY c.userid ), vote_analysis AS ( SELECT v.userid, COUNT(v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_given, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM votes v WHERE v.creationdate >= 1440384404646 GROUP BY v.userid ), post_history_trend AS ( SELECT ph.userid, COUNT(ph.id) AS edit_count, MIN(ph.creationdate) AS first_edit_date, MAX(ph.creationdate) AS last_edit_date FROM posthistory ph WHERE ph.posthistorytypeid IN (2,5,8) GROUP BY ph.userid ), badge_activity AS ( SELECT b.userid, COUNT(b.id) AS badge_count, MIN(b.date) AS first_badge_date FROM badges b WHERE b.date <= 1449681652642 GROUP BY b.userid ), linked_post_network AS ( SELECT pl.postid, COUNT(pl.relatedpostid) AS link_count, AVG(p_linked.score) AS avg_linked_score FROM postlinks pl JOIN posts p_linked ON pl.relatedpostid = p_linked.id WHERE pl.linktypeid = 1 GROUP BY pl.postid ) SELECT ups.user_id, ups.reputation, ups.total_posts, ups.total_post_score, ups.avg_views, ups.total_answers_generated, ups.total_favorites, COALESCE(ce.comment_count, 0) AS comment_count, COALESCE(ce.avg_comment_score, 0) AS avg_comment_score, COALESCE(va.total_votes, 0) AS total_votes, COALESCE(va.upvotes_given, 0) AS upvotes_given, COALESCE(va.total_bounty, 0) AS total_bounty, COALESCE(pht.edit_count, 0) AS edit_count, COALESCE(ba.badge_count, 0) AS badge_count, COALESCE(lpn.link_count, 0) AS link_count, COALESCE(lpn.avg_linked_score, 0) AS avg_linked_score, AVG(ups.total_post_score) OVER ( PARTITION BY (ups.reputation / 1000) ORDER BY ups.user_creation ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_post_score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ups.total_posts DESC) AS post_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ups.reputation DESC) AS reputation_rank FROM user_post_stats ups LEFT JOIN comment_engagement ce ON ups.user_id = ce.userid LEFT JOIN vote_analysis va ON ups.user_id = va.userid LEFT JOIN post_history_trend pht ON ups.user_id = pht.userid LEFT JOIN badge_activity ba ON ups.user_id = ba.userid LEFT JOIN posts p ON ups.user_id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN linked_post_network lpn ON p.id = lpn.postid WHERE ups.total_posts > 824 AND ups.reputation BETWEEN 309452 AND 356538 AND (ce.comment_count IS NULL OR ce.comment_count >= 7095) GROUP BY ups.user_id, ups.reputation, ups.total_posts, ups.total_post_score, ups.avg_views, ups.total_answers_generated, ups.total_favorites, ce.comment_count, ce.avg_comment_score, va.total_votes, va.upvotes_given, va.total_bounty, pht.edit_count, ba.badge_count, lpn.link_count, lpn.avg_linked_score, ups.user_creation HAVING SUM(COALESCE(lpn.link_count, 0)) > 1 ORDER BY ups.reputation DESC, ups.total_posts DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS link_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, SUM(p.answercount) AS total_answers, SUM(p.commentcount) AS total_post_comments, SUM(p.favoritecount) AS total_favorites, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, AVG(t.count) AS avg_tag_popularity, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) DESC) AS badge_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid AND b.date >= 1587973385439 LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid AND c.creationdate >= 1525204354016 AND c.score > '1' LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid AND ph.creationdate >= 1289524320715 AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON ph.postid = pl.postid AND pl.creationdate >= 1276353849995 AND pl.linktypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid AND p.creationdate >= 1291833483016 AND p.posttypeid = '1' AND p.score > 395 AND p.viewcount > 40620 LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND v.creationdate >= 1437189689342 AND v.votetypeid = '1' AND v.bountyamount > '0' LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid AND t.count > 921 WHERE u.reputation > 861294 AND u.creationdate >= 1346107395474 AND (u.upvotes > 1297 OR u.downvotes < 674) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) > 52 AND SUM(p.score) > 7228 AND COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) > 715 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, badge_count DESC LIMIT 551;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received, MAX(sub.max_comment_score) AS max_comment_score_on_post, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid = 2 LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = 1 LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid JOIN ( SELECT p2.owneruserid, MAX(c2.score) AS max_comment_score FROM posts p2 JOIN comments c2 ON p2.id = c2.postid WHERE c2.creationdate >= 1550173980671 AND c2.creationdate <= 1535562137179 GROUP BY p2.owneruserid ) sub ON u.id = sub.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1392274277083 AND p.creationdate <= 1287989064785 AND u.reputation > 532795 AND p.posttypeid = 1 AND (p.answercount > 71 OR p.favoritecount > 14) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 42 AND SUM(p.score) > 709 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, u.reputation DESC;

WITH user_post_stats AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1479124562860 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation ), comment_activity AS ( SELECT c.userid, COUNT(c.id) AS comment_count, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score FROM comments c WHERE c.creationdate >= 1499633025380 GROUP BY c.userid ), vote_summary AS ( SELECT v.userid, COUNT(v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_given FROM votes v WHERE v.creationdate >= 1292700778625 GROUP BY v.userid ) SELECT ups.user_id, ups.reputation, ups.total_posts, ups.total_score, ups.avg_views, ca.comment_count, ca.avg_comment_score, vs.total_votes, vs.upvotes_given, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY (ups.total_posts > 0) ORDER BY ups.total_score DESC) AS score_rank, LAG(ups.total_posts, 1) OVER (ORDER BY ups.reputation DESC) AS prev_user_posts FROM user_post_stats ups LEFT JOIN comment_activity ca ON ups.user_id = ca.userid LEFT JOIN vote_summary vs ON ups.user_id = vs.userid WHERE ups.total_posts > 50 OR ca.comment_count > 69 ORDER BY ups.reputation DESC, ups.total_score DESC LIMIT 736;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes_received, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty_received, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, MAX(b.date) AS latest_badge_date, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid WHERE u.creationdate >= 1572281387321 AND u.reputation > 44185 AND (p.creationdate >= 1313102692512 OR p.creationdate IS NULL) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM posts p2 WHERE p2.owneruserid = u.id AND p2.posttypeid = 1 AND p2.answercount > 5 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM votes v2 WHERE v2.userid = u.id AND v2.votetypeid = 2 AND v2.creationdate >= 1266689782433 ) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 65 AND SUM(p.score) > 9996 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) >= 265 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_month, p.posttypeid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answers, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, SUM(t.count) AS total_tag_usage FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid AND p.creationdate >= 1382749811224 AND p.creationdate <= 1484975242781 LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid AND c.creationdate >= 1277988506798 AND c.creationdate <= 1589262266296 LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.creationdate >= 1392639462704 AND v.creationdate <= 1357141991729 LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid AND ph.creationdate >= 1267214861604 AND ph.creationdate <= 1529810019737 LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.creationdate >= 1385288166215 AND pl.creationdate <= 1419737793899 LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid AND b.date >= 1550862048001 AND b.date <= 1390222307293 LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE u.reputation > 403475 GROUP BY CUBE(u.id, u.reputation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), p.posttypeid) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 736 OR COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) IS NULL ORDER BY total_posts DESC, total_views DESC LIMIT 3959;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_quarter, COUNT(p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1293867257181 AND p.creationdate <= 1440342343469 AND p.posttypeid = 1 AND u.reputation > 9382 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, post_year, post_quarter HAVING COUNT(p.id) > 74 ORDER BY post_year DESC, post_quarter DESC, total_score DESC;

WITH user_post_activity AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1433757665015 OR c.creationdate >= 1334089071114 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation ), post_engagement AS ( SELECT ph.postid, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes, MAX(v.creationdate) AS last_vote_date FROM posthistory ph JOIN votes v ON ph.postid = v.postid WHERE ph.posthistorytypeid IN ('1', '11') AND v.creationdate BETWEEN 1269161306164 AND 1844221567258 GROUP BY ph.postid ), tag_popularity AS ( SELECT t.id AS tag_id, t.count AS tag_usage_count, p.owneruserid, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score_for_tag, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS linked_posts_count FROM tags t JOIN posts p ON t.excerptpostid = p.id LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = '1' WHERE t.count > 9349 GROUP BY t.id, t.count, p.owneruserid ), badge_analysis AS ( SELECT b.userid, COUNT(b.id) AS badge_count, MIN(b.date) AS first_badge_date, MAX(b.date) AS last_badge_date FROM badges b WHERE b.date >= 1551940867116 GROUP BY b.userid HAVING COUNT(b.id) > 47 ) SELECT upa.user_id, upa.reputation, upa.post_count, upa.comment_count, upa.total_post_score, upa.avg_viewcount, pe.history_entries, pe.vote_count, pe.upvotes, pe.downvotes, tp.tag_usage_count, tp.avg_post_score_for_tag, tp.linked_posts_count, ba.badge_count, ba.first_badge_date, ba.last_badge_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY upa.total_post_score DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY upa.reputation DESC) AS reputation_rank, SUM(upa.post_count) OVER (PARTITION BY upa.reputation / 714) AS posts_by_reputation_bucket, AVG(pe.vote_count) OVER (ORDER BY upa.latest_post_date RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_votes_rolling FROM user_post_activity upa JOIN post_engagement pe ON upa.user_id = (SELECT owneruserid FROM posts WHERE id = pe.postid) JOIN tag_popularity tp ON upa.user_id = tp.owneruserid JOIN badge_analysis ba ON upa.user_id = ba.userid WHERE upa.reputation > 92887 AND upa.post_count >= 81 AND pe.upvotes > 9 AND tp.tag_usage_count BETWEEN 467 AND 2547 ORDER BY upa.total_post_score DESC, upa.reputation DESC LIMIT 633;

WITH user_post_stats AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(p.creationdate) AS last_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1418510620605 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation ), comment_activity AS ( SELECT c.userid, COUNT(c.id) AS comment_count, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, MIN(c.creationdate) AS first_comment_date FROM comments c WHERE c.creationdate BETWEEN 1579634617864 AND 1267135262031 GROUP BY c.userid ), vote_summary AS ( SELECT v.userid, COUNT(v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM votes v WHERE v.creationdate >= 1368218931409 GROUP BY v.userid ) SELECT ups.user_id, ups.reputation, ups.total_posts, ups.total_score, ups.avg_views, ca.comment_count, ca.avg_comment_score, vs.vote_count, vs.total_bounty, AVG(ups.total_score) OVER ( ORDER BY ups.last_post_date ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_score FROM user_post_stats ups LEFT JOIN comment_activity ca ON ups.user_id = ca.userid LEFT JOIN vote_summary vs ON ups.user_id = vs.userid WHERE ups.total_posts > 83 AND ups.reputation >= 92737 ORDER BY ups.total_score DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, MAX(p.viewcount) AS max_post_views, SUM(p.favoritecount) AS total_favorites, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank, LAG(u.reputation, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY u.id ORDER BY MIN(p.creationdate)) AS prev_reputation FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1464642684125 AND p.creationdate <= 1542595704615 AND u.reputation > 729839 AND p.score > 560 AND c.score > '0' AND v.bountyamount > '0' AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' AND pl.linktypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 945 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 933 AND SUM(p.favoritecount) > 707 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, total_posts DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.score) AS median_post_score, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c.score) AS comment_score_75th_percentile, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, MAX(p.viewcount) AS max_post_views, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.viewcount) AS post_views_90th_percentile FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE u.reputation > 350081 AND u.creationdate >= 1741899614 AND p.creationdate >= 320233913 AND c.creationdate >= 299277909 AND v.creationdate >= 1053255512 AND ph.creationdate >= 1570778222 AND b.date >= 166588710 AND p.score > 315 AND c.score > '0' AND v.bountyamount > '0' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 979 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 339 AND SUM(p.score) > 9368 AND PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.score) > 88 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY (CASE WHEN u.reputation >= 765271.96 THEN 'high' ELSE 'low' END) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank_by_reputation_group FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1522698437359 AND p.creationdate <= 1393828077280 AND u.creationdate >= 1537003845355 AND v.creationdate >= 1469301688064 AND p.score > 664.92 AND u.reputation > 869365.23 AND p.viewcount > 811855.61 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 70.77 AND SUM(p.score) > 7862.99 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, total_views DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, AVG(ph_counts.post_history_count) AS avg_post_history_per_post, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS rank_by_post_score, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.id), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY u.reputation >= 126856 ORDER BY u.creationdate) AS prev_post_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid AND p.posttypeid = 1 AND p.creationdate >= 1513681017896 AND p.creationdate <= 1469183367208 LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid AND c.creationdate >= 1415385176267 AND c.creationdate <= 1446904950493 LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid AND b.date >= 1506156184687 AND b.date <= 1574350286559 LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.votetypeid IN (1,2,3) AND v.creationdate >= 1391014169641 AND v.creationdate <= 1395369113145 LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = 1 AND pl.creationdate >= 1448370548775 AND pl.creationdate <= 1360742512202 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT postid, COUNT(*) AS post_history_count FROM posthistory WHERE posthistorytypeid IN (2,5,10) AND creationdate >= 1515872418827 AND creationdate <= 1545285359873 GROUP BY postid ) ph_counts ON p.id = ph_counts.postid WHERE u.reputation >= 166611 AND u.creationdate >= 1393483757202 AND u.creationdate <= 1425256545687 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 422 AND SUM(p.score) > 4677 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_month, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, AVG(p.score) OVER (PARTITION BY u.id ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '2 months' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_score_rolling_3months, SUM(p.favoritecount) OVER (PARTITION BY u.id ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '2 months' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS total_favorites_rolling_3months, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.votetypeid = '1') AS upvotes_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments_received, (SELECT MAX(ph.creationdate) FROM posthistory ph WHERE ph.postid = p.id AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1') AS last_edit_date FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.posttypeid = '1' AND p.creationdate >= 1595100436 AND u.reputation > 22241 AND p.score > 498 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), p.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 21 ORDER BY total_score DESC, total_views DESC LIMIT 428;
