SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes_received, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, SUM(p.answercount) AS total_answers_generated, SUM(p.favoritecount) AS total_favorites, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS quarterly_post_score_rank FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1275363192223 AND p.creationdate <= 1561437850843 AND p.posttypeid = '1' AND p.score > 472 AND u.reputation >= 626146 AND u.creationdate <= 1247609203006 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 66 AND SUM(p.score) > 2711 ORDER BY post_year DESC, post_quarter DESC, total_post_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answers_per_post, MAX(p.favoritecount) AS max_favorites, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes_received, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_edits, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS quarterly_post_score_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.id), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY u.id ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate))) AS prev_quarter_post_count FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid = 5 LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1589788331805 AND p.creationdate <= 1538095916847 AND p.posttypeid = 1 AND u.reputation > 499579 AND p.score > 378 AND (p.viewcount > 12433 OR p.favoritecount > 730) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 73 AND SUM(p.score) > 6206 ORDER BY post_year DESC, post_quarter DESC, total_post_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, p.posttypeid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1380352898 OR p.creationdate IS NULL GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (u.id, u.reputation, p.posttypeid), (u.id, u.reputation), (p.posttypeid), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 66 ORDER BY u.reputation DESC, post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.views, u.upvotes, u.downvotes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges b WHERE b.userid = u.id AND b.date >= 1317982666776) AS recent_badges, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.userid = u.id AND c.score > '5') AS high_score_comments, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes v WHERE v.userid = u.id AND v.votetypeid = '1') AS specific_votes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posthistory ph WHERE ph.userid = u.id AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1') AS history_actions FROM users u WHERE u.reputation >= 61502 AND u.creationdate <= 1236923016885 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.views, u.upvotes, u.downvotes ORDER BY u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.views, u.upvotes, u.downvotes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges b WHERE b.userid = u.id AND b.date >= 1324783057548) AS recent_badge_count, (SELECT AVG(p.score) FROM posts p WHERE p.owneruserid = u.id AND p.creationdate >= 1374466583175) AS avg_post_score, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty_received FROM users u LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid AND c.creationdate >= 1317231758767 LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.votetypeid = 7 AND v.creationdate >= 1396753540183 WHERE u.reputation > 120987 AND u.creationdate >= 1410200396565 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.views, u.upvotes, u.downvotes HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 35 ORDER BY u.reputation DESC, total_bounty_received DESC;

SELECT u1.id AS user1_id, u2.id AS user2_id, COUNT(DISTINCT b1.id) AS badges_user1, COUNT(DISTINCT b2.id) AS badges_user2, AVG(v1.bountyamount) AS avg_bounty_user1, AVG(v2.bountyamount) AS avg_bounty_user2 FROM users u1 JOIN users u2 ON u1.reputation > u2.reputation LEFT JOIN badges b1 ON u1.id = b1.userid LEFT JOIN badges b2 ON u2.id = b2.userid LEFT JOIN votes v1 ON u1.id = v1.userid LEFT JOIN votes v2 ON u2.id = v2.userid WHERE u1.creationdate >= 1422916820 AND u2.creationdate <= 1380998973 AND u1.upvotes > 194 GROUP BY u1.id, u2.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b1.id) > 22 AND COUNT(DISTINCT b2.id) < 85 ORDER BY u1.reputation DESC, u2.reputation ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT u1.id AS user1_id, u2.id AS user2_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p1.id) AS posts_by_user1, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.id) AS posts_by_user2, SUM(v1.bountyamount) AS total_bounty_user1, SUM(v2.bountyamount) AS total_bounty_user2, AVG(c1.score) AS avg_comment_score_user1, AVG(c2.score) AS avg_comment_score_user2, MAX(ph1.creationdate) AS latest_posthistory_user1, MAX(ph2.creationdate) AS latest_posthistory_user2, COUNT(DISTINCT pl1.relatedpostid) AS linked_posts_user1, COUNT(DISTINCT pl2.relatedpostid) AS linked_posts_user2, SUM(b1.date) AS badge_date_sum_user1, SUM(b2.date) AS badge_date_sum_user2, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.excerptpostid) AS tag_excerpts_user1, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.excerptpostid) AS tag_excerpts_user2 FROM users u1 JOIN users u2 ON u1.reputation > u2.reputation AND u1.creationdate >= u2.creationdate LEFT JOIN posts p1 ON u1.id = p1.owneruserid LEFT JOIN posts p2 ON u2.id = p2.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v1 ON p1.id = v1.postid LEFT JOIN votes v2 ON p2.id = v2.postid LEFT JOIN comments c1 ON u1.id = c1.userid LEFT JOIN comments c2 ON u2.id = c2.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph1 ON u1.id = ph1.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph2 ON u2.id = ph2.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl1 ON p1.id = pl1.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl2 ON p2.id = pl2.postid LEFT JOIN badges b1 ON u1.id = b1.userid LEFT JOIN badges b2 ON u2.id = b2.userid LEFT JOIN tags t1 ON p1.id = t1.excerptpostid LEFT JOIN tags t2 ON p2.id = t2.excerptpostid WHERE u1.views > 30744 AND u2.views < 24905 AND p1.score > 223 AND p2.score < 457 AND v1.creationdate >= 1306181115 AND v2.creationdate <= 1570320463 AND ph1.posthistorytypeid = '1' AND ph2.posthistorytypeid = '1' GROUP BY u1.id, u2.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p1.id) > 66 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p2.id) < 15 AND SUM(v1.bountyamount) >= '0' AND SUM(v2.bountyamount) <= '0' ORDER BY u1.id, u2.id LIMIT 893;

WITH user_activity AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.creationdate AS user_creation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, SUM(p.favoritecount) AS total_favorites, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1333153593726 OR c.creationdate >= 1454186068987 OR b.date >= 1346784045468 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate ), post_metrics AS ( SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.owneruserid, p.creationdate, p.score, p.viewcount, p.answercount, p.commentcount, p.favoritecount, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS edit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS link_count, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score FROM posts p LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid IN (2,5) LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = 1 LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid WHERE p.creationdate BETWEEN 1480625177349 AND 1566303494069 GROUP BY p.id, p.owneruserid, p.creationdate, p.score, p.viewcount, p.answercount, p.commentcount, p.favoritecount ), tag_popularity AS ( SELECT t.id AS tag_id, t.count, t.excerptpostid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS tagged_posts, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_tag_views FROM tags t JOIN posts p ON t.excerptpostid = p.id OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM posts p2 WHERE p2.id = t.excerptpostid AND p2.owneruserid = p.owneruserid ) WHERE t.count > 9279 GROUP BY t.id, t.count, t.excerptpostid ) SELECT ua.user_id, ua.reputation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + ua.user_creation * INTERVAL '1 millisecond') AS join_year, ua.post_count, ua.comment_count, ua.badge_count, ua.total_post_score, ua.total_views, ua.total_favorites, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.post_id) AS active_posts, AVG(pm.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(pm.viewcount) AS total_post_views, SUM(pm.vote_count) AS total_votes_received, SUM(pm.upvotes) AS total_upvotes, SUM(pm.downvotes) AS total_downvotes, MAX(tp.tagged_posts) AS max_tagged_posts, AVG(tp.avg_post_score) AS avg_tag_score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ua.total_post_score DESC) AS score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ua.post_count DESC) AS post_count_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ua.reputation) AS reputation_percentile FROM user_activity ua JOIN post_metrics pm ON ua.user_id = pm.owneruserid LEFT JOIN tag_popularity tp ON pm.post_id = tp.excerptpostid WHERE ua.reputation > 8308 AND ua.latest_post_date >= 1554765610567 AND pm.creationdate >= 1593369312223 GROUP BY ua.user_id, ua.reputation, ua.user_creation, ua.post_count, ua.comment_count, ua.badge_count, ua.total_post_score, ua.total_views, ua.total_favorites HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pm.post_id) > 36 AND AVG(pm.score) >= 14 ORDER BY ua.total_post_score DESC, ua.reputation DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH user_post_stats AS ( SELECT p.owneruserid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views FROM posts p WHERE p.creationdate >= 1323570754 GROUP BY p.owneruserid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 6 ) SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, ups.post_count, ups.total_score, ups.avg_views, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count FROM users u JOIN user_post_stats ups ON u.id = ups.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid AND c.creationdate >= 1299182146 LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.creationdate >= 1373279050 WHERE u.reputation > 3983 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, ups.post_count, ups.total_score, ups.avg_views ORDER BY ups.total_score DESC LIMIT 67;

WITH user_post_stats AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1527390068404 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation ), comment_activity AS ( SELECT c.userid, COUNT(c.id) AS comment_count, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, MIN(c.creationdate) AS first_comment_date, MAX(c.creationdate) AS last_comment_date FROM comments c WHERE c.creationdate BETWEEN 1594267514192 AND 1443304412032 GROUP BY c.userid ), vote_analysis AS ( SELECT v.userid, COUNT(v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_given, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes_given, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM votes v WHERE v.creationdate >= 1561535441749 GROUP BY v.userid ), badge_summary AS ( SELECT b.userid, COUNT(b.id) AS badge_count, MIN(b.date) AS first_badge_date, MAX(b.date) AS last_badge_date FROM badges b WHERE b.date <= 1421942146644 GROUP BY b.userid ), post_history_summary AS ( SELECT ph.userid, COUNT(ph.id) AS history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.postid) AS affected_posts FROM posthistory ph WHERE ph.creationdate >= 1412924724511 AND ph.posthistorytypeid IN ('1', '1') GROUP BY ph.userid ), post_link_network AS ( SELECT pl.postid, COUNT(pl.id) AS link_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS unique_related_posts FROM postlinks pl WHERE pl.creationdate BETWEEN 1299574126726 AND 1504900667279 AND pl.linktypeid = '1' GROUP BY pl.postid ) SELECT ups.user_id, ups.reputation, ups.total_posts, ups.total_post_score, ups.avg_viewcount, ca.comment_count, ca.avg_comment_score, va.total_votes, va.upvotes_given, va.downvotes_given, va.total_bounty, bs.badge_count, phs.history_entries, phs.affected_posts, pln.link_count, pln.unique_related_posts, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ups.total_post_score DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ca.comment_count DESC) AS comment_count_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY va.total_votes DESC) AS vote_percent_rank FROM user_post_stats ups LEFT JOIN comment_activity ca ON ups.user_id = ca.userid LEFT JOIN vote_analysis va ON ups.user_id = va.userid LEFT JOIN badge_summary bs ON ups.user_id = bs.userid LEFT JOIN post_history_summary phs ON ups.user_id = phs.userid LEFT JOIN posts p ON ups.user_id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN post_link_network pln ON p.id = pln.postid WHERE ups.total_posts > 55 AND (ca.comment_count >= 12 OR ca.comment_count IS NULL) AND va.total_votes < 2846 AND bs.badge_count BETWEEN 12 AND 39 GROUP BY ups.user_id, ups.reputation, ups.total_posts, ups.total_post_score, ups.avg_viewcount, ca.comment_count, ca.avg_comment_score, va.total_votes, va.upvotes_given, va.downvotes_given, va.total_bounty, bs.badge_count, phs.history_entries, phs.affected_posts, pln.link_count, pln.unique_related_posts HAVING SUM(pln.link_count) > 2 OR SUM(pln.link_count) IS NULL ORDER BY ups.total_post_score DESC, ca.comment_count DESC LIMIT 827;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views_on_posts, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) DESC) AS badge_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid AND b.date >= 1564365684712 LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid AND c.creationdate >= 1333291272486 LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid AND p.creationdate >= 1498350670181 WHERE u.reputation > 196780 GROUP BY u.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) > 99 AND AVG(c.score) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY badge_count DESC, total_views_on_posts DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1495005381007 AND p.creationdate <= 1272707268686 AND u.reputation > 218807 GROUP BY u.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 16 ORDER BY post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1434426823348 AND p.score > 57 GROUP BY u.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 46 ORDER BY total_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1473559770765 AND p.creationdate <= 1284032558252 AND p.score > 73 GROUP BY u.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 19 ORDER BY total_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(CASE WHEN p.posttypeid = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS question_count, SUM(CASE WHEN p.posttypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answer_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1550101116800 AND p.score > 38 AND v.votetypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 95 ORDER BY total_posts DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COALESCE(avg_comment_score.avg_score, 0) AS avg_comment_score, badge_counts.badge_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c.userid, AVG(c.score) AS avg_score FROM comments c WHERE c.creationdate >= 1601669114269 GROUP BY c.userid ) avg_comment_score ON u.id = avg_comment_score.userid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT b.userid, COUNT(*) AS badge_count FROM badges b WHERE b.date >= ( SELECT MIN(date) FROM badges WHERE userid = b.userid AND date >= 1593343744077 ) GROUP BY b.userid ) badge_counts ON u.id = badge_counts.userid WHERE u.reputation >= 410089 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, avg_comment_score.avg_score, badge_counts.badge_count ORDER BY u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, 0 AS comment_count FROM users u JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE b.date >= 1444292107283 AND u.reputation > 152988 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation UNION ALL SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, 0 AS badge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count FROM users u JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid WHERE c.creationdate >= 1591592807973 AND u.reputation > 829153 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation ORDER BY user_id;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS post_history_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS post_link_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, SUM(p.answercount) AS total_answers, SUM(p.commentcount) AS total_post_comments, SUM(p.favoritecount) AS total_favorites, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, AVG(t.count) AS avg_tag_popularity, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) DESC) AS badge_count_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid AND b.date >= 1540669498436 LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid AND c.creationdate >= 1276716506806 AND c.score > '1' LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid AND ph.creationdate >= 1363943128642 AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON ph.postid = pl.postid AND pl.creationdate >= 1314393735546 AND pl.linktypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid AND p.creationdate >= 1271316264773 AND p.posttypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND v.creationdate >= 1402502160689 AND v.votetypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid AND t.count > 585 WHERE u.reputation > 594585 AND u.creationdate >= 1538333927754 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) > 641 AND SUM(p.score) > 6546 AND COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) > 360 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, badge_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, MAX(b.date) AS latest_badge_date FROM users u JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE b.date >= 1494783840196 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) > 33 UNION ALL SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, MAX(c.creationdate) AS latest_comment_date FROM users u JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid WHERE c.creationdate >= 1452810942914 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 50 ORDER BY reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.posttypeid = 1 AND p.creationdate >= 1404924345843 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM comments c WHERE c.postid = p.id AND c.score > '5' ) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 16 ORDER BY post_count DESC, avg_post_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1371406526624 AND p.creationdate <= 1298366518422 AND p.score > 24 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 7 ORDER BY avg_post_score DESC, post_count DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND v.votetypeid = '1' WHERE p.creationdate >= 1520245306508 AND p.creationdate <= 1288085630319 AND p.posttypeid = '1' AND u.reputation > 81292 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 34 AND AVG(p.score) < 82 ORDER BY total_bounty DESC NULLS LAST, post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.votetypeid = 8 WHERE (u.reputation > 18870 OR u.upvotes > 3433) AND NOT (u.downvotes >= 836 AND u.views < 1395) AND u.creationdate BETWEEN 1419893394 AND 1480340991 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 38 AND AVG(p.score) < 34 ORDER BY total_bounty DESC NULLS LAST, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.score) AS median_post_score, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c.score) AS median_comment_score FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1328000155197 OR c.creationdate >= 1398025512632 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 8 OR COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 37 ORDER BY u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, (SELECT AVG(score) FROM comments c WHERE c.userid = u.id AND c.creationdate >= 1295440233425) AS avg_comment_score_recent FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1564202082735 AND p.score > 27 AND v.votetypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 6 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, (SELECT AVG(score) FROM comments c WHERE c.userid = u.id AND c.creationdate >= 1573708422708) AS avg_comment_score_recent FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1533834233750 AND p.score > 54 AND v.votetypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 29 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC LIMIT 77;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, (SELECT AVG(score) FROM comments c WHERE c.userid = u.id AND c.creationdate >= 1606615788908) AS avg_comment_score_recent FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1529136800219 AND p.score > 616 AND v.votetypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 8 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, MAX(v.bountyamount) AS max_bounty, SUM(t.count) AS total_tag_usage, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS link_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON b.date >= 1590532337614 AND b.date <= 1348418380009 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 49 AND SUM(p.score) > 5239 AND AVG(c.score) < '-10' AND MAX(v.bountyamount) >= '0' AND AS link_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1346068970310 AND p.creationdate <= 1499525224495 AND p.score > 698 AND u.reputation >= 918767 AND v.votetypeid = '1' AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' AND pl.linktypeid = '1' AND b.date >= 1543993054012 AND b.date <= 1326528877191 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 84 AND SUM(p.score) > 3743 AND AVG(c.score) < '-10' AND MAX(v.bountyamount) >= '0' AND SUM(t.count) > 30998 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) >= 152 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) > 84 AND COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) >= 889 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, MAX(c.score) AS max_comment_score, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS linked_posts FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1606956653332 AND p.creationdate <= 1557724736829 AND u.reputation > 560121 AND p.score > 4565 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 991 AND SUM(p.score) > 38785 ORDER BY total_bounty DESC, total_post_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1563834643123 AND p.score > 62 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 20 INTERSECT SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score FROM users u JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid WHERE c.creationdate >= 1354603594011 AND c.score > '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 88 ORDER BY reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS link_count, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date, MIN(u.creationdate) AS user_join_date, (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (TO_TIMESTAMP(MAX(p.creationdate)) - TO_TIMESTAMP(MIN(p.creationdate)))) / 86400.0) AS post_activity_span_days FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1419509478 AND p.creationdate <= 1398110398 AND u.creationdate >= 1523757762 AND u.creationdate <= 1433077634 AND p.score > 169 AND p.viewcount > 62553 AND v.creationdate >= 1415756294 AND v.creationdate <= 1350159688 AND b.date >= 1366926927 AND b.date <= 1514809976 AND ph.creationdate >= 1423827742 AND ph.creationdate <= 1448950747 AND pl.creationdate >= 1426245834 AND pl.creationdate <= 1605832835 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 87 AND SUM(p.score) > 1875 AND AVG(p.viewcount) > 4364 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 72 AND COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) > 922 AND COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) > 3 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) > 99 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) > 64 ORDER BY total_score DESC, post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT c.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY u.id ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_comments_last_3_months, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty_received FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND v.votetypeid = '1' WHERE p.creationdate >= 1398976054173 AND p.creationdate <= 1353355147768 AND p.posttypeid = 1 AND u.reputation > 8998 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 18 ORDER BY total_bounty_received DESC NULLS LAST, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answer_count, MAX(v.bountyamount) AS max_bounty_received, SUM(CASE WHEN ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS linked_posts_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid WHERE u.reputation > 97810 AND p.creationdate >= 1458225241823 AND p.creationdate <= 1449324089396 AND (p.score > 29 OR p.viewcount > 319153) AND v.creationdate >= 1402735727486 AND v.votetypeid IN ('1', '1') AND ph.creationdate BETWEEN 1334185214102 AND 1414385315740 AND pl.linktypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 30 AND SUM(p.score) > 1106 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 28 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, total_posts DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.score) AS median_post_score, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c.score) AS comment_score_75th_percentile, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, MAX(p.viewcount) AS max_post_views, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.viewcount) AS post_views_90th_percentile FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE u.reputation > 257302 AND u.creationdate >= 680733701 AND p.creationdate >= 1841351789 AND c.creationdate >= 1715501353 AND v.creationdate >= 165125246 AND ph.creationdate >= 806237472 AND b.date >= 1039396880 AND p.score > 115 AND c.score > '0' AND v.bountyamount > '0' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 28 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 957 AND SUM(p.score) > 97850 AND PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.score) > 26 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_posthistory, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_postlinks, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY u.reputation / 1000 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_rank_by_reputation_bucket, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.id), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY u.reputation / 1000 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS prev_post_count_in_bucket FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid AND p.posttypeid = 1 AND p.creationdate >= 1405588766039 AND p.creationdate <= 1575170223378 LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid AND c.creationdate >= 1591844208383 AND c.creationdate <= 1352836875287 LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid AND b.date >= 1508883531791 AND b.date <= 1386483701756 LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.creationdate >= 1279535315093 AND v.creationdate <= 1489143061472 LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid AND ph.creationdate >= 1352414367755 AND ph.creationdate <= 1385846084704 LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.creationdate >= 1539711014578 AND pl.creationdate <= 1405435146714 WHERE u.reputation > 565493 AND u.views > 1882 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 765 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 3484 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, total_bounty DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, (SELECT MAX(subq.max_favorite) FROM (SELECT MAX(p2.favoritecount) AS max_favorite FROM posts p2 WHERE p2.owneruserid = u.id GROUP BY p2.posttypeid) subq) AS max_favorite_by_type, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid AND c.creationdate >= 1606665028037 LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.creationdate >= 1446664238659 AND v.votetypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid AND b.date >= 1554781476721 LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE u.reputation >= 995959 AND p.creationdate >= 1504049511493 AND p.posttypeid IN ('1', '1') AND (p.score > 410 OR p.viewcount > 855455) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 159 AND SUM(p.score) > 2983 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, u.reputation DESC LIMIT 112;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received, MAX(sub.max_comment_score) AS max_comment_score_on_post, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS rank_by_post_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid AND b.date >= 1477739674720 LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT postid, MAX(score) AS max_comment_score FROM comments WHERE creationdate >= 1383936289892 GROUP BY postid ) sub ON p.id = sub.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1517835642140 AND p.creationdate <= 1336553554752 AND u.reputation >= 633673 AND p.score > 415 AND (p.viewcount > 31093 OR p.favoritecount > 136) AND p.posttypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 83 AND SUM(p.score) > 5411 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answer_count_per_post, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS user_rank_by_post_score, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.id), 1) OVER (ORDER BY u.creationdate) AS prev_user_post_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE u.reputation > 550058 AND u.creationdate >= 1032827803 AND p.creationdate >= 467853723 AND c.creationdate >= 1543921315 AND v.creationdate >= 1043588387 AND ph.creationdate >= 79086728 AND b.date >= 42532470 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 253 AND SUM(p.score) > 8244 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 3733 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, user_rank_by_post_score;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.views, u.upvotes, u.downvotes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges b WHERE b.userid = u.id AND b.date >= 1518149720650) AS recent_badges, (SELECT AVG(c.score) FROM comments c WHERE c.userid = u.id AND c.creationdate >= 1565628939458) AS avg_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, MAX(p.viewcount) AS max_viewcount FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE u.reputation >= 885927 AND u.creationdate <= 1517898591015 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.views, u.upvotes, u.downvotes HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 320 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC;

WITH user_activity AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.creationdate AS user_created, u.views AS profile_views, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes_cast, SUM(CASE WHEN p.posttypeid = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS questions_asked, SUM(CASE WHEN p.posttypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answers_given, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, MAX(p.creationdate) AS last_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid WHERE u.reputation >= 609010 AND u.creationdate BETWEEN 1537215910 AND 1646209089 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate, u.views ), post_metrics AS ( SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.owneruserid, p.posttypeid, p.score, p.viewcount, p.answercount, p.commentcount, p.favoritecount, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS edit_history_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS related_links_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes_received, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes, MAX(v.bountyamount) AS max_bounty, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score FROM posts p LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid IN (2,5,8) LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = 1 LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1683448697 AND p.score >= 243 GROUP BY p.id, p.owneruserid, p.posttypeid, p.score, p.viewcount, p.answercount, p.commentcount, p.favoritecount ), tag_analysis AS ( SELECT t.id AS tag_id, t.count AS tag_usage_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS posts_with_tag, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score_for_tag, MAX(p.viewcount) AS max_views_for_tag, SUM(p.favoritecount) AS total_favorites_for_tag FROM tags t JOIN posts p ON t.excerptpostid = p.id WHERE t.count >= 6443 GROUP BY t.id, t.count ), combined_metrics AS ( SELECT ua.user_id, ua.reputation, ua.profile_views, ua.total_posts, ua.total_comments, ua.total_badges, ua.total_votes_cast, ua.questions_asked, ua.answers_given, ua.avg_post_score, COUNT(pm.post_id) AS active_posts, SUM(pm.viewcount) AS total_post_views, SUM(pm.total_votes_received) AS total_votes_on_posts, AVG(pm.avg_comment_score) AS avg_comments_on_posts, SUM(pm.favoritecount) AS total_favorites_received, MAX(pm.max_bounty) AS highest_bounty_received, COUNT(DISTINCT ta.tag_id) AS distinct_tags_used, SUM(ta.tag_usage_count) AS total_tag_usage, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ua.reputation DESC) AS reputation_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ua.total_posts DESC) AS post_count_rank, CASE WHEN ua.reputation >= 10000 THEN 'Expert' WHEN ua.reputation >= 5000 THEN 'Advanced' WHEN ua.reputation >= 1000 THEN 'Intermediate' ELSE 'Beginner' END AS user_level, CASE WHEN ua.total_posts >= 100 THEN 'Very Active' WHEN ua.total_posts >= 50 THEN 'Active' WHEN ua.total_posts >= 10 THEN 'Occasional' ELSE 'Rare' END AS posting_frequency, CASE WHEN ua.avg_post_score >= 10 THEN 'High Quality' WHEN ua.avg_post_score >= 5 THEN 'Good Quality' WHEN ua.avg_post_score >= 0 THEN 'Average' ELSE 'Low Quality' END AS content_quality FROM user_activity ua LEFT JOIN post_metrics pm ON ua.user_id = pm.owneruserid LEFT JOIN tags t ON pm.post_id = t.excerptpostid LEFT JOIN tag_analysis ta ON t.id = ta.tag_id WHERE pm.score >= 14 AND pm.viewcount >= 75136 GROUP BY ua.user_id, ua.reputation, ua.profile_views, ua.total_posts, ua.total_comments, ua.total_badges, ua.total_votes_cast, ua.questions_asked, ua.answers_given, ua.avg_post_score ) SELECT user_level, posting_frequency, content_quality, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS user_count, AVG(reputation) AS avg_reputation, AVG(total_posts) AS avg_posts_per_user, AVG(total_comments) AS avg_comments_per_user, AVG(total_post_views) AS avg_views_per_user, AVG(total_votes_on_posts) AS avg_votes_per_user, SUM(total_favorites_received) AS total_favorites, MAX(highest_bounty_received) AS max_bounty_in_group, AVG(distinct_tags_used) AS avg_tags_per_user, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY reputation) AS median_reputation, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_posts) AS median_posts FROM combined_metrics WHERE reputation_rank <= 8393 AND post_count_rank <= 3650 GROUP BY user_level, posting_frequency, content_quality HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) >= 25 AND AVG(reputation) >= 2855 ORDER BY avg_reputation DESC, user_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(c.score) AS max_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1403720857190 AND p.creationdate <= 1579717536467 AND p.score > 74 AND u.reputation >= 64687 AND v.votetypeid = '1' AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' AND pl.linktypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 80 AND SUM(p.score) > 783 AND AVG(p.viewcount) < 88381 INTERSECT SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(c.score) AS max_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1407752748005 AND p.creationdate <= 1522662345427 AND p.score > 56 AND u.reputation >= 86045 AND v.votetypeid = '1' AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' AND pl.linktypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 18 AND SUM(p.score) > 524 AND AVG(p.viewcount) < 37595 ORDER BY total_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS score_rank FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE p.posttypeid = 1 AND p.creationdate >= 1270698021103 AND p.score > 70 AND u.reputation >= 547040 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tags t WHERE t.excerptpostid = p.id AND t.count > 2741 ORDER BY t.count DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 49 ) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 66 AND SUM(p.score) > 1054 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answers_per_post, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE ( u.reputation > 625519 OR u.views > 388510 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM posts p2 WHERE p2.owneruserid = u.id AND p2.score > 5298 AND p2.creationdate >= 1440843448943 ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM votes v2 WHERE v2.userid = u.id AND v2.votetypeid = '1' AND v2.creationdate >= 1548122566015 ) ) AND p.posttypeid = '1' AND p.creationdate BETWEEN 1545976154735 AND 1389949483244 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 294 AND SUM(p.score) > 98571 AND (COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 2904 OR COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) > 511) ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, total_views DESC LIMIT 867;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_post_views, SUM(p.favoritecount) AS total_post_favorites, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_post_answers, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) FILTER (WHERE ph.posthistorytypeid = '1') AS specific_history_actions, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) FILTER (WHERE pl.linktypeid = '1') AS specific_link_actions, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty_awarded, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS rank_by_score, LAG(u.reputation, 1) OVER (ORDER BY u.creationdate) AS prev_user_reputation FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1581347468587 AND p.creationdate <= 1382854329600 AND u.reputation > 456469 AND (p.score > 933 OR p.viewcount > 600936) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 194 AND SUM(p.favoritecount) > 434 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 396 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges b WHERE b.userid = u.id AND b.date >= 1348897617774) AS recent_badges, (SELECT SUM(v.bountyamount) FROM votes v WHERE v.userid = u.id AND v.votetypeid = 7 AND v.creationdate BETWEEN 1537498198265 AND 1369676922390) AS total_bounty_received, MAX(c.creationdate) AS latest_comment_date, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS post_history_entries, (SELECT AVG(sub_p.answercount) FROM posts sub_p WHERE sub_p.owneruserid = u.id AND sub_p.posttypeid = 1 AND sub_p.creationdate >= 1466735613390) AS avg_answer_count_on_questions FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE u.reputation > 551950 AND u.creationdate <= 1532914077767 AND (p.score IS NULL OR p.score > 2958) AND (c.score IS NULL OR c.score >= '0') GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 127 AND SUM(p.viewcount) > 604516 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges b WHERE b.userid = u.id AND b.date >= 1385777765925) AS recent_badges, (SELECT SUM(v.bountyamount) FROM votes v WHERE v.userid = u.id AND v.votetypeid = 7 AND v.creationdate BETWEEN 1366048377977 AND 1391156016548) AS total_bounty_received, MAX(c.creationdate) AS latest_comment_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.id), 1) OVER (ORDER BY u.creationdate) AS prev_user_post_count FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid AND c.score > '1' LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid = 2 LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = 1 LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE u.reputation > 271108 AND p.creationdate >= 1595459960401 AND p.posttypeid = 1 AND p.answercount >= 58 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 434 AND AVG(p.viewcount) < 321738 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, MAX(sub.max_comment_score) AS max_comment_score_per_post, SUM(vote_counts.total_votes) AS total_votes_received FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c.userid, c.postid, MAX(c.score) AS max_comment_score FROM comments c WHERE c.creationdate >= 1486442617998 GROUP BY c.userid, c.postid ) sub ON u.id = sub.userid AND p.id = sub.postid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT v.postid, COUNT(*) AS total_votes FROM votes v WHERE v.votetypeid = '1' GROUP BY v.postid ) vote_counts ON p.id = vote_counts.postid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid WHERE p.creationdate BETWEEN 1402459091484 AND 1407095561926 AND p.posttypeid = '1' AND u.reputation > 162150 AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' AND b.date >= 1441044080253 AND pl.linktypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 659 AND SUM(p.score) >= 6969 ORDER BY total_votes_received DESC, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received, MAX(sub.max_comment_score) AS max_comment_score_on_post, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ph.postid, COUNT(*) AS history_entries, (SELECT AVG(c.score) FROM comments c WHERE c.postid = ph.postid AND c.creationdate >= 1517388434716 GROUP BY c.postid) AS avg_comment_score_for_post FROM posthistory ph WHERE ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' GROUP BY ph.postid HAVING COUNT(*) > 199 ) AS ph_sub ON p.id = ph_sub.postid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c.postid, MAX(c.score) AS max_comment_score FROM comments c GROUP BY c.postid ) AS sub ON p.id = sub.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1539536345719 AND p.posttypeid = '1' AND u.reputation > 705238 AND (p.favoritecount >= 631 OR p.favoritecount IS NULL) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING SUM(p.score) > 652 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 135 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_month, p.posttypeid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answers, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), p.posttypeid ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS score_rank FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND v.votetypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid AND c.score > '0' LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid AND b.date >= 1334428558889 LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1285371992763 AND p.creationdate <= 1392926545090 AND u.reputation >= 890716 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (u.id, u.reputation, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), p.posttypeid), (u.id, u.reputation), (DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), p.posttypeid), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 133 ORDER BY total_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_year, COUNT(p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1525117043744 AND p.creationdate <= 1586397767333 AND p.posttypeid = '1' AND u.reputation > 745990 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (u.id, u.reputation, post_year), (u.id, u.reputation), (post_year), () ) HAVING COUNT(p.id) > 170 ORDER BY u.reputation DESC, post_year ASC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, p.posttypeid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_year, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1318514428 AND p.creationdate <= 1436568801 AND u.reputation > 364626 AND p.score > 282 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (u.id, u.reputation, p.posttypeid, post_year), (u.id, u.reputation), (p.posttypeid, post_year), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 61 ORDER BY total_posts DESC, total_post_score DESC;

WITH user_post_stats AS ( SELECT p.owneruserid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views FROM posts p WHERE p.creationdate >= 1300289563 GROUP BY p.owneruserid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 4 ) SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, ups.post_count, ups.total_score, ups.avg_views, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count FROM users u JOIN user_post_stats ups ON u.id = ups.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid AND c.creationdate >= 1482534287 LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.creationdate >= 1350316689 WHERE u.reputation > 1359 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, ups.post_count, ups.total_score, ups.avg_views ORDER BY ups.total_score DESC LIMIT 18;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1310811964084 AND p.score > 87 AND u.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT v.userid FROM votes v WHERE v.creationdate >= 1421737343551 AND v.votetypeid = '1' ) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 37 ORDER BY avg_post_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND v.votetypeid = '1' WHERE p.creationdate >= 1433681766187 AND p.creationdate <= 1605130948088 AND p.posttypeid = 1 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 50 AND AVG(p.score) >= 4 ORDER BY total_bounty DESC NULLS LAST, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) OVER (PARTITION BY u.id) AS avg_post_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1327758315790 AND p.score > 50 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, p.score ORDER BY post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, MAX(c.score) AS max_comment_score, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) FILTER (WHERE ph.posthistorytypeid = '1') AS specific_history_count FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND v.votetypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE p.posttypeid = '1' AND p.creationdate >= 1442321352048 AND p.creationdate <= 1346024414598 AND u.reputation > 48720 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM posts p2 WHERE p2.owneruserid = u.id AND p2.answercount > 3 AND p2.favoritecount >= 75) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tags t WHERE t.excerptpostid = p.id AND t.count > 2626) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 63 AND SUM(p.score) >= 794 AND AVG(p.viewcount) < 72759 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, post_count ASC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(c.score) AS max_comment_score, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS linked_posts FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1421376908041 AND p.creationdate <= 1343992778335 AND u.reputation > 968881 AND p.score > 3494 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 175 AND SUM(p.score) > 49221 ORDER BY total_bounty DESC, total_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, MAX(p.viewcount) AS max_view_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS linked_posts_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.favoritecount) DESC) AS favorite_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.votetypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid AND ph.creationdate >= 1425003648207 LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE u.reputation > 33259 AND p.creationdate >= 1468952041716 AND (p.score > 874 OR p.viewcount > 57860) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 81 AND SUM(v.bountyamount) > '0' ORDER BY total_posts DESC, total_bounty DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes_received, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1372911854431 AND p.score > 72 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 33 ORDER BY total_posts DESC, reputation DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.score) AS median_post_score, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.viewcount) AS p75_post_views, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes_received, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty_received, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links_involved FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid OR p.id = pl.relatedpostid WHERE u.creationdate >= 1587859908499 AND p.creationdate >= 1306108888123 AND p.score > 40 AND v.creationdate >= 1330905085055 AND b.date >= 1403388964325 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 37 AND AVG(c.score) < '1' AND SUM(v.bountyamount) >= '50' ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(c.score) AS max_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS total_tags FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1590005508216 AND p.creationdate <= 1559902010766 AND p.score > 988 AND u.reputation >= 397502 AND v.creationdate >= 1524051039262 AND v.creationdate <= 1569127470034 AND b.date >= 1330929601274 AND b.date <= 1360816775391 AND ph.creationdate >= 1339888042941 AND ph.creationdate <= 1395431624428 AND pl.creationdate >= 1348668268291 AND pl.creationdate <= 1345300905198 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 389 AND SUM(p.score) > 2282 AND AVG(p.viewcount) > 37774 AND COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) > 3711 AND SUM(v.bountyamount) > '0' ORDER BY total_score DESC, total_posts DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_month, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answers_per_post, MAX(p.favoritecount) AS max_favorites, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments_received, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes_received, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty_received, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS post_edits_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS linked_posts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badges_earned_in_period, SUM(p.commentcount) AS total_comments_on_posts, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.id), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY u.id ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate))) AS prev_month_posts, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS rank_by_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid = 5 LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = 1 LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid AND b.date >= p.creationdate - 2592000000 AND b.date <= p.creationdate WHERE p.posttypeid = 1 AND p.creationdate >= 1539052438756 AND p.creationdate <= 1604179874717 AND u.reputation > 978894 AND p.score > 212 AND p.viewcount > 803289 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 14 AND SUM(p.score) > 1787 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, post_month;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_month, p.posttypeid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answers, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.posttypeid, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS user_rank_by_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1545948380210 AND p.creationdate <= 1376829512471 AND u.reputation >= 389172 AND p.score > 12 AND v.votetypeid = '1' GROUP BY CUBE(u.id, u.reputation, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), p.posttypeid) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 89 AND SUM(p.viewcount) > 10320 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, total_views DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(u.creationdate)) AS user_creation_month, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(SUM(p.score)) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(u.creationdate)) ORDER BY u.reputation ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_score_by_rep FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.score > 84.06 AND u.reputation >= 979.43 AND TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate) >= '2010-01-01' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(u.creationdate)) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 32.97 ORDER BY u.reputation DESC, total_posts DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answers_per_post, MAX(p.favoritecount) AS max_favorites, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes_received, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_edits, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS quarterly_post_score_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.id), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY u.id ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate))) AS prev_quarter_post_count FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid = 5 LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1365547115926 AND p.creationdate <= 1389371743975 AND p.posttypeid = 1 AND u.reputation > 360604 AND p.score > 561 AND (p.viewcount > 97720 OR p.favoritecount > 115) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 87 AND SUM(p.score) > 6983 ORDER BY post_year DESC, post_quarter DESC, total_post_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1478731382440 AND p.owneruserid IN ( SELECT userid FROM badges WHERE date >= 1342718293159 AND userid IN ( SELECT userid FROM comments WHERE creationdate >= 1507154057592 GROUP BY userid HAVING COUNT(*) > 40 ) ) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING AVG(p.score) > 14 ORDER BY post_count DESC;
