SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS post_history_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS post_link_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, (SUM(p.score) + SUM(c.score) + u.reputation + COALESCE(SUM(v.bountyamount), 0)) AS total_engagement_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1344931794834 AND p.creationdate <= 1273335682324 AND c.creationdate >= 1424970090877 AND c.creationdate <= 1526989074520 AND v.creationdate >= 1558793308480 AND v.creationdate <= 1364894254107 AND u.reputation > 977407 AND p.score > 6058 AND c.score > '0' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 709 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 424 AND COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) > 273 AND (SUM(p.score) + SUM(c.score) + u.reputation + COALESCE(SUM(v.bountyamount), 0)) > 4707516.02 ORDER BY total_engagement_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_upvotes_received, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_downvotes_received, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, MAX(p.viewcount) AS max_post_views, SUM(p.favoritecount) AS total_favorites, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS total_linked_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) FILTER (WHERE ph.posthistorytypeid = 2) AS total_edits, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.favoritecount) DESC) AS favorite_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid WHERE ( (u.reputation > 645725 AND u.creationdate >= 1315817726374) OR (p.score > 494 AND p.creationdate BETWEEN 1310631334301 AND 1508700265730) OR (c.score > '5' AND c.creationdate >= 1300888659483) OR (v.bountyamount IS NOT NULL AND v.creationdate >= 1505482060387) ) AND NOT (u.views < 168 AND u.upvotes < 123) AND p.posttypeid = 1 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 27 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 45 AND AVG(p.score) < 15 ORDER BY total_posts DESC, total_favorites DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(CASE WHEN p.posttypeid = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS question_count, SUM(CASE WHEN p.posttypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answer_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvote_count, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvote_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS user_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS user_post_count_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1350533947986 AND p.creationdate <= 1319468834223 AND u.reputation >= 204387 AND p.score > 90 AND v.creationdate >= 1558554079991 AND v.creationdate <= 1587545590353 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 274 AND SUM(p.viewcount) > 26307 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 7464 ORDER BY total_posts DESC, total_views DESC LIMIT 550;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answer_count, AVG(p.commentcount) AS avg_comment_count, AVG(p.favoritecount) AS avg_favorite_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY (p.posttypeid) ORDER BY SUM(p.viewcount) DESC) AS view_rank_by_post_type, LAG(u.reputation, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY (p.posttypeid) ORDER BY u.creationdate) AS prev_reputation_by_post_type FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1526311040064 AND p.creationdate <= 1440915475712 AND u.reputation > 858229 AND p.score > 1360 AND v.creationdate >= 1582973078714 AND v.creationdate <= 1444340583872 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate, p.posttypeid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 762 AND SUM(p.viewcount) > 823997 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, total_views DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answer_count_per_post, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank, LAG(u.reputation, 1) OVER (ORDER BY u.creationdate) AS prev_user_reputation FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1556113344964 AND p.creationdate <= 1336723264622 AND u.reputation > 590051 AND p.score > 488 AND v.creationdate >= 1607858850544 AND v.creationdate <= 1551486246964 AND b.date >= 1266831389128 AND b.date <= 1465330498727 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 73 AND SUM(p.viewcount) > 50373 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 285 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, total_views DESC LIMIT 581;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answer_count_per_post, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS rank_by_post_score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY (u.reputation / 1000) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS row_num_by_reputation_bucket_and_post_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1440047052136 AND p.creationdate <= 1532990439361 AND u.reputation >= 420634 AND u.creationdate >= 1567909309560 AND p.score > 806 AND v.creationdate >= 1320287424258 AND v.votetypeid = '1' AND ph.creationdate >= 1452374212795 AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' AND pl.creationdate >= 1468190045552 AND pl.linktypeid = '1' AND t.count > 6911 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 902 AND SUM(p.viewcount) > 30389 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 156 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, total_views DESC;

WITH user_activity AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.creationdate AS user_creation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, SUM(p.answercount) AS total_answers, SUM(p.favoritecount) AS total_favorites, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1599585051860 OR p.creationdate IS NULL GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate ), post_engagement AS ( SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.owneruserid, p.posttypeid, p.creationdate, p.score, p.viewcount, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS link_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score FROM posts p LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate BETWEEN 1427738891136 AND 1340032280762 GROUP BY p.id, p.owneruserid, p.posttypeid, p.creationdate, p.score, p.viewcount ), tag_popularity AS ( SELECT t.id AS tag_id, t.count AS tag_usage, t.excerptpostid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS tagged_posts, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_tag_views, SUM(p.answercount) AS total_tag_answers FROM tags t JOIN posts p ON t.excerptpostid = p.id WHERE t.count > 7773 GROUP BY t.id, t.count, t.excerptpostid ) SELECT ua.user_id, ua.reputation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + ua.user_creation * INTERVAL '1 millisecond') AS join_year, ua.post_count, ua.comment_count, ua.badge_count, ua.vote_count, ua.total_post_score, ua.total_views, ua.total_answers, ua.total_favorites, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.post_id) AS active_posts, AVG(pe.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(pe.viewcount) AS total_post_views, SUM(pe.upvotes) AS total_upvotes_received, SUM(pe.downvotes) AS total_downvotes_received, COUNT(DISTINCT tp.tag_id) AS tags_used, SUM(tp.tag_usage) AS total_tag_usage, SUM(tp.total_tag_views) AS total_tag_views FROM user_activity ua JOIN post_engagement pe ON ua.user_id = pe.owneruserid LEFT JOIN tags t ON pe.post_id = t.excerptpostid LEFT JOIN tag_popularity tp ON t.id = tp.tag_id WHERE ua.reputation > 11029 AND ua.post_count >= 839 AND pe.posttypeid = '1' GROUP BY ua.user_id, ua.reputation, ua.user_creation, ua.post_count, ua.comment_count, ua.badge_count, ua.vote_count, ua.total_post_score, ua.total_views, ua.total_answers, ua.total_favorites HAVING AVG(pe.score) > 1 AND SUM(pe.viewcount) > 11467 AND COUNT(DISTINCT pe.post_id) >= 43 ORDER BY ua.reputation DESC, total_post_views DESC LIMIT 825;

WITH user_post_summary AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1332244857296 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 97 ), comment_activity AS ( SELECT c.userid, COUNT(c.id) AS comment_count, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, MIN(c.creationdate) AS first_comment_date, MAX(c.creationdate) AS last_comment_date FROM comments c WHERE c.creationdate BETWEEN 1369055066766 AND 1323645949974 GROUP BY c.userid HAVING COUNT(c.id) >= 444 ), vote_analysis AS ( SELECT v.userid, COUNT(v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_given, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes_given, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM votes v WHERE v.creationdate >= 1300515307051 GROUP BY v.userid HAVING COUNT(v.id) > 452 ), badge_recognition AS ( SELECT b.userid, COUNT(b.id) AS badge_count, MIN(b.date) AS first_badge_date, MAX(b.date) AS last_badge_date FROM badges b WHERE b.date <= 1496336760642 GROUP BY b.userid HAVING COUNT(b.id) BETWEEN 1 AND 435 ), post_history_tracking AS ( SELECT ph.userid, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.postid) AS edited_posts, COUNT(ph.id) AS total_edits, AVG(ph.posthistorytypeid) AS avg_edit_type FROM posthistory ph WHERE ph.creationdate >= 1492612506653 GROUP BY ph.userid HAVING COUNT(ph.id) > 102 ), post_link_network AS ( SELECT pl.postid, COUNT(pl.relatedpostid) AS link_count, AVG(pl.linktypeid) AS avg_link_type FROM postlinks pl WHERE pl.creationdate <= 1600334724310 GROUP BY pl.postid HAVING COUNT(pl.relatedpostid) >= 2 ), tag_popularity AS ( SELECT t.excerptpostid AS post_id, t.count AS tag_usage_count FROM tags t WHERE t.count > 7740 ) SELECT ups.user_id, ups.reputation, ups.total_posts, ups.total_post_score, ups.avg_viewcount, ups.latest_post_date, COALESCE(ca.comment_count, 0) AS comment_count, COALESCE(ca.avg_comment_score, 0) AS avg_comment_score, COALESCE(ca.first_comment_date, 0) AS first_comment_date, COALESCE(ca.last_comment_date, 0) AS last_comment_date, COALESCE(va.total_votes, 0) AS total_votes, COALESCE(va.upvotes_given, 0) AS upvotes_given, COALESCE(va.downvotes_given, 0) AS downvotes_given, COALESCE(va.total_bounty, 0) AS total_bounty, COALESCE(br.badge_count, 0) AS badge_count, COALESCE(br.first_badge_date, 0) AS first_badge_date, COALESCE(br.last_badge_date, 0) AS last_badge_date, COALESCE(pht.edited_posts, 0) AS edited_posts, COALESCE(pht.total_edits, 0) AS total_edits, COALESCE(pht.avg_edit_type, 0) AS avg_edit_type, COALESCE(pln.link_count, 0) AS post_link_count, COALESCE(pln.avg_link_type, 0) AS avg_link_type, COALESCE(tp.tag_usage_count, 0) AS tag_usage_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ups.total_post_score DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ups.total_posts DESC) AS post_count_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ups.reputation / 1000 ORDER BY ups.avg_viewcount DESC) AS view_rank_in_reputation_bucket FROM user_post_summary ups LEFT JOIN comment_activity ca ON ups.user_id = ca.userid LEFT JOIN vote_analysis va ON ups.user_id = va.userid LEFT JOIN badge_recognition br ON ups.user_id = br.userid LEFT JOIN post_history_tracking pht ON ups.user_id = pht.userid LEFT JOIN posts p ON ups.user_id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN post_link_network pln ON p.id = pln.postid LEFT JOIN tag_popularity tp ON p.id = tp.post_id WHERE ups.total_post_score > 3021 OR COALESCE(ca.comment_count, 0) > 883 OR COALESCE(va.total_votes, 0) > 1919 ORDER BY ups.total_post_score DESC, ups.total_posts DESC, ups.avg_viewcount DESC LIMIT 579;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND v.votetypeid = 8 JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1292811836586 AND p.creationdate <= 1525951387469 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM badges b WHERE b.userid = u.id AND b.date >= 1554395795214) AND p.posttypeid = 1 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 97 AND AVG(p.score) >= 28 ORDER BY total_bounty DESC NULLS LAST, post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_view_count, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date, SUM(CASE WHEN ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_history_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS linked_posts_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1326064445547 AND p.creationdate <= 1394618254132 AND u.reputation > 47697 AND (p.score > 59 OR p.score IS NULL) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 14 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, post_count DESC LIMIT 147;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, MAX(p.viewcount) AS max_view_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS linked_posts_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.favoritecount) DESC) AS favorite_rank FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND v.votetypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.creationdate >= 1425445548136 LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = '1' WHERE p.creationdate >= 1354032147425 AND p.creationdate <= 1604696253690 AND u.creationdate <= 1414212520211 AND (p.score > 583 OR p.viewcount > 3162) AND p.posttypeid IN ('1', '1') GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 14 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 107 AND SUM(v.bountyamount) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_posts DESC, total_bounty DESC LIMIT 56;

c.id) AS total_comments, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, MAX(c.creationdate) AS latest_comment_date FROM comments c WHERE c.creationdate >= 1431510381093 GROUP BY c.userid ), user_vote_activity AS = ts.excerptpostid WHERE upa.reputation >= 901969 GROUP BY upa.user_id, upa.reputation, upa.total_posts, upa.total_post_score, upa.avg_views_per_post, uca.total_comments, uca.avg_comment_score, comment_activity AS ( SELECT c.userid, COUNT(c.id) AS total_comments, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, SUM(CASE WHEN c.score > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_score_comments FROM comments c WHERE c.creationdate BETWEEN 1504134610778 AND 1608979067988 GROUP BY c.userid ), vote_analysis AS ( SELECT v.userid, COUNT(v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT v.postid) AS distinct_posts_voted FROM votes v WHERE v.creationdate >= 1507599534427 GROUP BY v.userid ), badge_counts AS ( SELECT b.userid, COUNT(b.id) AS badge_count, MIN(b.date) AS first_badge_date ups.avg_answers_per_post, ups.latest_post_date, COALESCE(ca.total_comments, 0) AS total_comments, COALESCE(ca.avg_comment_score, 0) AS avg_comment_score, COALESCE(ca.high_score_comments, 0) AS high_score_comments, COALESCE(va.total_votes, 0) AS total_votes, COALESCE(va.total_bounty, 0) AS total_bounty, COALESCE(va.distinct_posts_voted, 0) AS distinct_posts_voted, COALESCE(bc.badge_count, 0) AS badge_count, bc.first_badge_date, COALESCE(phs.history_entries, 0) AS history_entries, COALESCE(phs.distinct_posts_edited, 0) AS distinct_posts_edited, COALESCE(pln.link_count, 0) AS post_link_count, COALESCE(pln.distinct_related_posts, 0) AS distinct_related_posts, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ups.total_post_score DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ups.total_views bc.userid LEFT JOIN post_history_stats phs ON ups.user_id = phs.userid LEFT JOIN posts p ON ups.user_id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN post_link_network pln ON p.id = pln.postid WHERE ups.total_posts > 57 AND ups.reputation >= 40451 AND (ca.total_comments > 37 OR ca.total_comments IS NULL) AND (va.total_votes > 27 OR va.total_votes IS NULL) GROUP BY ups.user_id, ups.reputation, ups.total_posts, ups.total_post_score, ups.total_views, ups.avg_answers_per_post, ups.latest_post_date, ca.total_comments, ca.avg_comment_score, ca.high_score_comments, va.total_votes, va.total_bounty, b.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid WHERE u.reputation >= 173517 AND u.creationdate BETWEEN 1466143728 AND 1654032996 AND (p.creationdate >= 1314070005 OR p.creationdate IS NULL) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate ), post_metrics AS ( SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.owneruserid, p.posttypeid, p.score, p.viewcount, p.creationdate, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS history_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS related_posts, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvote_count, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvote_count, MAX(v.bountyamount) AS max_bounty FROM posts p LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid WHERE p.score >= 912 AND p.creationdate BETWEEN 1661098195 AND 1685959884 GROUP BY p.id, p.owneruserid, p.posttypeid, p.score, p.viewcount, p.creationdate ), tag_analysis AS ( SELECT t.id AS tag_id, t.count AS tag_usage_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS distinct_tagged_posts, tags t LEFT JOIN posts p ON t.excerptpostid = p.id LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE t.count >= 95225 GROUP BY t.id, t.count ) SELECT ua.user_id, WITH user_post_stats AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS distinct_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS distinct_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS distinct_votes, SUM(p.score) pl.relatedpostid WHERE t.count >= 5606 GROUP BY t.id, t.count ), badge_activity AS ( SELECT b.userid, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, MIN(b.date) AS first_badge_date, MAX(b.date) AS SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, MAX(p.viewcount) AS max_view_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ph.posthistorytypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS edit_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.favoritecount) DESC) AS favorite_rank FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1404724940662 AND p.creationdate <= 1531105483522 AND v.creationdate >= 1578752934833 AND v.creationdate <= 1477580822761 AND b.date >= 1273656704917 AND b.date <= 1296633268280 AND p.score > 480 AND u.reputation > 529349 AND v.votetypeid = '1' AND ph.posthistorytypeid IN ('1', '1') AND pl.linktypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 18 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 421 AND SUM(v.bountyamount) > '50' ORDER BY total_posts DESC, total_bounty DESC LIMIT 270;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received, MAX(sub.max_comment_score) AS max_comment_score_on_post, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid = 2 LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = 1 LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid JOIN ( SELECT p_inner.owneruserid, MAX(c_inner.score) AS max_comment_score FROM posts p_inner JOIN comments c_inner ON p_inner.id = c_inner.postid WHERE p_inner.creationdate >= 1548480716602 AND p_inner.answercount > 70 GROUP BY p_inner.owneruserid ) sub ON u.id = sub.owneruserid WHERE u.creationdate >= 1502089313606 AND u.reputation > 210814 AND p.posttypeid = 1 AND p.creationdate BETWEEN 1265569351430 AND 1365627961464 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 14 AND SUM(p.score) >= 4307 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, user_id;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answer_count, MAX(p.favoritecount) AS max_favorite_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS linked_posts_count, SUM(t.count) AS total_tag_usage FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1486025697383 AND p.creationdate <= 1336595495365 AND u.reputation > 9606 AND (p.score > 606 OR p.viewcount > 74928) AND v.creationdate >= 1453677892498 AND v.votetypeid IN ('1', '1') GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 14 AND SUM(p.score) > 3336 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) >= 3 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, post_count DESC LIMIT 447;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1327540803970 AND p.score > 91 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation UNION ALL SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score FROM users u JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid WHERE c.creationdate >= 1503762095689 AND c.score > '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation ORDER BY reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(c.score) AS max_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1351676293880 AND p.creationdate <= 1570797788226 AND p.score > 354 AND u.reputation >= 594889 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 50 AND SUM(p.score) > 4945 ORDER BY total_score DESC, post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(CASE WHEN p.posttypeid = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS question_count, SUM(CASE WHEN p.posttypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answer_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid AND p.creationdate >= 1401062521231 LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid AND c.creationdate >= 1586102289239 LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.creationdate >= 1327805998985 WHERE u.reputation > 646454 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 72 ORDER BY u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes_received, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, SUM(p.answercount) AS total_answers_generated, SUM(p.favoritecount) AS total_favorites, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS quarterly_post_score_rank FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1580727383388 AND p.creationdate <= 1410070828077 AND p.posttypeid = '1' AND p.score > 55 AND u.reputation >= 363139 AND u.creationdate <= 1427145334496 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 52 AND SUM(p.score) > 3302 ORDER BY post_year DESC, post_quarter DESC, total_post_score DESC;

WITH user_activity_summary AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, SUM(p.answercount) AS total_answers, SUM(p.favoritecount) AS total_favorites, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1442800926 OR c.creationdate >= 1350866626 OR b.date >= 1341739668 OR v.creationdate >= 1405154496 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 59 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 41 ), post_network_analysis AS ( SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.owneruserid, p.posttypeid, p.score, p.viewcount, p.answercount, p.favoritecount, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS edit_history_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS link_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, MAX(ph.creationdate) AS last_edit_date FROM posts p LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid IN (2,5,8) LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = 1 LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate BETWEEN 1420858301 AND 1373148320 AND p.score > 88 AND (p.owneruserid IS NOT NULL OR p.lasteditoruserid IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY p.id, p.owneruserid, p.posttypeid, p.score, p.viewcount, p.answercount, p.favoritecount HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) >= 9 AND COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) > 47 ) SELECT 'user_summary' AS result_type, user_id, reputation, post_count, comment_count, badge_count, vote_count, total_post_score, total_views, total_answers, total_favorites, latest_post_date, NULL AS post_id, NULL AS posttypeid, NULL AS post_score, NULL AS post_viewcount, NULL AS edit_history_count, NULL AS link_count, NULL AS post_comment_count, NULL AS post_vote_count, NULL AS upvotes, NULL AS downvotes, NULL AS avg_comment_score FROM user_activity_summary WHERE reputation > 25003 AND total_views > 984188 UNION ALL SELECT 'post_analysis' AS result_type, owneruserid AS user_id, NULL AS reputation, NULL AS post_count, NULL AS comment_count, NULL AS badge_count, NULL AS vote_count, NULL AS total_post_score, NULL AS total_views, NULL AS total_answers, NULL AS total_favorites, NULL AS latest_post_date, post_id, posttypeid, score AS post_score, viewcount AS post_viewcount, edit_history_count, link_count, user_id DESC, post_id DESC LIMIT 8546 OFFSET 222;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.posttypeid = 1 AND p.creationdate >= 1467607889570 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM comments c WHERE c.postid = p.id AND c.score > '5' ) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 62 ORDER BY avg_post_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.score) FILTER (WHERE p.score > 0) AS avg_positive_score, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1409024717163 OR c.creationdate >= 1398678705672 OR v.creationdate >= 1275008239274 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 26 OR COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 93 ORDER BY u.reputation DESC, total_post_score DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges b WHERE b.userid = u.id AND b.date >= 1445267680256 AND b.date <= 1382566554185) AS badge_count_recent, (SELECT SUM(v.bountyamount) FROM votes v WHERE v.userid = u.id AND v.votetypeid = '1' AND v.creationdate >= 1602386040206) AS total_bounty, (SELECT MAX(c.score) FROM comments c WHERE c.userid = u.id AND c.creationdate BETWEEN 1268944751421 AND 1602587969352) AS max_comment_score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS score_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.id), 1) OVER (ORDER BY u.creationdate) AS prev_user_post_count FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.posttypeid = '1' AND p.creationdate >= 1575149335612 AND p.creationdate <= 1449663636629 AND p.score > 3 AND v.votetypeid IN ('1', '1') AND v.creationdate >= 1554181862375 AND c.score > '0' AND c.creationdate BETWEEN 1575766277000 AND 1284079399367 AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' AND ph.creationdate >= 1405021742416 AND pl.linktypeid = '1' AND pl.creationdate >= 1483019572115 AND (t.count IS NULL OR t.count > 171) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 69 AND SUM(p.score) >= 3145 AND AVG(p.viewcount) < 42052 ORDER BY total_score DESC, post_count ASC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(c.score) AS max_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1516231240666 AND p.creationdate <= 1349889540413 AND p.score > 910 AND u.reputation >= 874536 AND v.creationdate >= 1426624818687 AND v.creationdate <= 1300332865154 AND ph.creationdate >= 1455042923223 AND ph.creationdate <= 1552932274254 AND b.date >= 1306599723256 AND b.date <= 1387511905592 AND pl.creationdate >= 1369301218238 AND pl.creationdate <= 1494292075706 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 79 AND SUM(p.score) > 8828 AND AVG(p.viewcount) > 79066 AND COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) > 419 INTERSECT SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(c.score) AS max_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.answercount > 88 AND p.commentcount > 75 AND p.favoritecount > 64 AND u.views >= 66713 AND u.upvotes >= 7994 AND u.downvotes >= 3776 AND v.votetypeid = '1' AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' AND pl.linktypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 55 AND SUM(p.score) > 2838 AND AVG(p.viewcount) > 19650 AND COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) > 68 ORDER BY total_score DESC, post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, MAX(p.viewcount) AS max_view_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_history_events, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(v.bountyamount) DESC NULLS LAST) AS bounty_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1278760155094 AND p.creationdate <= 1356220258273 AND (p.score > 439 OR p.viewcount > 55216) AND u.reputation >= 508472 AND v.creationdate >= 1346847415612 AND v.votetypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 524 AND SUM(v.bountyamount) >= '0' AND AVG(p.score) < 414 ORDER BY total_bounty DESC, post_rank ASC LIMIT 866;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_month, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answers_per_post, MAX(p.favoritecount) AS max_favorites, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments_received, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes_received, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty_received, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS post_edits_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS linked_posts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badges_earned_in_period, SUM(p.commentcount) AS total_comments_on_posts, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.id), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY u.id ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate))) AS prev_month_posts, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS rank_by_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid = 5 LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = 1 LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid AND b.date >= p.creationdate - 2592000000 AND b.date <= p.creationdate WHERE p.posttypeid = 1 AND p.creationdate >= 1472634589000 AND p.creationdate <= 1264685651199 AND u.reputation > 438303 AND p.score > 407 AND p.viewcount > 370304 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 55 AND SUM(p.score) > 4637 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, post_month;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COALESCE(agg.total_comments, 0) AS total_comments, COALESCE(agg.avg_post_score, 0) AS avg_post_score FROM users u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.owneruserid, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score FROM posts p JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1582898446541 AND p.creationdate <= 1597677434949 GROUP BY p.owneruserid HAVING AVG(p.score) > 64 ) agg ON u.id = agg.owneruserid WHERE u.reputation >= 53813 ORDER BY u.reputation DESC, total_comments DESC LIMIT 103;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND v.votetypeid = '1' WHERE u.reputation > 70255 AND (p.posttypeid = 1 OR p.posttypeid = 2) AND p.creationdate >= 1429419267868 AND p.creationdate <= 1321425954769 AND (p.score > 236 OR p.viewcount > 12894) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 76 AND AVG(p.score) < 69 ORDER BY total_bounty DESC NULLS LAST, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, MAX(v.creationdate) AS last_vote_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1400058816694 AND c.creationdate >= 1512384117883 AND u.reputation > 158 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 23 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 68 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1530521257299 AND p.score > 91 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 47 INTERSECT SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score FROM users u JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid WHERE c.creationdate >= 1499432925920 AND c.score > '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 18 ORDER BY reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1564474515066 AND p.score > 75 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 43 INTERSECT SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score FROM users u JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid WHERE c.creationdate >= 1282321850991 AND c.score > '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 22 ORDER BY reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, MAX(p.viewcount) AS max_view_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_history_events, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.favoritecount) DESC) AS favorite_rank FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND v.votetypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1361168985972 AND p.creationdate <= 1545520265965 AND u.reputation > 305473 AND p.score > 876 AND (p.posttypeid = 1 OR p.posttypeid = 2) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 18 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 184 AND SUM(v.bountyamount) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_bounty DESC, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(p.score) AS sum_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_view_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_history_events, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date, MIN(b.date) AS earliest_badge_date, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS rank_by_post_score, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.id), 1) OVER (ORDER BY u.creationdate) AS prev_user_post_count FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.score > 32 AND p.creationdate >= 1593973133035 AND p.creationdate <= 1347945735113 AND v.creationdate >= 1448743000649 AND u.reputation >= 59221 AND u.views > 6056 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 37 AND SUM(p.score) > 2026 ORDER BY total_posts DESC, sum_post_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(CASE WHEN p.posttypeid = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS question_count, SUM(CASE WHEN p.posttypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answer_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvote_count FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1344110971587 AND p.score > 262 AND u.reputation >= 174149 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 66 ORDER BY avg_post_score DESC, total_posts DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(c.score) AS max_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS score_rank FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1358981094620 AND p.creationdate <= 1544377775697 AND p.score > 235 AND u.reputation >= 599778 AND v.creationdate >= 1285552572328 AND v.creationdate <= 1429027063388 AND ph.creationdate >= 1340224954803 AND ph.creationdate <= 1457242189581 AND b.date >= 1348185271885 AND b.date <= 1348644188331 AND pl.creationdate >= 1572490277204 AND pl.creationdate <= 1528836095523 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 597 AND SUM(p.score) > 7067 AND AVG(p.viewcount) > 28983 ORDER BY total_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_year, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1440762123155 AND p.creationdate <= 1441406554704 AND p.posttypeid = 1 AND u.reputation > 686408 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (u.id, u.reputation, post_year), (u.id, u.reputation), (post_year), () ) ORDER BY u.reputation DESC, post_year;

WITH user_post_summary AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1409803387359 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 40 ), comment_activity AS ( SELECT c.userid, COUNT(c.id) AS comment_count, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, MIN(c.creationdate) AS first_comment_date, MAX(c.creationdate) AS last_comment_date FROM comments c WHERE c.creationdate BETWEEN 1531806556394 AND 1328541862082 GROUP BY c.userid HAVING COUNT(c.id) >= 375 ), vote_analysis AS ( SELECT v.userid, COUNT(v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_given, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes_given, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM votes v WHERE v.creationdate >= 1288251247988 GROUP BY v.userid HAVING COUNT(v.id) > 431 ), badge_recognition AS ( SELECT b.userid, COUNT(b.id) AS badge_count, MIN(b.date) AS first_badge_date, MAX(b.date) AS last_badge_date FROM badges b WHERE b.date <= 1524049661164 GROUP BY b.userid HAVING COUNT(b.id) BETWEEN 3 AND 92 ), post_history_tracking AS ( SELECT ph.userid, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.postid) AS edited_posts, COUNT(ph.id) AS total_edits, AVG(ph.posthistorytypeid) AS avg_edit_type FROM posthistory ph WHERE ph.creationdate >= 1273548929987 GROUP BY ph.userid HAVING COUNT(ph.id) > 65 ), post_link_network AS ( SELECT pl.postid, COUNT(pl.relatedpostid) AS link_count, AVG(pl.linktypeid) AS avg_link_type FROM postlinks pl WHERE pl.creationdate <= 1275426209653 GROUP BY pl.postid HAVING COUNT(pl.relatedpostid) >= 6 ), tag_popularity AS ( SELECT t.excerptpostid AS post_id, t.count AS tag_usage_count FROM tags t WHERE t.count > 6194 ) SELECT ups.user_id, ups.reputation, ups.total_posts, ups.total_post_score, ups.avg_viewcount, ups.latest_post_date, COALESCE(ca.comment_count, 0) AS comment_count, COALESCE(ca.avg_comment_score, 0) AS avg_comment_score, COALESCE(ca.first_comment_date, 0) AS first_comment_date, COALESCE(ca.last_comment_date, 0) AS last_comment_date, COALESCE(va.total_votes, 0) AS total_votes, COALESCE(va.upvotes_given, 0) AS upvotes_given, COALESCE(va.downvotes_given, 0) AS downvotes_given, COALESCE(va.total_bounty, 0) AS total_bounty, COALESCE(br.badge_count, 0) AS badge_count, COALESCE(br.first_badge_date, 0) AS first_badge_date, COALESCE(br.last_badge_date, 0) AS last_badge_date, COALESCE(pht.edited_posts, 0) AS edited_posts, COALESCE(pht.total_edits, 0) AS total_edits, COALESCE(pht.avg_edit_type, 0) AS avg_edit_type, COALESCE(pln.link_count, 0) AS post_link_count, COALESCE(pln.avg_link_type, 0) AS avg_link_type, COALESCE(tp.tag_usage_count, 0) AS tag_usage_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ups.total_post_score DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ups.total_posts DESC) AS post_count_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ups.reputation / 1000 ORDER BY ups.avg_viewcount DESC) AS view_rank_in_reputation_bucket FROM user_post_summary ups LEFT JOIN comment_activity ca ON ups.user_id = ca.userid LEFT JOIN vote_analysis va ON ups.user_id = va.userid LEFT JOIN badge_recognition br ON ups.user_id = br.userid LEFT JOIN post_history_tracking pht ON ups.user_id = pht.userid LEFT JOIN posts p ON ups.user_id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN post_link_network pln ON p.id = pln.postid LEFT JOIN tag_popularity tp ON p.id = tp.post_id WHERE ups.total_post_score > 7442 OR COALESCE(ca.comment_count, 0) > 458 OR COALESCE(va.total_votes, 0) > 3673 ORDER BY ups.total_post_score DESC, ups.total_posts DESC, ups.avg_viewcount DESC LIMIT 668;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1380099326789 AND p.creationdate <= 1371043871666 AND u.reputation > 372448 GROUP BY u.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 81 ORDER BY post_count DESC, avg_comment_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1416239764 AND v.creationdate >= 1441314827 GROUP BY u.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 26 AND AVG(p.score) < 50 ORDER BY total_bounty DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges b WHERE b.userid = u.id AND b.date >= 1406488928514) AS recent_badges, (SELECT AVG(c.score) FROM comments c WHERE c.userid = u.id AND c.creationdate <= 1553663500907) AS avg_comment_score FROM users u WHERE u.reputation > 56142 AND u.creationdate < 1432827482122 ORDER BY u.reputation DESC LIMIT 960;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COALESCE(agg.total_comments, 0) AS total_comments, COALESCE(agg.avg_post_score, 0) AS avg_post_score FROM users u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.owneruserid, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score FROM posts p JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1368477507804 AND p.creationdate <= 1421197030572 GROUP BY p.owneruserid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 51 ) agg ON u.id = agg.owneruserid WHERE u.reputation >= 210981 ORDER BY u.reputation DESC, total_comments DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid AND b.date >= 1528495911955 LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid AND c.creationdate >= 1439155620367 WHERE u.reputation > 727671 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) < 99 OR COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) < 376 ORDER BY u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid AND b.date >= 1445623336629 LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid AND c.creationdate >= 1361421145440 LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.creationdate >= 1482211526076 WHERE u.creationdate >= 1600681098283 AND u.reputation > 90779 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) < 42 OR COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) < 215 ORDER BY u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1530533657647 AND p.creationdate <= 1358463846474 AND p.posttypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 28 ORDER BY post_count DESC, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_rank FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1533129866474 AND v.creationdate >= 1295645305199 AND p.score > 31 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 47 ORDER BY post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.votetypeid = 8 WHERE (u.reputation > 57737 OR u.upvotes > 2128) AND NOT (u.downvotes >= 596 AND u.views < 495) AND u.creationdate BETWEEN 1312023317 AND 1496616330 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 33 AND AVG(p.score) < 82 ORDER BY total_bounty DESC NULLS LAST, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1540130618 AND c.creationdate >= 1430447234 AND v.votetypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 35 AND SUM(p.score) > 797 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1380632804 AND c.creationdate >= 1364926511 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(c.creationdate)) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 26 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, (SELECT AVG(score) FROM comments c WHERE c.userid = u.id AND c.creationdate >= 1370936934109) AS avg_comment_score_recent FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1326283359991 AND p.score > 50 AND v.votetypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 49 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(c.score) AS max_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_rank, LAG(SUM(p.score), 1) OVER (ORDER BY u.creationdate) AS prev_user_total_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND v.votetypeid = 7 LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid = 2 LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = 1 LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1498154981172 AND p.creationdate <= 1368846847126 AND p.score > 295 AND u.reputation >= 903973 AND (p.viewcount > 225984 OR p.favoritecount > 992) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 61 AND SUM(p.score) > 4926 AND AVG(p.viewcount) < 935218 ORDER BY total_score DESC, post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(c.score) AS max_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS link_count FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1263770401519 AND p.creationdate <= 1574339149203 AND u.reputation > 450722 AND p.score > 6424 AND v.votetypeid = '1' AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' AND pl.linktypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 106 AND SUM(p.score) > 31998 AND AVG(p.viewcount) < 188632 AND COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) >= 4060 AND COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) <= 3825 ORDER BY total_score DESC, post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(c.score) AS max_comment_score, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1506578577472 AND p.creationdate <= 1366651461803 AND p.score > 839 AND u.reputation >= 936590 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tags t WHERE t.excerptpostid = p.id AND t.count > 2411 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 9 AND SUM(p.score) < 597277 ORDER BY total_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1389126539658 AND p.score > 20 AND u.reputation >= 44426 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 2 UNION ALL SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, AVG(u.views) AS avg_user_views, MAX(b.date) AS latest_badge_date FROM users u JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid JOIN postlinks pl ON c.postid = pl.postid WHERE b.date >= 1353696666860 AND c.score > '1' AND u.upvotes >= 1557 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) > 17 ORDER BY reputation DESC, user_id;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes_received, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, MAX(p.viewcount) AS max_post_views, SUM(CASE WHEN ph.posthistorytypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS edit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS linked_posts_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.favoritecount) DESC) AS favorite_count_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid AND p.posttypeid = 1 LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid IN (2,5) LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = 1 LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE u.creationdate >= 1403168470 AND u.reputation >= 125883 AND (p.creationdate >= 1420089727 OR p.creationdate IS NULL) AND (v.creationdate >= 1218753497 OR v.creationdate IS NULL) AND (b.date >= 1405148975 OR b.date IS NULL) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 566 AND SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 470 AND AVG(p.score) <= 279 ORDER BY total_posts DESC, upvotes_received DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, MAX(p.viewcount) AS max_view_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_history_events, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(v.bountyamount) DESC NULLS LAST) AS bounty_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1375267360642 AND p.creationdate <= 1346270767321 AND (p.score > 408 OR p.viewcount > 597493) AND u.reputation >= 641333 AND v.creationdate >= 1388515634462 AND v.votetypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 171 AND SUM(v.bountyamount) >= '0' AND AVG(p.score) < 666 ORDER BY total_bounty DESC, post_rank ASC LIMIT 788;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_post_views, MAX(b.date) AS latest_badge_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE u.reputation > 19354 AND p.creationdate >= 1269894735 AND p.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT postid FROM votes WHERE votetypeid = '1' AND creationdate BETWEEN 1277995720 AND 1495179508 ) AND u.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT userid FROM badges WHERE date >= 1434485066 ) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 6 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 36 AND SUM(p.score) > 497 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, u.reputation DESC LIMIT 837;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_post_views, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date, MIN(b.date) AS first_badge_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE u.reputation > 33007 AND p.creationdate >= 1424872465 AND p.creationdate <= 1452130634 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM votes v2 WHERE v2.postid = p.id AND v2.votetypeid = '1' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM posthistory ph2 WHERE ph2.postid = p.id AND ph2.posthistorytypeid = '1' ) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 97 AND SUM(p.score) > 905 AND AVG(p.viewcount) < 39381 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, u.reputation DESC LIMIT 47;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answers_per_post, MAX(p.favoritecount) AS max_favorites, SUM(CASE WHEN ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS linked_posts_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank, LAG(u.reputation, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + u.creationdate * INTERVAL '1 second') ORDER BY u.creationdate) AS prev_user_reputation FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1381395317 AND p.creationdate <= 1541630530 AND (p.score > 512 OR p.viewcount > 96701) AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + p.creationdate * INTERVAL '1 second') IN (12, 3, 8) AND EXTRACT(DOW FROM TIMESTAMP 'epoch' + p.creationdate * INTERVAL '1 second') = 5 AND (u.reputation BETWEEN 624297 AND 242162 OR u.views > 95380) AND (c.creationdate >= 1331450843 OR c.creationdate IS NULL) AND (v.creationdate >= 1506204894 OR v.creationdate IS NULL) AND (b.date >= 1389142985 OR b.date IS NULL) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 202 AND SUM(p.viewcount) > 392965 AND AVG(p.answercount) < 95 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, total_views DESC LIMIT 518;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(CASE WHEN p.posttypeid = 1 THEN p.viewcount ELSE 0 END) AS total_question_views, SUM(CASE WHEN p.posttypeid = 2 THEN p.score ELSE 0 END) AS total_answer_score, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes_received, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answer_count_per_post, MAX(p.favoritecount) AS max_favorite_count, SUM(p.commentcount) AS total_post_comments, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY u.reputation DESC) AS reputation_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid WHERE u.creationdate >= 1274989964898 AND p.creationdate >= 1447344941260 AND v.creationdate >= 1437586516302 AND b.date >= 1374898265809 AND ph.creationdate >= 1525971956629 AND pl.creationdate >= 1263990714072 AND u.reputation > 124319 AND p.score > 8640 AND v.votetypeid IN ('1', '1') GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 707 AND COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) > 3566 AND SUM(CASE WHEN p.posttypeid = 1 THEN p.viewcount ELSE 0 END) > 549972 ORDER BY u.reputation DESC, total_posts DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, SUM(t.count) AS total_tag_usage, AVG(SUM(p.score)) OVER (PARTITION BY u.reputation ORDER BY u.creationdate ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_score_by_rep FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1256784454 AND p.score > 747 AND u.reputation BETWEEN 925227 AND 758659 AND v.creationdate >= 1263225801 AND c.creationdate >= 1342673255 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 701 AND SUM(p.viewcount) > 774777 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, MAX(p.answercount) AS max_answercount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges b WHERE b.userid = u.id AND b.date >= 1390381318062) AS recent_badges, (SELECT SUM(v.bountyamount) FROM votes v WHERE v.userid = u.id AND v.votetypeid = 7 AND v.creationdate BETWEEN 1361567056233 AND 1456039735001) AS total_bounty_received, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ph.postid) FROM posthistory ph WHERE ph.userid = u.id AND ph.posthistorytypeid IN (2,5) AND ph.creationdate >= 1501430671538) AS recent_edits, (SELECT AVG(sub.cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM comments c2 WHERE c2.userid = u.id GROUP BY c2.postid) sub) AS avg_comments_per_post FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid AND c.score > '1' LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = 1 LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE u.creationdate >= 1358731605118 AND p.posttypeid = 1 AND p.creationdate BETWEEN 1547430359121 AND 1467986524104 AND (p.favoritecount >= 919 OR p.commentcount > 345) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 98 AND SUM(p.score) >= 6418 AND AVG(p.viewcount) < 533525 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, recent_badges DESC LIMIT 446;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received, MAX(sub.max_comment_score) AS max_comment_score_on_posts, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS score_rank FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid = 2 LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = 3 LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid JOIN ( SELECT p2.owneruserid, MAX(c2.score) AS max_comment_score FROM posts p2 JOIN comments c2 ON p2.id = c2.postid WHERE c2.creationdate >= 1416259203971 GROUP BY p2.owneruserid HAVING MAX(c2.score) > '1' ) sub ON u.id = sub.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate BETWEEN 1374056665429 AND 1562569091087 AND p.posttypeid = 1 AND u.reputation > 81940 AND (p.favoritecount >= 576 OR p.answercount > 82) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 809 AND SUM(p.score) >= 2370 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answers_per_post, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS user_post_score_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1429277290797 AND p.score > 201 AND u.reputation >= 493120 AND v.creationdate >= 1519503403581 AND c.creationdate >= 1542272965027 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 725 AND SUM(p.viewcount) > 972198 AND COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) >= 7192 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(u.creationdate)) AS user_join_year, p.posttypeid, t.count AS tag_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answers, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1400569249450 AND p.creationdate <= 1380850360897 AND u.reputation > 860956 AND p.score > 999 AND v.creationdate >= 1601052847207 GROUP BY CUBE( u.id, u.reputation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(u.creationdate)), p.posttypeid, t.count ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 48 AND SUM(p.viewcount) > 296647 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, total_views DESC LIMIT 1000;

SUM(p2.score)) DESC) AS combined_score_rank FROM users u1 JOIN users u2 ON u1.creationdate >= 1990814958 AND u2.creationdate <= 1576202420 AND u1.id <> u2.id LEFT JOIN badges b1 ON u1.id = b1.userid AND b1.date >= 1949121187 LEFT JOIN badges b2 ON u2.id = b2.userid AND b2.date <= 1665018605 LEFT JOIN comments c1 ON u1.id = c1.userid AND c1.creationdate BETWEEN 1165857140 AND 1877550377 LEFT JOIN comments c2 ON u2.id = c2.userid AND c2.creationdate BETWEEN 1341177851 AND 1631679176 LEFT JOIN posts p1 ON u1.id = p1.owneruserid AND p1.creationdate >= 1132496028 LEFT JOIN posts p2 ON u2.id = p2.owneruserid AND p2.creationdate <= 1988801857 LEFT JOIN posthistory ph1 ON u1.id = ph1.userid AND ph1.creationdate >= 1538210326 LEFT JOIN posthistory ph2 ON u2.id = ph2.userid AND ph2.creationdate <= 1391487744 LEFT JOIN votes v1 ON u1.id = v1.userid AND v1.creationdate BETWEEN 1893416200 AND 1392589577 LEFT JOIN votes v2 ON u2.id = v2.userid AND v2.creationdate BETWEEN 1751682548 AND 1635139506 LEFT JOIN tags t1 ON p1.id = t1.excerptpostid LEFT JOIN tags t2 ON p2.id = t2.excerptpostid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl1 ON p1.id = pl1.postid AND pl1.creationdate >= 1029264133 LEFT JOIN postlinks pl2 ON p2.id = pl2.postid AND pl2.creationdate <= 1601214526 WHERE u1.reputation > 449846 AND u2.reputation < 694641 GROUP BY u1.id, u2.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b1.id) > 95 AND
