WITH user_post_stats AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1581362472 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation ), comment_engagement AS ( SELECT c.userid, COUNT(c.id) AS total_comments, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, SUM(CASE WHEN c.score > '5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_score_comments FROM comments c WHERE c.creationdate >= 1267755300 GROUP BY c.userid ), vote_analysis AS ( SELECT v.userid, COUNT(v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT v.postid) AS distinct_posts_voted FROM votes v WHERE v.creationdate BETWEEN 1279073210 AND 1526474265 GROUP BY v.userid ), badge_activity AS ( SELECT b.userid, COUNT(b.id) AS badge_count, MIN(b.date) AS first_badge_date, MAX(b.date) AS last_badge_date FROM badges b WHERE b.date >= 1339947778 GROUP BY b.userid ), post_history_summary AS ( SELECT ph.userid, COUNT(ph.id) AS history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.postid) AS distinct_posts_edited FROM posthistory ph WHERE ph.creationdate >= 1354248359 GROUP BY ph.userid ), post_link_network AS ( SELECT pl.postid, COUNT(pl.id) AS link_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS distinct_related_posts FROM postlinks pl WHERE pl.creationdate >= 1341004440 GROUP BY pl.postid ), window_ranked_users AS ( SELECT ups.user_id, ups.reputation, ups.total_posts, ups.total_post_score, ups.avg_viewcount, ce.total_comments, ce.avg_comment_score, ce.high_score_comments, va.total_votes, va.total_bounty, va.distinct_posts_voted, ba.badge_count, ba.first_badge_date, ba.last_badge_date, phs.history_entries, phs.distinct_posts_edited, pln.link_count, pln.distinct_related_posts, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ups.total_posts > 0 ORDER BY ups.total_post_score DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ups.reputation DESC) AS reputation_rank, SUM(ups.total_posts) OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN ups.reputation >= 9817 THEN 'high' ELSE 'low' END) AS total_posts_by_reputation_group FROM user_post_stats ups LEFT JOIN comment_engagement ce ON ups.user_id = ce.userid LEFT JOIN vote_analysis va ON ups.user_id = va.userid LEFT JOIN badge_activity ba ON ups.user_id = ba.userid LEFT JOIN post_history_summary phs ON ups.user_id = phs.userid LEFT JOIN posts p ON ups.user_id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN post_link_network pln ON p.id = pln.postid WHERE ups.reputation >= 7149 GROUP BY ups.user_id, ups.reputation, ups.total_posts, ups.total_post_score, ups.avg_viewcount, ce.total_comments, ce.avg_comment_score, ce.high_score_comments, va.total_votes, va.total_bounty, va.distinct_posts_voted, ba.badge_count, ba.first_badge_date, ba.last_badge_date, phs.history_entries, phs.distinct_posts_edited, pln.link_count, pln.distinct_related_posts ) SELECT user_id, reputation, total_posts, total_post_score, avg_viewcount, total_comments, avg_comment_score, high_score_comments, total_votes, total_bounty, distinct_posts_voted, badge_count, first_badge_date, last_badge_date, history_entries, distinct_posts_edited, link_count, distinct_related_posts, post_score_rank, reputation_rank, total_posts_by_reputation_group, CASE WHEN total_posts > 0 THEN total_post_score / total_posts ELSE 0 END AS avg_post_score, CASE WHEN total_comments > 0 THEN high_score_comments * 100.0 / total_comments ELSE 0 END AS high_score_comment_percentage FROM window_ranked_users WHERE total_posts >= 63 AND total_comments >= 46 ORDER BY reputation_rank, post_score_rank LIMIT 319;

WITH user_post_summary AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1478102088 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation ), comment_activity AS ( SELECT c.userid, COUNT(c.id) AS comment_count, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, MIN(c.creationdate) AS first_comment_date FROM comments c WHERE c.creationdate BETWEEN 1364322575 AND 1541948794 GROUP BY c.userid ), vote_analysis AS ( SELECT v.userid, COUNT(v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT v.postid) AS distinct_voted_posts FROM votes v WHERE v.creationdate >= 1468252338 GROUP BY v.userid ), badge_summary AS ( SELECT b.userid, COUNT(b.id) AS badge_count, MAX(b.date) AS latest_badge_date FROM badges b WHERE b.date <= 1264491752 GROUP BY b.userid ), post_history_agg AS ( SELECT ph.userid, COUNT(ph.id) AS history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.postid) AS affected_posts FROM posthistory ph WHERE ph.creationdate >= 1343292942 GROUP BY ph.userid ), post_link_network AS ( SELECT pl.postid, COUNT(pl.id) AS link_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS unique_related_posts FROM postlinks pl WHERE pl.creationdate BETWEEN 1311274203 AND 1351670883 GROUP BY pl.postid ), tag_popularity AS ( SELECT t.id AS tag_id, t.count AS usage_count, t.excerptpostid FROM tags t WHERE t.count > 2866 ), correlated_subquery AS ( SELECT ups.user_id, ups.reputation, ups.total_posts, ups.total_post_score, ups.avg_viewcount, ca.comment_count, ca.avg_comment_score, va.vote_count, va.total_bounty, bs.badge_count, pha.history_entries, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts p2 WHERE p2.owneruserid = ups.user_id AND p2.creationdate >= 1479084299 AND p2.score > (SELECT AVG(score) FROM posts WHERE creationdate >= 1394685952) ) AS high_score_posts FROM user_post_summary ups LEFT JOIN comment_activity ca ON ups.user_id = ca.userid LEFT JOIN vote_analysis va ON ups.user_id = va.userid LEFT JOIN badge_summary bs ON ups.user_id = bs.userid LEFT JOIN post_history_agg pha ON ups.user_id = pha.userid WHERE ups.total_posts > 42 AND (ca.comment_count IS NULL OR ca.comment_count >= 499) AND (va.vote_count IS NULL OR va.vote_count <= 9719) AND ups.reputation BETWEEN 18079 AND 866057 ) SELECT csq.user_id, csq.reputation, csq.total_posts, csq.total_post_score, csq.avg_viewcount, csq.comment_count, csq.avg_comment_score, csq.vote_count, csq.total_bounty, csq.badge_count, csq.history_entries, csq.high_score_posts, pln.link_count, pln.unique_related_posts, tp.usage_count AS tag_usage, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY csq.total_post_score DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY csq.reputation DESC) AS reputation_rank, LAG(csq.total_posts, 1) OVER (ORDER BY csq.user_id) AS prev_user_posts, SUM(csq.total_bounty) OVER (PARTITION BY csq.reputation / 1000) AS bounty_by_reputation_bucket FROM correlated_subquery csq LEFT JOIN posts p ON csq.user_id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN post_link_network pln ON p.id = pln.postid LEFT JOIN tag_popularity tp ON p.id = tp.excerptpostid WHERE csq.high_score_posts > 17 AND (pln.link_count IS NULL OR pln.link_count < 44) ORDER BY csq.total_post_score DESC, csq.reputation DESC LIMIT 145;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1423397473316 AND p.creationdate <= 1529496936975 AND p.posttypeid = 1 GROUP BY u.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 87 ORDER BY post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY (u.reputation >= 32863) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS rank_by_post_count FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1553745881350 AND p.creationdate <= 1430194261610 AND p.score > 7 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 16 ORDER BY u.reputation DESC, rank_by_post_count;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY (p.posttypeid) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_type_volume_rank, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT p.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY u.reputation / 1000) AS reputation_bucket_post_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE u.creationdate >= 1342089010330 AND p.creationdate >= 1415936277273 AND p.score > 367 AND v.creationdate >= 1313532169130 AND v.bountyamount > '50' AND c.creationdate >= 1420346452928 AND b.date >= 1570765067310 AND ph.creationdate >= 1327795694369 AND pl.creationdate >= 1540520465798 AND t.count > 2648 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, p.posttypeid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 19 AND SUM(p.score) > 2566 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 373 AND COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) > 483 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1534605369494 AND p.creationdate <= 1298726323367 AND v.creationdate >= 1565274211305 AND v.creationdate <= 1446676282465 AND c.creationdate >= 1327865700145 AND c.creationdate <= 1467150880025 AND b.date >= 1600322347412 AND b.date <= 1419163766450 AND ph.creationdate >= 1517555013917 AND ph.creationdate <= 1479305810650 AND pl.creationdate >= 1487376967547 AND pl.creationdate <= 1480312981167 AND p.score > 514 AND v.bountyamount > '0' AND c.score > '0' AND u.reputation > 584686 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > (SELECT AVG(post_count) FROM (SELECT owneruserid, COUNT(*) AS post_count FROM posts GROUP BY owneruserid) AS sub) AND SUM(p.score) > 2015 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 615 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, MAX(p.answercount) AS max_answercount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges b WHERE b.userid = u.id AND b.date >= 1297976827194) AS recent_badges_count, (SELECT AVG(v.bountyamount) FROM votes v WHERE v.userid = u.id AND v.votetypeid = '1' AND v.creationdate BETWEEN 1402513288830 AND 1432090733045) AS avg_bounty_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tags t WHERE t.excerptpostid IN (SELECT p2.id FROM posts p2 WHERE p2.owneruserid = u.id)) AS tags_with_excerpt FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid WHERE u.reputation > 571234 AND u.creationdate >= 1241292349629 AND (p.score > 833 OR p.score IS NULL) AND (c.creationdate BETWEEN 1460144046315 AND 1279724722157 OR c.creationdate IS NULL) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 653 AND SUM(p.score) > 704 AND AVG(p.viewcount) < 20588 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, recent_badges_count DESC LIMIT 919;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answer_count, AVG(p.commentcount) AS avg_comment_count, AVG(p.favoritecount) AS avg_favorite_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank, SUM(SUM(p.score)) OVER (PARTITION BY u.reputation >= 483040) AS total_score_by_reputation_threshold, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT c.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.posttypeid) AS avg_comments_per_post_type FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1367335038008 AND p.creationdate <= 1396563954103 AND u.creationdate >= 1535916625922 AND u.creationdate <= 1300743254721 AND (p.score > 246 OR p.score IS NULL) AND (c.creationdate >= 1281091863754 OR c.creationdate IS NULL) AND (v.creationdate >= 1265105513448 OR v.creationdate IS NULL) AND (ph.creationdate >= 1293785170711 OR ph.creationdate IS NULL) AND (pl.creationdate >= 1270570890707 OR pl.creationdate IS NULL) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, p.posttypeid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 6 AND SUM(p.viewcount) > 118176 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, total_views DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.creationdate AS user_creation, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges b WHERE b.userid = u.id AND b.date >= 1514482495153) AS recent_badge_count, (SELECT AVG(p.score) FROM posts p WHERE p.owneruserid = u.id AND p.creationdate >= 1478163106068) AS avg_post_score, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM users u LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid AND c.creationdate >= 1391053963137 LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.votetypeid = 7 AND v.creationdate >= 1551746338489 WHERE u.reputation BETWEEN 667512 AND 794968 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 742 ORDER BY total_bounty DESC NULLS LAST, u.reputation DESC;

WITH user_post_stats AS ( SELECT p.owneruserid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM posts p WHERE p.owneruserid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.owneruserid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 33 ), comment_engagement AS ( SELECT c.userid, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, MIN(c.creationdate) AS first_comment_date FROM comments c WHERE c.userid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.userid HAVING AVG(c.score) > '0' ), vote_analysis AS ( SELECT v.userid, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT v.postid) AS voted_posts_count FROM votes v WHERE v.userid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY v.userid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) BETWEEN 945 AND 3655 ), post_history_trend AS ( SELECT ph1.userid, ph1.postid, COUNT(DISTINCT ph2.id) AS history_entries_count, MIN(ph2.creationdate) AS earliest_history_date FROM posthistory ph1 JOIN posthistory ph2 ON ph1.postid = ph2.postid AND ph1.userid = ph2.userid AND ph1.creationdate < ph2.creationdate WHERE ph1.userid IS NOT NULL AND ph2.userid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ph1.userid, ph1.postid ), badge_activity AS ( SELECT b.userid, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, MAX(b.date) AS latest_badge_date FROM badges b WHERE b.userid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY b.userid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) > 4 ), linked_posts AS ( SELECT pl1.postid, COUNT(DISTINCT pl2.relatedpostid) AS related_links_count, AVG(pl2.linktypeid) AS avg_link_type FROM postlinks pl1 JOIN postlinks pl2 ON pl1.postid = pl2.postid AND pl1.creationdate <= pl2.creationdate GROUP BY pl1.postid ) SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.views AS profile_views, ups.total_posts, ups.total_score AS post_total_score, ups.avg_views, ce.total_comments, ce.avg_comment_score, va.total_votes, va.total_bounty, va.voted_posts_count, ba.badge_count, ba.latest_badge_date, COUNT(DISTINCT pht.postid) AS posts_with_history, AVG(pht.history_entries_count) AS avg_history_entries, SUM(lp.related_links_count) AS total_related_links, AVG(lp.avg_link_type) AS overall_avg_link_type FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_post_stats ups ON u.id = ups.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comment_engagement ce ON u.id = ce.userid LEFT JOIN vote_analysis va ON u.id = va.userid LEFT JOIN badge_activity ba ON u.id = ba.userid LEFT JOIN post_history_trend pht ON u.id = pht.userid LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN linked_posts lp ON p.id = lp.postid WHERE u.creationdate >= 1591625877 AND u.reputation > 17504 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.views, ups.total_posts, ups.total_score, ups.avg_views, ce.total_comments, ce.avg_comment_score, va.total_votes, va.total_bounty, va.voted_posts_count, ba.badge_count, ba.latest_badge_date HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 18 AND AVG(pht.history_entries_count) < 20 ORDER BY u.reputation DESC, total_related_links DESC LIMIT 748;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, 0 AS comment_count FROM users u JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE b.date >= 1415770200540 AND u.reputation > 813962 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation UNION ALL SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, 0 AS badge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count FROM users u JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid WHERE c.creationdate >= 1435644599013 AND u.reputation > 247341 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation ORDER BY user_id;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1529018213160 AND p.creationdate <= 1355329883680 AND p.posttypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 28 ORDER BY post_count DESC, avg_post_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS post_history_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS post_link_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, (SUM(p.score) + SUM(c.score) + u.reputation + COALESCE(SUM(v.bountyamount), 0)) AS total_engagement_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1554249279679 AND p.creationdate <= 1515341844533 AND c.creationdate >= 1528323101771 AND c.creationdate <= 1468660717378 AND v.creationdate >= 1455497484225 AND v.creationdate <= 1459090444827 AND u.reputation > 949518 AND p.score > 3023 AND c.score > '0' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 313 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 177 AND COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) > 55 AND (SUM(p.score) + SUM(c.score) + u.reputation + COALESCE(SUM(v.bountyamount), 0)) > 2925885.96 ORDER BY total_engagement_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, MAX(b.date) AS latest_badge_date, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, SUM(t.count) AS total_tag_usage, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank, LAG(u.reputation, 1) OVER (ORDER BY u.creationdate) AS prev_user_reputation FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid AND p.posttypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid AND c.score > '0' LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.votetypeid IN ('1', '1') LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid AND b.date BETWEEN 1317012748996 AND 1470680332194 LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE u.reputation >= 869505 AND u.creationdate >= 1345521629066 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM posts p2 WHERE p2.owneruserid = u.id AND p2.score > 281 AND p2.creationdate >= 1461923662347 ORDER BY p2.creationdate DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 464 ) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 752 AND SUM(p.score) >= 9366 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) BETWEEN 756 AND 486 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, u.reputation DESC LIMIT 61 OFFSET 250;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_quarter, COUNT(p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND v.votetypeid = 7 WHERE p.posttypeid = 1 AND p.creationdate >= 1359629483167 AND p.score > 274 AND u.reputation BETWEEN 241547 AND 852193 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, post_year, post_quarter HAVING COUNT(p.id) > 13 ORDER BY total_bounty DESC NULLS LAST, total_score DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answer_count_per_post, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS user_rank_by_post_score, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.id), 1) OVER (ORDER BY u.creationdate) AS prev_user_post_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE (p.creationdate >= 1376168997040 OR p.creationdate IS NULL) AND (c.creationdate >= 1536323213974 OR c.creationdate IS NULL) AND (b.date >= 1373834527901 OR b.date IS NULL) AND (v.creationdate >= 1359957165986 OR v.creationdate IS NULL) AND (ph.creationdate >= 1340715916937 OR ph.creationdate IS NULL) AND (pl.creationdate >= 1561253575244 OR pl.creationdate IS NULL) AND u.reputation > 793634 AND p.score > 4747 AND p.viewcount > 105254 AND c.score > '1' AND v.bountyamount > '1' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) = 2023 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(c.creationdate)) = 2 AND DATE_PART('doy', TO_TIMESTAMP(b.date)) BETWEEN 77 AND 309 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 46 AND SUM(p.viewcount) > 6124577 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 293 AND COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) > 952 AND AVG(p.answercount) > 7 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, total_views DESC LIMIT 386;

WITH user_post_stats AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1281445204168 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation ), comment_engagement AS ( SELECT c.userid, COUNT(c.id) AS total_comments, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT c.postid) AS distinct_posts_commented FROM comments c WHERE c.creationdate >= 1424149984123 GROUP BY c.userid ), vote_analysis AS ( SELECT v.userid, COUNT(v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_given, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes_given, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty_given FROM votes v WHERE v.creationdate >= 1383056109730 GROUP BY v.userid ), badge_summary AS ( SELECT b.userid, COUNT(b.id) AS total_badges, MIN(b.date) AS first_badge_date, MAX(b.date) AS last_badge_date FROM badges b WHERE b.date >= 1463515870042 GROUP BY b.userid ), post_history_trend AS ( SELECT ph.userid, COUNT(ph.id) AS total_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.postid) AS distinct_posts_edited, MAX(ph.creationdate) AS latest_edit_date FROM posthistory ph WHERE ph.creationdate >= 1602253574446 GROUP BY ph.userid ), post_link_network AS ( SELECT pl.postid, COUNT(pl.id) AS total_links, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS distinct_related_posts FROM postlinks pl WHERE pl.creationdate >= 1287720087273 GROUP BY pl.postid ), combined_metrics AS ( SELECT ups.user_id, ups.reputation, ups.total_posts, ups.total_post_score, ups.avg_viewcount, ce.total_comments, ce.avg_comment_score, ce.distinct_posts_commented, va.total_votes, va.upvotes_given, va.downvotes_given, va.total_bounty_given, bs.total_badges, pht.total_history_events, pht.distinct_posts_edited, pln.total_links, pln.distinct_related_posts, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ups.reputation DESC) AS reputation_rank, AVG(ups.total_post_score) OVER (ORDER BY ups.latest_post_date ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_post_score FROM user_post_stats ups LEFT JOIN comment_engagement ce ON ups.user_id = ce.userid LEFT JOIN vote_analysis va ON ups.user_id = va.userid LEFT JOIN badge_summary bs ON ups.user_id = bs.userid LEFT JOIN post_history_trend pht ON ups.user_id = pht.userid LEFT JOIN posts p ON ups.user_id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN post_link_network pln ON p.id = pln.postid WHERE ups.reputation > 63819 GROUP BY ups.user_id, ups.reputation, ups.total_posts, ups.total_post_score, ups.avg_viewcount, ce.total_comments, ce.avg_comment_score, ce.distinct_posts_commented, va.total_votes, va.upvotes_given, va.downvotes_given, va.total_bounty_given, bs.total_badges, pht.total_history_events, pht.distinct_posts_edited, pln.total_links, pln.distinct_related_posts, ups.latest_post_date ) SELECT user_id, reputation, total_posts, total_post_score, avg_viewcount, total_comments, avg_comment_score, distinct_posts_commented, total_votes, upvotes_given, downvotes_given, total_bounty_given, total_badges, total_history_events, distinct_posts_edited, total_links, distinct_related_posts, reputation_rank, moving_avg_post_score, SUM(total_posts + total_comments + total_votes + total_badges) OVER (PARTITION BY reputation_rank / 100 ORDER BY user_id) AS cumulative_engagement FROM combined_metrics WHERE total_post_score > 1232 AND total_comments > 606 ORDER BY reputation_rank, cumulative_engagement DESC LIMIT 626;

JOIN badge_summary bs ON ups.user_id = bs.userid LEFT JOIN post_history_trend pht ON ups.user_id = pht.userid LEFT JOIN posts p ON ups.user_id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN post_link_network pln ON p.id = SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date, MIN(u.creationdate) AS user_creation_date, (SELECT AVG(sub_p.score) FROM posts sub_p WHERE sub_p.owneruserid = u.id AND sub_p.posttypeid = 1) AS avg_question_score, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes sub_v WHERE sub_v.userid = u.id AND sub_v.votetypeid = 2) AS total_upvotes_given FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid AND p.posttypeid IN (1, 2) AND p.creationdate >= 1416587753120 AND p.creationdate <= 1286293362713 LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid AND c.creationdate >= 1460419732270 AND c.creationdate <= 1453971693545 LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.creationdate >= 1606156937176 AND v.creationdate <= 1376734592798 LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid AND b.date >= 1574979122890 AND b.date <= 1408396724924 LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid AND ph.creationdate >= 1531530057661 AND ph.creationdate <= 1451263118213 LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.creationdate >= 1269155494907 AND pl.creationdate <= 1523506609544 LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE u.reputation > 380473 AND u.views > 546907 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > (SELECT AVG(post_count) FROM (SELECT owneruserid, COUNT(*) AS post_count FROM posts WHERE posttypeid IN (1, 2) GROUP BY owneruserid) sub) AND SUM(p.score) > 3922 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, u.reputation DESC LIMIT 994;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.score) AS median_post_score, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c.score) AS median_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date, MIN(p.creationdate) AS earliest_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE u.reputation > 216700 AND p.creationdate >= 1277786569093 AND p.creationdate <= 1315768581914 AND p.score > 439 AND c.creationdate >= 1549679494582 AND c.creationdate <= 1515023438148 AND v.creationdate >= 1452038519876 AND v.creationdate <= 1597592792279 AND ph.creationdate >= 1552955343879 AND ph.creationdate <= 1281669417619 AND pl.creationdate >= 1538429007185 AND pl.creationdate <= 1389503683180 AND b.date >= 1472098984594 AND b.date <= 1340484201430 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 91 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 71 AND COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) > 335 AND SUM(p.score) > 6116 AND SUM(c.score) > '1' AND SUM(v.bountyamount) > '50' ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, total_comment_score DESC, total_bounty DESC LIMIT 268;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.score) AS median_post_score, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.viewcount) AS p75_post_views, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY u.reputation) AS p90_user_reputation FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1514207406432 AND p.creationdate <= 1294145516203 AND u.creationdate >= 1367835526149 AND u.creationdate <= 1462223070130 AND p.score > 720 AND u.reputation > 571825 AND v.creationdate >= 1577154448694 AND v.creationdate <= 1408493279408 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 861 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 3082 AND SUM(p.viewcount) > 415708 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, total_views DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(c.score) AS max_comment_score, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges b WHERE b.userid = u.id AND b.date BETWEEN 1373556377819 AND 1585560970795) AS badge_count_in_range, (SELECT SUM(v.bountyamount) FROM votes v WHERE v.userid = u.id AND v.votetypeid = '1' AND v.creationdate >= 1288385271879) AS total_bounty_received FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid JOIN votes v2 ON p.id = v2.postid WHERE u.reputation > 85529 AND p.creationdate >= 1513571966262 AND p.posttypeid = '1' AND ph.posthistorytypeid IN ('1', '1') AND pl.linktypeid = '1' AND v2.votetypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 70 AND SUM(p.score) >= 279 ORDER BY total_score DESC, badge_count_in_range DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes_received, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.score) AS median_post_score, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.viewcount) AS p75_post_views, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY u.reputation) AS p90_user_reputation FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1459228471202 AND p.creationdate <= 1483261534804 AND u.reputation > 171063 AND p.score > 6288 AND v.creationdate >= 1580803427991 AND v.creationdate <= 1507007806764 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 35 AND SUM(p.viewcount) > 608550 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, total_views DESC LIMIT 900;

JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid WHERE p.score >= 804 AND p.creationdate BETWEEN 1459638469 AND 1348735336 GROUP BY p.id, p.owneruserid, p.posttypeid, p.score, p.viewcount, p.creationdate ), tag_analysis AS ( SELECT t.id AS tag_id, t.count AS tag_usage_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS distinct_tagged_posts, tags t LEFT JOIN posts p ON t.excerptpostid = p.id LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE t.count >= 47237 GROUP BY t.id, t.count ) SELECT ua.user_id, ua.reputation, ua.distinct_posts, ua.distinct_comments, ua.distinct_votes, ua.distinct_badges, ua.distinct_post_history, ua.distinct_post_links, ua.total_post_score, ua.total_views, ua.total_answers, ua.total_post_comments, ua.total_favorites, ua.avg_post_score, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.post_id) AS active_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT ta.tag_id) AS used_tags, SUM(pm.vote_count) AS total_post_votes, SUM(pm.comment_count) AS total_post_comments_agg, AVG(pm.score) AS avg_active_post_score, MAX(pm.viewcount) AS max_post_views, SUM(pm.upvote_count) AS total_upvotes_received, SUM(pm.downvote_count) AS total_downvotes_received, MAX(pm.max_bounty) AS highest_bounty_received, SUM(ta.tag_usage_count) AS total_tag_usage, AVG(ta.avg_tag_score) AS avg_tag_score_per_user, SUM(ta.total_tag_views) AS total_tag_views_contributed, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ua.total_post_score DESC) AS score_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ua.distinct_posts DESC) AS post_count_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ua.total_views DESC) >= 4349 AND (pm.vote_count >= 572 OR pm.vote_count IS NULL) GROUP BY ua.user_id, ua.reputation, ua.distinct_posts, ua.distinct_comments, ua.distinct_votes, ua.distinct_badges, SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, MAX(v.bountyamount) AS max_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) FILTER (WHERE ph.posthistorytypeid = '1') AS specific_history_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts p2 WHERE p2.owneruserid = u.id AND p2.posttypeid = 1 AND p2.creationdate >= 1333858023002) AS recent_questions FROM users u LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid AND b.date BETWEEN 1587742561691 AND 1448961097468 LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND v.votetypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = '1' WHERE u.reputation > 133635 AND u.creationdate <= 1366844644056 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) >= 55 AND AVG(c.score) > '0' AND SUM(p.viewcount) < 2819364 ORDER BY total_views DESC, user_id;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1423826656064 AND p.score > 65 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 11 ORDER BY post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) OVER (PARTITION BY u.id) AS avg_post_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1494932317696 AND p.score > 84 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, p.score ORDER BY post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1270833349673 AND p.score > 42 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 16 INTERSECT SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score FROM users u JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid WHERE c.creationdate >= 1349969714390 AND c.score > '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 22 ORDER BY reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(c.score) AS max_comment_score, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS link_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE p.posttypeid = '1' AND p.creationdate >= 1540199043 AND p.score > 215 AND v.votetypeid = '1' AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' AND pl.linktypeid = '1' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tags t WHERE t.excerptpostid = p.id AND t.count > 2660) AND u.reputation >= 60474 AND u.creationdate <= 1487961695 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 11 AND SUM(p.score) >= 1901 ORDER BY total_score DESC, post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, MAX(p.viewcount) AS max_view_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.votetypeid = 8 LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid AND ph.posthistorytypeid = 2 LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = 1 LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE u.creationdate >= 1525930970 AND u.reputation > 218 AND u.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT p2.owneruserid FROM posts p2 WHERE p2.creationdate BETWEEN 1548180652 AND 1273488142 AND p2.score > 331 AND p2.posttypeid = 1 ) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 31 AND AVG(p.score) < 581 AND SUM(v.bountyamount) >= '50' ORDER BY total_posts DESC, total_bounty DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH user_post_stats AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1598823458064 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 55 ), comment_engagement AS ( ph.userid AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' WHERE c.creationdate BETWEEN 1533993904813 AND 1475402452711 GROUP BY c.userid ), vote_analysis AS ( SELECT v.userid, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = '1' THEN v.postid END) AS upvote_posts FROM votes v WHERE v.creationdate >= 1372072586539 GROUP BY v.userid HAVING SUM(v.bountyamount) > '50' ), badge_counts AS ( SELECT b.userid, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, MIN(b.date) AS first_badge_date FROM badges b WHERE b.date <= 1447288240379 GROUP BY b.userid ), post_link_network AS ( SELECT pl.postid, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS linked_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS tag_count FROM postlinks pl LEFT JOIN tags t ON pl.postid = t.excerptpostid WHERE DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY va.total_votes DESC) AS vote_rank, LAG(ups.total_posts, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ups.user_id ORDER BY ups.latest_post_date) AS prev_post_count FROM user_post_stats ups JOIN comment_engagement ce ON ups.user_id = ce.userid JOIN vote_analysis va ON ups.user_id = va.userid LEFT JOIN badge_counts bc ON ups.user_id = bc.userid LEFT JOIN posts p ON ups.user_id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN post_link_network pln ON p.id = pln.postid WHERE ups.reputation > 40505 AND ce.total_comments > 416 GROUP BY ups.user_id, ups.reputation, ups.total_posts, ups.total_post_score,
