SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes_received, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, MAX(p.viewcount) AS max_post_views, SUM(CASE WHEN ph.posthistorytypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS edit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS linked_posts_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.favoritecount) DESC) AS favorite_count_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid AND p.posttypeid = 1 LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid IN (2,5) LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = 1 LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE u.creationdate >= 1480130640 AND u.reputation >= 729859 AND (p.creationdate >= 1463479990 OR p.creationdate IS NULL) AND (v.creationdate >= 1550182702 OR v.creationdate IS NULL) AND (b.date >= 1323467418 OR b.date IS NULL) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 88 AND SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 853 AND AVG(p.score) <= 127 ORDER BY total_posts DESC, upvotes_received DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM postlinks pl WHERE pl.postid IN (SELECT p2.id FROM posts p2 WHERE p2.owneruserid = u.id AND p2.creationdate >= 1433474213868)) AS total_postlinks, (SELECT MAX(ph.creationdate) FROM posthistory ph WHERE ph.userid = u.id AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1') AS latest_posthistory_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid AND p.posttypeid = '1' AND p.creationdate >= 1520832928063 LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid AND c.creationdate >= 1283888892951 LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid AND b.date >= 1360763260702 LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.votetypeid = '1' AND v.creationdate >= 1461798804634 WHERE u.reputation >= 902315 AND u.creationdate <= 1492565300632 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 827 AND SUM(p.score) >= 2279 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, u.reputation DESC LIMIT 290;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answer_count_per_post, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid AND p.posttypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.votetypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid AND b.date BETWEEN 1284583334626 AND 1442839744858 LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE u.reputation > 411831 AND u.creationdate >= 1344603591654 AND (p.creationdate BETWEEN 1533786799518 AND 1359747727742 OR p.creationdate IS NULL) AND (c.creationdate BETWEEN 1551474083955 AND 1444775735324 OR c.creationdate IS NULL) AND (v.creationdate BETWEEN 1485187670247 AND 1407480331720 OR v.creationdate IS NULL) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 774 AND SUM(p.score) > 2874 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 2432 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, total_views DESC LIMIT 836;

WITH user_post_stats AS ( SELECT p.owneruserid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM posts p WHERE p.posttypeid = 1 GROUP BY p.owneruserid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 15 ), comment_activity AS ( SELECT c.userid, COUNT(*) AS comment_count, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, MIN(c.creationdate) AS first_comment_date, MAX(c.creationdate) AS last_comment_date FROM comments c GROUP BY c.userid HAVING AVG(c.score) > '1' ), vote_analysis AS ( SELECT v.userid, COUNT(*) AS total_votes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes, AVG(v.bountyamount) AS avg_bounty FROM votes v WHERE v.creationdate >= 1529551340 GROUP BY v.userid HAVING COUNT(*) > 517 ), post_history_self_join AS ( SELECT ph1.postid, ph1.userid AS editor1, ph2.userid AS editor2, COUNT(*) AS edit_pairs_count, MIN(ph1.creationdate) AS first_edit_pair_date FROM posthistory ph1 JOIN posthistory ph2 ON ph1.postid = ph2.postid AND ph1.id < ph2.id AND ph1.posthistorytypeid = ph2.posthistorytypeid AND ph1.creationdate BETWEEN 1288706729 AND 1396707946 WHERE ph1.userid IS NOT NULL AND ph2.userid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ph1.postid, ph1.userid, ph2.userid ), linked_posts AS ( SELECT pl.postid, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS linked_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_linked_score FROM postlinks pl JOIN posts p ON pl.relatedpostid = p.id WHERE pl.linktypeid = 1 GROUP BY pl.postid ), user_aggregated AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.views AS profile_views, u.upvotes AS user_upvotes, u.downvotes AS user_downvotes, ups.total_posts, ups.total_score, ups.avg_views, ups.latest_post_date, ca.comment_count, ca.avg_comment_score, ca.first_comment_date, ca.last_comment_date, va.total_votes, va.upvotes AS vote_upvotes, va.downvotes AS vote_downvotes, va.avg_bounty, COALESCE(SUM(phs.edit_pairs_count), 0) AS total_edit_pairs, COALESCE(AVG(lp.linked_count), 0) AS avg_linked_posts, COALESCE(AVG(lp.avg_linked_score), 0) AS avg_linked_score FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_post_stats ups ON u.id = ups.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comment_activity ca ON u.id = ca.userid LEFT JOIN vote_analysis va ON u.id = va.userid LEFT JOIN post_history_self_join phs ON u.id = phs.editor1 OR u.id = phs.editor2 LEFT JOIN linked_posts lp ON u.id = (SELECT owneruserid FROM posts WHERE id = lp.postid) WHERE u.reputation > 41853 AND u.creationdate >= 1545117649 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.views, u.upvotes, u.downvotes, ups.total_posts, ups.total_score, ups.avg_views, ups.latest_post_date, ca.comment_count, ca.avg_comment_score, ca.first_comment_date, ca.last_comment_date, va.total_votes, va.upvotes, va.downvotes, va.avg_bounty ) SELECT user_id, reputation, profile_views, user_upvotes, user_downvotes, total_posts, total_score, avg_views, latest_post_date, comment_count, avg_comment_score, first_comment_date, last_comment_date, total_votes, vote_upvotes, vote_downvotes, avg_bounty, total_edit_pairs, avg_linked_posts, avg_linked_score, (total_score * 0.3 + avg_views * 0.2 + reputation * 0.5) AS engagement_score FROM user_aggregated WHERE total_posts IS NOT NULL AND comment_count IS NOT NULL AND total_votes IS NOT NULL ORDER BY engagement_score DESC, reputation DESC LIMIT 730;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1337613878004 AND p.creationdate <= 1486196956873 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM comments c WHERE c.postid = p.id AND c.score > '1') GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 12 ORDER BY post_count DESC, avg_post_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty_received FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND v.votetypeid = 8 WHERE p.creationdate >= 1296678711 AND p.posttypeid = 1 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM comments c WHERE c.postid = p.id AND c.score > '5' ) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 6 AND AVG(p.score) < 99 ORDER BY total_bounty_received DESC NULLS LAST, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, AVG(p.score) FILTER (WHERE p.score IS NOT NULL) AS avg_post_score, SUM(v.bountyamount) FILTER (WHERE v.bountyamount IS NOT NULL) AS total_bounty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY u.creationdate >= 1345459425 ORDER BY u.reputation DESC) AS rep_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.votetypeid = 8 WHERE u.reputation > 41021 AND u.creationdate >= 1351730111 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 9 AND AVG(p.score) FILTER (WHERE p.score IS NOT NULL) > 15 ORDER BY u.reputation DESC, total_bounty DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 303;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, COALESCE(SUM(v.bountyamount), 0) AS total_bounty, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.votetypeid = 8 WHERE u.creationdate >= 1266553609 AND u.reputation > 37973 AND (p.creationdate >= 1371582161 OR p.creationdate IS NULL) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 31 AND AVG(p.score) < 62 ORDER BY total_bounty DESC, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1400802524122 AND p.score > 31 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 33 AND SUM(p.score) >= 236 ORDER BY total_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date, (SUM(p.score) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.id), 0)) AS avg_post_score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1519504211337 AND p.creationdate <= 1588860975222 AND u.reputation >= 660703 AND p.score > 672 AND c.creationdate >= 1594320922457 AND c.creationdate <= 1380047576714 AND v.creationdate >= 1418446634086 AND v.creationdate <= 1270974991723 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 301 AND SUM(p.viewcount) > 971499 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 147 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.score) AS median_post_score, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.viewcount) AS p75_post_views, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY u.reputation) AS p90_user_reputation, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS rank_by_post_score, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS dense_rank_by_post_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1588532886916 AND p.creationdate <= 1299782592275 AND u.creationdate >= 1356058462419 AND u.creationdate <= 1585070566561 AND p.score > 909 AND u.reputation > 652631 AND v.creationdate >= 1360392856507 AND v.creationdate <= 1326761091142 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 871 AND SUM(p.viewcount) > 274612 AND PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.score) > 198 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, total_views DESC LIMIT 913;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_year, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answers, GROUPING(u.id, u.reputation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate))) AS grouping_id FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1594020368248 AND p.creationdate <= 1435456345518 AND p.score > 79 AND v.votetypeid = '1' GROUP BY CUBE(u.id, u.reputation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate))) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 95 ORDER BY total_posts DESC, total_score DESC;

WITH user_activity AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.creationdate AS user_creation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, SUM(p.favoritecount) AS total_favorites, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1297850511 OR c.creationdate >= 1575897806 OR b.date >= 1499798840 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate ), post_metrics AS ( SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.owneruserid, p.creationdate, p.score, p.viewcount, p.answercount, p.commentcount, p.favoritecount, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS edit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS link_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score FROM posts p LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid = 5 LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid WHERE p.creationdate BETWEEN 1493866989 AND 1625454356 GROUP BY p.id, p.owneruserid, p.creationdate, p.score, p.viewcount, p.answercount, p.commentcount, p.favoritecount ), tag_popularity AS ( SELECT t.id AS tag_id, t.count AS tag_usage_count, p.owneruserid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS posts_with_tag, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score FROM tags t JOIN posts p ON t.excerptpostid = p.id WHERE t.count > 700 GROUP BY t.id, t.count, p.owneruserid ) SELECT ua.user_id, ua.reputation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(ua.user_creation)) AS join_year, ua.post_count, ua.comment_count, ua.badge_count, ua.total_post_score, ua.total_views, ua.total_favorites, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.post_id) AS active_posts, SUM(pm.score) AS sum_post_scores, AVG(pm.viewcount) AS avg_post_views, SUM(pm.edit_count) AS total_edits, SUM(pm.link_count) AS total_links, SUM(pm.vote_count) AS total_votes, SUM(pm.upvotes) AS total_upvotes, SUM(pm.downvotes) AS total_downvotes, COUNT(DISTINCT tp.tag_id) AS distinct_tags_used, SUM(tp.tag_usage_count) AS total_tag_usage, AVG(tp.avg_post_score) AS avg_tag_post_score FROM user_activity ua JOIN post_metrics pm ON ua.user_id = pm.owneruserid LEFT JOIN tag_popularity tp ON ua.user_id = tp.owneruserid WHERE ua.reputation > 18281 AND ua.latest_post_date >= 1833255452 AND pm.creationdate >= 1809622410 GROUP BY ua.user_id, ua.reputation, ua.user_creation, ua.post_count, ua.comment_count, ua.badge_count, ua.total_post_score, ua.total_views, ua.total_favorites HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pm.post_id) > 14 AND SUM(pm.score) > 137 ORDER BY ua.reputation DESC, total_post_score DESC LIMIT 99;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1466258595620 AND p.score > 43 AND p.owneruserid IN ( SELECT userid FROM badges WHERE date >= 1499925592803 GROUP BY userid HAVING COUNT(*) >= 29 ) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 15 ORDER BY avg_post_score DESC;

WITH user_activity AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS distinct_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS distinct_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS distinct_votes, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS distinct_badges, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answer_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE u.creationdate >= 1434983266 AND u.reputation >= 9944 AND (p.creationdate >= 1571746073 OR p.creationdate IS NULL) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation ), post_network AS ( SELECT pl.postid, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS linked_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS history_entries, MAX(ph.creationdate) AS last_history_date FROM postlinks pl JOIN posthistory ph ON pl.postid = ph.postid WHERE pl.creationdate >= 1315806809 AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' GROUP BY pl.postid ), tag_summary AS ( SELECT t.id AS tag_id, t.count AS tag_usage, p.owneruserid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS posts_with_tag, SUM(p.favoritecount) AS total_favorites FROM tags t JOIN posts p ON t.excerptpostid = p.id WHERE t.count >= 2465 GROUP BY t.id, t.count, p.owneruserid ) SELECT ua.user_id, ua.reputation, ua.distinct_posts, ua.distinct_comments, ua.distinct_votes, ua.distinct_badges, ua.total_post_score, ua.total_views, ua.avg_answer_count, COALESCE(SUM(pn.linked_posts), 0) AS total_linked_posts, COALESCE(SUM(pn.history_entries), 0) AS total_history_entries, MAX(pn.last_history_date) AS max_history_date, COALESCE(SUM(ts.tag_usage), 0) AS total_tag_usage, COALESCE(SUM(ts.posts_with_tag), 0) AS total_tagged_posts, COALESCE(SUM(ts.total_favorites), 0) AS total_tag_favorites, COUNT(DISTINCT pn.postid) AS distinct_network_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT ts.tag_id) AS distinct_tags_used FROM user_activity ua LEFT JOIN post_network pn ON EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM posts p WHERE p.id = pn.postid AND p.owneruserid = ua.user_id ) LEFT JOIN tag_summary ts ON ua.user_id = ts.owneruserid WHERE ua.total_post_score > 609 OR ua.total_views > 34608 GROUP BY ua.user_id, ua.reputation, ua.distinct_posts, ua.distinct_comments, ua.distinct_votes, ua.distinct_badges, ua.total_post_score, ua.total_views, ua.avg_answer_count HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pn.postid) >= 99 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ts.tag_id) >= 9 ORDER BY ua.reputation DESC, total_linked_posts DESC LIMIT 757;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, MAX(p.viewcount) AS max_view_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS linked_posts_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.favoritecount) DESC) AS favorite_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.votetypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.creationdate >= 1293747687945 LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE u.reputation > 236556 AND u.creationdate >= 1520236904374 AND (p.creationdate >= 1594169720340 OR p.creationdate IS NULL) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 23 AND SUM(v.bountyamount) > '50' ORDER BY total_bounty DESC, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges b WHERE b.userid = u.id AND b.date >= 1391672574214) AS recent_badge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) FILTER (WHERE ph.posthistorytypeid = '1') AS specific_history_events, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty_received, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1474756993929 AND p.score > 684 AND u.reputation >= 921693 AND v.creationdate >= 1573673581267 AND ph.creationdate >= 1377118569982 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 95 AND SUM(p.score) > 8114 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) >= 316 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, post_count DESC LIMIT 678;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes_received, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, MAX(p.viewcount) AS max_post_views, SUM(p.favoritecount) AS total_favorites, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS linked_posts_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank, LAG(u.reputation, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY u.id ORDER BY p.creationdate) AS prev_reputation FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1380626006319 AND p.score > 668 AND u.reputation >= 404359 AND v.creationdate >= 1382217289734 AND b.date >= 1461368826069 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, p.creationdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 31 AND AVG(p.score) < 348 AND SUM(p.favoritecount) >= 120 ORDER BY total_posts DESC, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.score) AS median_post_score, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.viewcount) AS p75_post_views, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY u.reputation) AS p90_user_reputation FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE u.creationdate >= 1487648044795 AND p.creationdate >= 1291128778760 AND p.score > 831 AND v.creationdate >= 1399707479701 AND u.reputation BETWEEN 937054 AND 329748 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 753 AND SUM(p.viewcount) > 77599 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, total_views DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, badge_counts.badge_count, comment_counts.comment_score_sum, post_counts.post_score_sum FROM users u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT b.userid, COUNT(*) AS badge_count FROM badges b WHERE b.date >= 1361398101309 GROUP BY b.userid ) badge_counts ON u.id = badge_counts.userid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c.userid, SUM(c.score) AS comment_score_sum FROM comments c WHERE c.creationdate >= 1385352864502 GROUP BY c.userid ) comment_counts ON u.id = comment_counts.userid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.owneruserid, SUM(p.score) AS post_score_sum FROM posts p WHERE p.creationdate >= 1275668850958 GROUP BY p.owneruserid ) post_counts ON u.id = post_counts.owneruserid WHERE u.creationdate >= 1515030094675 AND u.reputation >= 11087 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, badge_counts.badge_count, comment_counts.comment_score_sum, post_counts.post_score_sum ORDER BY u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u1.id AS user1_id, u2.id AS user2_id, COUNT(DISTINCT b1.id) AS badges_user1, COUNT(DISTINCT b2.id) AS badges_user2, AVG(c1.score) AS avg_comment_score_user1, AVG(c2.score) AS avg_comment_score_user2, SUM(p1.score) AS total_post_score_user1, SUM(p2.score) AS total_post_score_user2, MAX(v1.bountyamount) AS max_bounty_user1, MAX(v2.bountyamount) AS max_bounty_user2, COUNT(DISTINCT ph1.postid) AS edited_posts_user1, COUNT(DISTINCT ph2.postid) AS edited_posts_user2, SUM(pl1.linktypeid) AS total_linktype_user1, SUM(pl2.linktypeid) AS total_linktype_user2, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (SUM(p1.score) + SUM(p2.score)) DESC) AS combined_score_rank FROM users u1 JOIN users u2 ON u1.creationdate < u2.creationdate AND u1.reputation > 168829.77 AND u2.reputation > 497411.82 LEFT JOIN badges b1 ON u1.id = b1.userid AND b1.date BETWEEN '0' AND '0' LEFT JOIN badges b2 ON u2.id = b2.userid AND b2.date BETWEEN '0' AND '0' LEFT JOIN comments c1 ON u1.id = c1.userid AND c1.creationdate >= '0' LEFT JOIN comments c2 ON u2.id = c2.userid AND c2.creationdate >= '0' LEFT JOIN posts p1 ON u1.id = p1.owneruserid AND p1.posttypeid = 1.64 LEFT JOIN posts p2 ON u2.id = p2.owneruserid AND p2.posttypeid = 7.12 LEFT JOIN votes v1 ON u1.id = v1.userid AND v1.votetypeid = 8.11 LEFT JOIN votes v2 ON u2.id = v2.userid AND v2.votetypeid = 4.81 LEFT JOIN posthistory ph1 ON u1.id = ph1.userid AND ph1.posthistorytypeid = 40.3 LEFT JOIN posthistory ph2 ON u2.id = ph2.userid AND ph2.posthistorytypeid = 24.81 LEFT JOIN postlinks pl1 ON p1.id = pl1.postid AND pl1.linktypeid IN (5.6, 7.5) LEFT JOIN postlinks pl2 ON p2.id = pl2.postid AND pl2.linktypeid IN (1.23, 8.2) WHERE u1.views > 9396.62 AND u2.views > 36141.25 GROUP BY u1.id, u2.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b1.id) + COUNT(DISTINCT b2.id) > 433.4 AND AVG(c1.score) + AVG(c2.score) < 90.42 ORDER BY combined_score_rank, u1.id, u2.id;

WITH user_post_stats AS ( SELECT p.owneruserid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM posts p WHERE p.owneruserid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.owneruserid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 59 ), comment_engagement AS ( SELECT c.userid, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, MIN(c.creationdate) AS first_comment_date FROM comments c WHERE c.userid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.userid HAVING AVG(c.score) > '0' ), vote_analysis AS ( SELECT v.userid, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT v.postid) AS voted_posts_count FROM votes v WHERE v.userid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY v.userid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) BETWEEN 418 AND 7340 ), post_history_trend AS ( SELECT ph1.userid, ph1.postid, COUNT(DISTINCT ph2.id) AS history_entries_count, MIN(ph2.creationdate) AS earliest_history_date FROM posthistory ph1 JOIN posthistory ph2 ON ph1.postid = ph2.postid AND ph1.userid = ph2.userid AND ph1.creationdate < ph2.creationdate WHERE ph1.userid IS NOT NULL AND ph2.userid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ph1.userid, ph1.postid ), badge_activity AS ( SELECT b.userid, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, MAX(b.date) AS latest_badge_date FROM badges b WHERE b.userid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY b.userid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) > 35 ), linked_posts AS ( SELECT pl1.postid, COUNT(DISTINCT pl2.relatedpostid) AS related_links_count, AVG(pl2.linktypeid) AS avg_link_type FROM postlinks pl1 JOIN postlinks pl2 ON pl1.postid = pl2.postid AND pl1.creationdate <= pl2.creationdate GROUP BY pl1.postid ) SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.views AS profile_views, ups.total_posts, ups.total_score AS post_total_score, ups.avg_views, ce.total_comments, ce.avg_comment_score, va.total_votes, va.total_bounty, va.voted_posts_count, ba.badge_count, ba.latest_badge_date, COUNT(DISTINCT pht.postid) AS posts_with_history, AVG(pht.history_entries_count) AS avg_history_entries, SUM(lp.related_links_count) AS total_related_links, AVG(lp.avg_link_type) AS overall_avg_link_type FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_post_stats ups ON u.id = ups.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comment_engagement ce ON u.id = ce.userid LEFT JOIN vote_analysis va ON u.id = va.userid LEFT JOIN badge_activity ba ON u.id = ba.userid LEFT JOIN post_history_trend pht ON u.id = pht.userid LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN linked_posts lp ON p.id = lp.postid WHERE u.creationdate >= 1262999771 AND u.reputation > 35732 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.views, ups.total_posts, ups.total_score, ups.avg_views, ce.total_comments, ce.avg_comment_score, va.total_votes, va.total_bounty, va.voted_posts_count, ba.badge_count, ba.latest_badge_date HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 2 AND AVG(pht.history_entries_count) < 51 ORDER BY u.reputation DESC, total_related_links DESC LIMIT 541;

WITH user_post_stats AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1557813691094 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation ), comment_engagement AS ( SELECT c.userid, COUNT(c.id) AS total_comments, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT c.postid) AS distinct_posts_commented FROM comments c WHERE c.creationdate >= 1596225522462 GROUP BY c.userid ), vote_analysis AS ( SELECT v.userid, COUNT(v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_given, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes_given, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty_given FROM votes v WHERE v.creationdate >= 1413728899447 GROUP BY v.userid ), badge_achievements AS ( SELECT b.userid, COUNT(b.id) AS total_badges, MIN(b.date) AS first_badge_date, MAX(b.date) AS latest_badge_date FROM badges b WHERE b.date >= 1341277780401 GROUP BY b.userid ), post_history_tracking AS ( SELECT ph.userid, COUNT(ph.id) AS total_history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.postid) AS distinct_posts_edited FROM posthistory ph WHERE ph.creationdate >= 1447441272141 GROUP BY ph.userid ), post_link_network AS ( SELECT pl.postid, COUNT(pl.id) AS total_links, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS distinct_related_posts FROM postlinks pl WHERE pl.creationdate >= 1341643579951 GROUP BY pl.postid ), tag_popularity AS ( SELECT t.id AS tag_id, t.count AS tag_usage_count, t.excerptpostid, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts p2 WHERE p2.id = t.excerptpostid AND p2.score > 16) AS high_score_excerpt FROM tags t WHERE t.count > 3581 ), nested_aggregation AS ( SELECT ups.user_id, ups.reputation, ups.total_posts, ups.total_post_score, ups.avg_viewcount, ups.latest_post_date, COALESCE(ce.total_comments, 0) AS total_comments, COALESCE(ce.avg_comment_score, 0) AS avg_comment_score, COALESCE(ce.distinct_posts_commented, 0) AS distinct_posts_commented, COALESCE(va.total_votes, 0) AS total_votes, COALESCE(va.upvotes_given, 0) AS upvotes_given, COALESCE(va.downvotes_given, 0) AS downvotes_given, COALESCE(va.total_bounty_given, 0) AS total_bounty_given, COALESCE(ba.total_badges, 0) AS total_badges, ba.first_badge_date, ba.latest_badge_date, COALESCE(pht.total_history_entries, 0) AS total_history_entries, COALESCE(pht.distinct_posts_edited, 0) AS distinct_posts_edited, (SELECT SUM(pln.total_links) FROM post_link_network pln WHERE pln.postid IN (SELECT p3.id FROM posts p3 WHERE p3.owneruserid = ups.user_id)) AS total_post_links, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tp.tag_id) FROM tag_popularity tp WHERE tp.excerptpostid IN (SELECT p4.id FROM posts p4 WHERE p4.owneruserid = ups.user_id)) AS distinct_popular_tags_used FROM user_post_stats ups LEFT JOIN comment_engagement ce ON ups.user_id = ce.userid LEFT JOIN vote_analysis va ON ups.user_id = va.userid LEFT JOIN badge_achievements ba ON ups.user_id = ba.userid LEFT JOIN post_history_tracking pht ON ups.user_id = pht.userid WHERE ups.reputation > 26239 ) SELECT na.user_id, na.reputation, na.total_posts, na.total_post_score, na.avg_viewcount, na.total_comments, na.avg_comment_score, na.total_votes, na.upvotes_given, na.downvotes_given, na.total_bounty_given, na.total_badges, na.total_history_entries, na.total_post_links, na.distinct_popular_tags_used, (na.total_post_score * 0.3 + na.avg_comment_score * 0.2 + na.reputation * 0.5) AS engagement_score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (na.total_post_score * 0.3 + na.avg_comment_score * 0.2 + na.reputation * 0.5) DESC) AS engagement_rank FROM nested_aggregation na WHERE na.total_posts > 45 OR na.total_comments > 29 ORDER BY engagement_score DESC LIMIT 348;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, SUM(p.score) AS sum_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS rank_by_score, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.id), 1) OVER (ORDER BY u.creationdate) AS prev_user_post_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1587641437576 AND p.score > 454 AND u.reputation >= 625492 AND v.creationdate >= 1574486313886 AND ph.creationdate >= 1298818466684 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 16 AND SUM(p.score) > 4451 ORDER BY total_posts DESC, sum_post_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1544117522326 AND p.score > 10 AND p.owneruserid IN (SELECT userid FROM badges WHERE date >= 1349833552484) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 27 ORDER BY avg_post_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND v.votetypeid = 8 JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1432055254306 AND p.creationdate <= 1433105912652 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM badges b WHERE b.userid = u.id AND b.date >= 1609349040753) AND p.posttypeid = 1 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 66 AND AVG(p.score) >= 98 ORDER BY total_bounty DESC NULLS LAST, post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1386811590284 AND p.score > 73 AND u.reputation >= 55007 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 39 ORDER BY post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(c.creationdate) AS latest_comment_date, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges b WHERE b.userid = u.id AND b.date >= 1287754672448) AS recent_badges, (SELECT SUM(v.bountyamount) FROM votes v WHERE v.userid = u.id AND v.votetypeid = 7 AND v.creationdate BETWEEN 1301338054107 AND 1390496113939) AS total_bounty, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ph.postid) FROM posthistory ph WHERE ph.userid = u.id AND ph.posthistorytypeid IN (2,5) AND ph.creationdate >= (SELECT MIN(creationdate) FROM posts WHERE owneruserid = u.id AND posttypeid = 1)) AS edited_questions FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid JOIN tags t ON t.excerptpostid = p.id WHERE u.reputation > 346392 AND p.creationdate >= 1287788386517 AND p.posttypeid = 1 AND pl.linktypeid = 1 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 97 AND SUM(p.score) >= 684 ORDER BY total_score DESC, post_count DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(c.score) AS max_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1421480730214 AND p.creationdate <= 1310952028316 AND u.reputation > 675895 AND p.score > 477 AND v.votetypeid = '1' AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 54 AND SUM(p.score) < 99675 ORDER BY total_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) DESC) AS comment_count_rank FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE ( p.score > 383 OR p.viewcount > 17203 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM posts p2 WHERE p2.owneruserid = u.id AND p2.answercount > 52 ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM votes v2 WHERE v2.userid = u.id AND v2.votetypeid = '1' ) ) AND p.creationdate >= 1325583639545 AND c.creationdate >= 1414857986157 AND v.creationdate >= 1305798321428 AND b.date >= 1363756516159 AND ph.creationdate >= 1539182907490 AND pl.creationdate >= 1547310682219 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 716 AND SUM(p.score) > 7475 AND AVG(p.viewcount) > 286 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, total_comments DESC LIMIT 15;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) + SUM(c.score) + SUM(v.bountyamount) DESC) AS user_engagement_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid AND p.posttypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid AND b.date >= 1513256286667 LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.votetypeid = '1' AND v.creationdate >= 1382862954684 LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = '1' WHERE u.reputation >= 112222 AND u.creationdate <= 1318695670382 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 488 AND SUM(p.viewcount) >= 379274 ORDER BY user_engagement_rank;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, COUNT(b.id) AS badge_count FROM users u JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE b.date >= 1417186515055 AND u.reputation > 975911 GROUP BY u.id HAVING COUNT(b.id) > 11 ORDER BY badge_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(c.creationdate) AS latest_comment_date, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS score_rank FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1380477485802 AND p.score > 16 AND v.creationdate >= 1532717759418 AND u.reputation >= 10992 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 21 AND SUM(p.score) > 151 ORDER BY total_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(p.score) AS sum_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS sum_post_views, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answer_count, MAX(p.favoritecount) AS max_favorite_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS distinct_related_posts, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS rank_by_post_score, LAG(u.reputation, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY u.id ORDER BY p.creationdate) AS prev_reputation FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1338888865086 AND p.creationdate <= 1333513598185 AND p.score > 509 AND u.reputation >= 161298 AND v.votetypeid = '1' AND p.posttypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, p.creationdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 78 AND SUM(p.viewcount) < 325256 ORDER BY total_posts DESC, sum_post_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(c.score) AS max_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS history_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS link_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1450688137239 AND p.creationdate <= 1296356060951 AND u.reputation > 648961 AND p.score > 3122 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tags t WHERE t.excerptpostid = p.id AND t.count > 25137 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 5) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 182 AND SUM(p.score) < 416424 AND AVG(p.viewcount) BETWEEN 48401 AND 18695 ORDER BY total_score DESC, post_count ASC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, SUM(CASE WHEN p.posttypeid = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS question_count, SUM(CASE WHEN p.posttypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answer_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges b WHERE b.userid = u.id AND b.date >= 1474150774072) AS recent_badges, (SELECT AVG(score) FROM comments c WHERE c.userid = u.id AND c.creationdate >= 1581508802295) AS avg_comment_score, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes v WHERE v.userid = u.id AND v.votetypeid = 2 AND v.creationdate BETWEEN 1265423980310 AND 1578813982795) AS upvotes_received, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ph.postid) FROM posthistory ph WHERE ph.userid = u.id AND ph.posthistorytypeid IN (2,5) AND ph.creationdate >= 1532863813740) AS edited_posts, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date, SUM(p.favoritecount) AS total_favorites FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN votes v2 ON p.id = v2.postid JOIN comments c2 ON p.id = c2.postid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE u.reputation > 227530 AND p.creationdate >= 1309475595095 AND p.score > 251 AND v2.votetypeid = '1' AND c2.score > '0' AND pl.linktypeid = '1' AND t.count > 2799 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 191 AND SUM(p.score) > 3238 AND AVG(p.viewcount) < 224291 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, recent_badges DESC LIMIT 991;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answers_per_post, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date, MIN(u.creationdate) AS user_creation_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT c.id), 1) OVER (ORDER BY u.creationdate) AS prev_user_comment_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid AND p.posttypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid AND c.creationdate BETWEEN 1581947639007 AND 1453215998822 LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.votetypeid IN ('1', '1') LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid AND b.date >= 1606373192329 LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE u.reputation > 371481 AND (p.score > 289 OR p.score IS NULL) AND (c.score >= '0' OR c.score IS NULL) AND (v.bountyamount > '0' OR v.bountyamount IS NULL) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 11 AND SUM(p.viewcount) > 665875 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) < 2624 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, total_views DESC LIMIT 581;

WITH user_activity AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.creationdate AS user_creation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, SUM(p.answercount) AS total_answers, SUM(p.commentcount) AS total_post_comments, SUM(p.favoritecount) AS total_favorites, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1592332321072 OR c.creationdate >= 1386715577700 OR b.date >= 1441911248888 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate ), post_metrics AS ( SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.owneruserid, p.posttypeid, p.creationdate, p.score, p.viewcount, p.answercount, p.commentcount, p.favoritecount, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS edit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS link_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes, AVG(v.bountyamount) FILTER (WHERE v.bountyamount IS NOT NULL) AS avg_bounty FROM posts p LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid IN (2,5,8) LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = 1 LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate BETWEEN 1492105829587 AND 1387483358419 GROUP BY p.id, p.owneruserid, p.posttypeid, p.creationdate, p.score, p.viewcount, p.answercount, p.commentcount, p.favoritecount ), windowed_analysis AS ( SELECT ua.user_id, ua.reputation, ua.user_creation, ua.post_count, ua.comment_count, ua.badge_count, ua.total_post_score, ua.total_views, ua.total_answers, ua.total_post_comments, ua.total_favorites, ua.latest_post_date, pm.post_id, pm.posttypeid, pm.creationdate AS post_creation, pm.score AS post_score, pm.viewcount AS post_views, pm.answercount AS post_answers, pm.commentcount AS post_comments, pm.favoritecount AS post_favorites, pm.edit_count, pm.link_count, pm.vote_count, pm.upvotes, pm.downvotes, pm.avg_bounty, AVG(pm.score) OVER ( PARTITION BY pm.owneruserid ORDER BY pm.creationdate ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_score, SUM(pm.viewcount) OVER ( PARTITION BY pm.owneruserid ORDER BY pm.creationdate ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_sum_views, COUNT(pm.post_id) OVER ( PARTITION BY pm.owneruserid ORDER BY pm.creationdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_posts FROM user_activity ua INNER JOIN post_metrics pm ON ua.user_id = pm.owneruserid WHERE ua.reputation > 16806 AND pm.score > 332 ), tag_aggregation AS ( SELECT t.id AS tag_id, t.count AS tag_usage, t.excerptpostid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS tagged_posts, AVG(p.score) AS avg_tag_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_tag_views FROM tags t LEFT JOIN posts p ON t.excerptpostid = p.id OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM posthistory ph2 WHERE ph2.postid = p.id AND ph2.posthistorytypeid = 1 ) WHERE t.count >= 229 GROUP BY t.id, t.count, t.excerptpostid ) SELECT wa.user_id, wa.reputation, wa.post_count, wa.comment_count, wa.badge_count, wa.total_post_score, wa.total_views, wa.total_answers, wa.total_post_comments, wa.total_favorites, wa.latest_post_date, wa.post_id, wa.posttypeid, wa.post_creation, wa.post_score, wa.post_views, wa.post_answers, wa.post_comments, wa.post_favorites, wa.edit_count, wa.link_count, wa.vote_count, wa.upvotes, wa.downvotes, wa.avg_bounty, wa.moving_avg_score, wa.moving_sum_views, wa.cumulative_posts, ta.tag_id, ta.tag_usage, ta.tagged_posts, ta.avg_tag_score, ta.total_tag_views, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY wa.total_post_score DESC) AS user_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY wa.posttypeid ORDER BY wa.post_score DESC) AS post_type_rank, LAG(wa.post_score, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY wa.user_id ORDER BY wa.post_creation) AS prev_post_score FROM windowed_analysis wa LEFT JOIN tag_aggregation ta ON wa.post_id = ta.excerptpostid WHERE wa.moving_avg_score > 139.75 AND wa.moving_sum_views < 83353 ORDER BY wa.total_post_score DESC, wa.post_creation ASC LIMIT 2632;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.creationdate AS user_creation, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges b WHERE b.userid = u.id AND b.date >= 1503757027918) AS recent_badges, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.userid = u.id AND c.score > '5') AS high_score_comments, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE u.reputation >= 85107 AND p.creationdate >= 1382882366085 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate HAVING SUM(p.score) > 8004 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1477977563606 AND p.creationdate <= 1572115987252 AND u.reputation > 912146 AND p.score > 791 AND v.creationdate >= 1348939633100 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 37 AND SUM(p.score) > 4203 EXCEPT SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1405095760844 AND p.creationdate <= 1568872579429 AND u.reputation <= 456 AND p.score <= -72 AND v.creationdate < 1228473072254 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) <= 1 OR SUM(p.score) <= 68 ORDER BY post_score_rank;

SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.owneruserid, p.score, p.viewcount, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.owneruserid = u.id LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND v.votetypeid = 7 WHERE p.posttypeid = 1 AND p.owneruserid IN (SELECT userid FROM badges WHERE date >= 1399131492543) GROUP BY p.id, p.owneruserid, p.score, p.viewcount, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 29 AND SUM(v.bountyamount) >= '0' ORDER BY total_bounty DESC, p.score DESC;
