SELECT u.id AS user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1294702554006 AND p.score > 13 GROUP BY u.id HAVING SUM(p.score) > 102 ORDER BY total_score DESC;

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count FROM posts p LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1319935348730 AND p.creationdate <= 1407423949962 AND p.score > 20 GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 292 ORDER BY post_year DESC, post_quarter DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received FROM users u LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid AND b.date >= 1308588565997 LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND v.creationdate >= 1556614449673 WHERE u.reputation > 817144 GROUP BY u.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) > 85 UNION ALL SELECT u.id AS user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score FROM users u LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid AND c.creationdate >= 1547909329579 WHERE u.views < 66264 GROUP BY u.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) BETWEEN 33 AND 66 ORDER BY user_id;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, MAX(b.date) AS latest_badge_date FROM users u JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE u.reputation > 923987.44 AND b.date >= 1477336592390 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation UNION ALL SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, MAX(c.creationdate) AS latest_comment_date FROM users u JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid WHERE u.reputation > 836847.27 AND c.creationdate >= 1267283215010 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation ORDER BY reputation DESC;

WITH user_post_stats AS ( SELECT p.owneruserid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM posts p WHERE p.posttypeid = 1 GROUP BY p.owneruserid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 25 ), comment_engagement AS ( SELECT c.userid, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score, MIN(c.creationdate) AS first_comment_date FROM comments c GROUP BY c.userid HAVING AVG(c.score) > '1' ), vote_analysis AS ( SELECT v.userid, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, COUNT(DISTINCT v.postid) AS distinct_posts_voted FROM votes v WHERE v.votetypeid IN (1,2,3) GROUP BY v.userid HAVING SUM(v.bountyamount) >= '50' ), post_history_trend AS ( SELECT ph1.userid, COUNT(DISTINCT ph1.postid) AS posts_with_history, COUNT(DISTINCT ph2.id) AS total_history_entries FROM posthistory ph1 JOIN posthistory ph2 ON ph1.userid = ph2.userid AND ph1.postid = ph2.postid AND ph1.creationdate < ph2.creationdate WHERE ph1.posthistorytypeid = 2 GROUP BY ph1.userid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ph2.id) > 13 ), badge_achievers AS ( SELECT b1.userid, COUNT(DISTINCT b1.id) AS total_badges, MIN(b2.date) AS earliest_badge_date FROM badges b1 JOIN badges b2 ON b1.userid = b2.userid AND b1.date <= b2.date WHERE b1.date >= 1263086260 GROUP BY b1.userid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b1.id) >= 5 ) SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.views, u.upvotes, u.downvotes, ups.total_posts, ups.total_score, ups.avg_views, ce.total_comments, ce.avg_comment_score, va.total_votes, va.total_bounty, va.distinct_posts_voted, pht.posts_with_history, pht.total_history_entries, ba.total_badges, ba.earliest_badge_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY u.reputation DESC) AS reputation_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ups.total_score DESC) AS post_score_rank, SUM(ups.total_posts) OVER (PARTITION BY (u.reputation / 1000)) AS posts_by_reputation_bucket FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_post_stats ups ON u.id = ups.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comment_engagement ce ON u.id = ce.userid LEFT JOIN vote_analysis va ON u.id = va.userid LEFT JOIN post_history_trend pht ON u.id = pht.userid LEFT JOIN badge_achievers ba ON u.id = ba.userid WHERE u.creationdate >= 1302070720 AND u.reputation > 5297 AND (ups.total_score IS NOT NULL OR ce.total_comments IS NOT NULL OR va.total_votes IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY u.reputation DESC, ups.total_score DESC LIMIT 473;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT c.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY u.id ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_comments_last_3_months, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty_received FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND v.votetypeid = '1' WHERE p.creationdate >= 1544589620814 AND p.creationdate <= 1276029320662 AND p.posttypeid = 1 AND u.reputation > 66828 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 74 ORDER BY total_bounty_received DESC NULLS LAST, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT t.id::text, ', ' ORDER BY t.id::text) AS tag_ids_list, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date, MIN(p.creationdate) AS earliest_post_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank, LAG(u.reputation, 1) OVER (ORDER BY u.creationdate) AS prev_user_reputation FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid AND p.posttypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid AND c.score > '0' LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid AND b.date BETWEEN 1456290603311 AND 1319270840282 LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.votetypeid IN ('1', '1') LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid AND t.count >= 8072 LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' WHERE u.reputation >= 37296 AND u.creationdate >= 1340808756636 AND (p.score > 870 OR p.viewcount > 132075) AND (c.creationdate >= 1486776587353 OR c.creationdate IS NULL) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 65 AND SUM(p.score) > 6416 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) >= 306 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, total_posts DESC LIMIT 923;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, MAX(p.viewcount) AS max_view_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_history_events, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS linked_posts_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.favoritecount) DESC) AS favorite_rank FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1317655900778 AND p.creationdate <= 1529329593541 AND p.score > 463 AND u.reputation >= 973820 AND v.votetypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 19 AND SUM(v.bountyamount) >= '0' ORDER BY total_bounty DESC, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_viewcount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges b WHERE b.userid = u.id AND b.date >= 1280293110273) AS recent_badges, (SELECT SUM(v.bountyamount) FROM votes v WHERE v.userid = u.id AND v.votetypeid = 7 AND v.creationdate BETWEEN 1449931908210 AND 1268293250208) AS total_bounty_received, MAX(c.creationdate) AS latest_comment_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.id), 1) OVER (ORDER BY u.creationdate) AS prev_user_post_count FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid AND c.score > '1' LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid = 2 LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid AND pl.linktypeid = 1 LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE u.reputation > 83753 AND p.creationdate >= 1609408583339 AND p.posttypeid = 1 AND p.answercount >= 36 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 266 AND AVG(p.viewcount) < 669154 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1523211641888 OR c.creationdate >= 1303076407364 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 24 AND SUM(p.score) > 757 ORDER BY post_count DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1342890138366 AND v.creationdate >= 1419345976913 AND v.votetypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 46 INTERSECT SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1463589933723 AND v.creationdate >= 1499182630824 AND v.votetypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 63 ORDER BY total_bounty DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) FILTER (WHERE ph.posthistorytypeid = '1') AS specific_history_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) FILTER (WHERE pl.linktypeid = '1') AS specific_link_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.votetypeid = '1' LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid WHERE u.creationdate >= 1327667244562 AND u.reputation >= 380329 AND (p.creationdate >= 1549411089367 OR p.creationdate IS NULL) AND (v.creationdate >= 1515728692402 OR v.creationdate IS NULL) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 318 AND SUM(p.viewcount) > 653824 AND (AVG(p.score) > 11 OR AVG(p.score) IS NULL) AND COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) >= 48 ORDER BY total_views DESC, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, DATE_TRUNC('day', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) AS post_date, COUNT(p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.score) AS avg_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, SUM(p.answercount) AS total_answers, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_last_30_days FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid AND c.creationdate >= 1353934917113 LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid AND v.votetypeid = 2 AND v.creationdate >= 1526270406004 WHERE p.creationdate >= 1369080361865 AND p.score > 10 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, DATE_TRUNC('day', TO_TIMESTAMP(p.creationdate)) HAVING COUNT(p.id) > 34 ORDER BY post_date DESC, total_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes_received, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1577646849745 AND p.score > 75 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 1 ORDER BY total_posts DESC, reputation DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, SUM(c.score) AS total_comment_score, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY (p.posttypeid) ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_type_volume_rank, LAG(u.reputation, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY (p.posttypeid) ORDER BY u.creationdate) AS prev_reputation_in_post_type FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1608878926046 AND p.score > 174 AND u.reputation >= 759741 AND v.creationdate >= 1554637946555 AND c.creationdate >= 1346362255803 AND b.date >= 1406346842225 AND ph.creationdate >= 1373590006448 AND pl.creationdate >= 1499019709336 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate, p.posttypeid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 83 AND SUM(p.viewcount) > 56629 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, total_views DESC;

WITH user_activity AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS distinct_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS distinct_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS distinct_votes, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS distinct_badges, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answer_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE u.creationdate >= 1458953830 AND u.reputation >= 39418 AND (p.creationdate >= 1275761518 OR p.creationdate IS NULL) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation ), post_network AS ( SELECT pl.postid, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.relatedpostid) AS linked_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS history_entries, MAX(ph.creationdate) AS last_history_date FROM postlinks pl JOIN posthistory ph ON pl.postid = ph.postid WHERE pl.creationdate >= 1379022479 AND ph.posthistorytypeid = '1' GROUP BY pl.postid ), tag_summary AS ( SELECT t.id AS tag_id, t.count AS tag_usage, p.owneruserid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS posts_with_tag, SUM(p.favoritecount) AS total_favorites FROM tags t JOIN posts p ON t.excerptpostid = p.id WHERE t.count >= 9972 GROUP BY t.id, t.count, p.owneruserid ) SELECT ua.user_id, ua.reputation, ua.distinct_posts, ua.distinct_comments, ua.distinct_votes, ua.distinct_badges, ua.total_post_score, ua.total_views, ua.avg_answer_count, COALESCE(SUM(pn.linked_posts), 0) AS total_linked_posts, COALESCE(SUM(pn.history_entries), 0) AS total_history_entries, MAX(pn.last_history_date) AS max_history_date, COALESCE(SUM(ts.tag_usage), 0) AS total_tag_usage, COALESCE(SUM(ts.posts_with_tag), 0) AS total_tagged_posts, COALESCE(SUM(ts.total_favorites), 0) AS total_tag_favorites, COUNT(DISTINCT pn.postid) AS distinct_network_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT ts.tag_id) AS distinct_tags_used FROM user_activity ua LEFT JOIN post_network pn ON EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM posts p WHERE p.id = pn.postid AND p.owneruserid = ua.user_id ) LEFT JOIN tag_summary ts ON ua.user_id = ts.owneruserid WHERE ua.total_post_score > 159 OR ua.total_views > 11991 GROUP BY ua.user_id, ua.reputation, ua.distinct_posts, ua.distinct_comments, ua.distinct_votes, ua.distinct_badges, ua.total_post_score, ua.total_views, ua.avg_answer_count HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pn.postid) >= 30 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ts.tag_id) >= 4 ORDER BY ua.reputation DESC, total_linked_posts DESC LIMIT 303;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1403460927348 AND p.score > 84 GROUP BY u.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 33 ORDER BY total_score DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) OVER (PARTITION BY u.reputation) AS avg_score_by_reputation FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid WHERE p.score > 20.62 AND u.reputation >= 734681.34 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, p.score ORDER BY post_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes_received, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, MAX(p.viewcount) AS max_post_views, SUM(p.favoritecount) AS total_favorites, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) FILTER (WHERE ph.posthistorytypeid = 2) AS edit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) FILTER (WHERE pl.linktypeid = 1) AS duplicate_links, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.answercount) AS median_answer_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE ( (u.reputation > 93877 AND u.creationdate >= 1325750643651) OR (p.score > 718 AND p.creationdate BETWEEN 1217102262585 AND 1185098660975) OR (c.score > '5' AND c.creationdate >= 1576398696944) OR (b.date >= 1179361103763) OR (v.creationdate >= 1439424896707 AND v.votetypeid IN (2,3)) OR (ph.creationdate >= 1425976859522 AND ph.posthistorytypeid = 2) ) AND NOT ( u.views < 18 AND p.viewcount < 34 AND p.commentcount < 10 ) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 49 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 149 AND SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 303 AND AVG(p.score) < 270 ORDER BY total_posts DESC, total_comments DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE u.reputation > 242967 AND p.creationdate >= 1309868057911 AND p.creationdate <= 1545849557447 AND p.score > 471 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 22 AND AVG(p.score) > 69.02 ORDER BY upvotes_received DESC, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS total_post_history, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS total_post_links, MAX(p.score) AS max_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_view_count, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes_received, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.score) AS median_post_score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_rank FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid OR p.id = pl.relatedpostid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE u.creationdate >= 1334171322 AND p.creationdate >= 1459147805 AND (p.score > 39 OR p.score IS NULL) AND v.creationdate >= 1516912800 AND b.date >= 1379070857 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 30 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 91 AND AVG(p.viewcount) < 95294 ORDER BY total_posts DESC, total_comments DESC LIMIT 582;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score FROM users u JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid WHERE u.reputation > 756946.72 AND b.date >= 1455818932566 AND p.creationdate >= 1438279376844 AND p.id IN (SELECT ph.postid FROM posthistory ph WHERE ph.creationdate >= 1418936158243) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING AVG(c.score) > 94.11 ORDER BY badge_count DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_views, MAX(p.answercount) AS max_answers, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS user_rank FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE p.creationdate >= 1367142446200 AND p.creationdate <= 1352333696921 AND p.score > 560 AND u.reputation >= 185346 AND v.creationdate >= 1266429679322 AND v.creationdate <= 1591650321386 AND ph.creationdate >= 1462631454430 AND ph.creationdate <= 1435990253551 AND pl.creationdate >= 1389375738571 AND pl.creationdate <= 1605786860936 AND b.date >= 1446648992594 AND b.date <= 1400558186004 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 723 AND SUM(p.score) > 2743 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 347 AND COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) > 705 ORDER BY user_rank;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COALESCE(SUM(v.bountyamount), 0) AS total_bounty FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid AND v.votetypeid = 8 WHERE u.reputation > 49284 AND u.creationdate >= 1347041398 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) < 6 ORDER BY total_bounty DESC, u.reputation DESC;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_badges, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, AVG(p.answercount) AS avg_answer_count, MAX(p.favoritecount) AS max_favorite_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.votetypeid = '1') AS specific_vote_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) FILTER (WHERE ph.posthistorytypeid = '1') AS specific_history_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) FILTER (WHERE pl.linktypeid = '1') AS specific_link_count, SUM(v.bountyamount) AS total_bounty_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS post_score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) DESC) AS post_count_rank, LAG(u.reputation, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY u.id ORDER BY MIN(p.creationdate)) AS prev_reputation FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid WHERE ( (p.creationdate >= 1305667263937 AND p.creationdate <= 1536879908518) OR (c.creationdate >= 1562207962316 AND c.creationdate <= 1265479055202) OR (b.date >= 1280282311808 AND b.date <= 1454056575404) ) AND NOT (p.score < 69 AND p.viewcount < 3487) AND (u.reputation > 51602 OR u.views > 61073) AND p.posttypeid = '1' GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) > 34 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) >= 16 AND SUM(p.score) > 126 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, total_views DESC LIMIT 869;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS total_votes, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, AVG(p.viewcount) AS avg_post_views, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date, MIN(b.date) AS first_badge_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN tags t ON p.id = t.excerptpostid WHERE u.reputation > 82576 AND p.creationdate >= 1527090923 AND p.creationdate <= 1451988705 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM votes v2 WHERE v2.postid = p.id AND v2.votetypeid = '1' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM posthistory ph2 WHERE ph2.postid = p.id AND ph2.posthistorytypeid = '1' ) GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 40 AND SUM(p.score) > 401 AND AVG(p.viewcount) < 97640 ORDER BY total_post_score DESC, u.reputation DESC LIMIT 857;

WITH user_activity AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.reputation, u.creationdate AS user_creation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS vote_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS badge_count, SUM(p.score) AS total_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_views, SUM(p.answercount) AS total_answers, SUM(p.commentcount) AS total_post_comments, SUM(p.favoritecount) AS total_favorites, MAX(p.creationdate) AS latest_post_date FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.owneruserid LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.id = c.userid LEFT JOIN votes v ON u.id = v.userid LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE u.creationdate >= 1575154056 GROUP BY u.id, u.reputation, u.creationdate ), post_evolution AS ( SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.owneruserid, p.creationdate AS post_creation, p.score, p.viewcount, p.answercount, p.commentcount, p.favoritecount, COUNT(DISTINCT ph.id) AS edit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.id) AS link_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS comment_count_detailed, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes, AVG(c.score) AS avg_comment_score FROM posts p LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND ph.posthistorytypeid IN (2,5,8) LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON p.id = pl.postid LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.id = c.postid LEFT JOIN votes v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.creationdate BETWEEN 1266840857 AND 1319870733 GROUP BY p.id, p.owneruserid, p.creationdate, p.score, p.viewcount, p.answercount, p.commentcount, p.favoritecount ), tag_analysis AS ( SELECT t.id AS tag_id, t.count AS tag_usage_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS tagged_post_count, AVG(p.score) AS avg_post_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS total_tag_views, COUNT(DISTINCT p.owneruserid) AS unique_authors FROM tags t JOIN posts p ON t.excerptpostid = p.id WHERE t.count > 147 GROUP BY t.id, t.count ) SELECT ua.user_id, ua.reputation, ua.post_count, ua.comment_count, ua.vote_count, ua.badge_count, ua.total_post_score, ua.total_views, ua.total_answers, ua.total_post_comments, ua.total_favorites, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.post_id) AS active_post_count, SUM(pe.score) AS user_post_score_sum, SUM(pe.viewcount) AS user_post_views_sum, SUM(pe.edit_count) AS total_edits, SUM(pe.link_count) AS total_links, SUM(pe.upvotes) AS total_upvotes_received, SUM(pe.downvotes) AS total_downvotes_received, AVG(pe.avg_comment_score) AS avg_comment_score_on_posts, COUNT(DISTINCT ta.tag_id) AS tags_used_count, SUM(ta.tagged_post_count) AS total_tagged_posts, AVG(ta.avg_post_score) AS avg_tag_post_score, SUM(ta.total_tag_views) AS total_tag_views_contributed, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ua.total_post_score DESC) AS rank_by_post_score, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ua.reputation DESC) AS rank_by_reputation FROM user_activity ua JOIN post_evolution pe ON ua.user_id = pe.owneruserid LEFT JOIN tags t ON pe.post_id = t.excerptpostid LEFT JOIN tag_analysis ta ON t.id = ta.tag_id WHERE ua.reputation > 378 AND ua.post_count >= 82 GROUP BY ua.user_id, ua.reputation, ua.post_count, ua.comment_count, ua.vote_count, ua.badge_count, ua.total_post_score, ua.total_views, ua.total_answers, ua.total_post_comments, ua.total_favorites HAVING SUM(pe.upvotes) > 317 AND AVG(pe.avg_comment_score) < 5.14 ORDER BY ua.total_post_score DESC, ua.reputation DESC LIMIT 131;
